File Summary
================================================================

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: src/**/*, supabase/**/*, tests/**/*, index.html, package.json, vite.config.js, README.md, .env.example
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: node_modules/**, dist/**, logs/**, log.zip, *.log, .git/**, .playwright-mcp/**, repomix-output.txt, Полный код проекта.txt, код 01.09.2026.txt, Карточка Мира.txt, 01_Лор.txt, 03_Политика.txt, 04_Религия.txt, 05_Магия и заклинания.txt, 06_Экономика.txt, Этерия.json, test_input.json, temp_json.json, fix-json.js
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Line numbers have been added to the beginning of each line
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

  1: // src/config/damageTypes.js
  2: // Предопределённые типы урона в стиле D&D с алгоритмическими свойствами
  3: 
  4: /**
  5:  * Типы урона:
  6:  * - dot: может наносить урон каждый ход (damage over time)
  7:  * - half_on_save: цель может получить половину урона при успешном спасброске
  8:  * - common_resistance: часто встречается сопротивление у существ
  9:  * - common_vulnerability: часто встречается уязвимость
 10:  * - ignore_armor: игнорирует физическую броню
 11:  */

211: // Получить тип урона по ID
212: export function getDamageType(id) {
213:   return DAMAGE_TYPES[id] || DAMAGE_TYPES.physical;
214: }
215: 
216: // Получить все типы урона в виде массива
217: export function getAllDamageTypes() {
218:   return Object.values(DAMAGE_TYPES);
219: }
220: 
221: // Получить типы урона по категории
222: export function getDamageTypesByCategory(category) {
223:   return Object.values(DAMAGE_TYPES).filter(dt => dt.category === category);
224: }
225: 
226: // Проверяет, может ли тип урона быть DoT
227: export function canBeDot(damageTypeId) {
228:   const dt = DAMAGE_TYPES[damageTypeId];
229:   return dt?.dot === true;
230: }
231: 
232: // Проверяет, можно ли спастись от урона наполовину
233: export function canHalfOnSave(damageTypeId) {
234:   const dt = DAMAGE_TYPES[damageTypeId];
235:   return dt?.halfOnSave === true;
236: }
237: 
238: // Получить способность для спасброска
239: export function getSaveAbility(damageTypeId) {
240:   const dt = DAMAGE_TYPES[damageTypeId];
241:   return dt?.saveAbility || null;
242: }

================
File: src/config/hitDice.js
================
  1: // src/config/hitDice.js
  2: // Система костей хитов в стиле D&D 5e
  3: 
  4: /**
  5:  * Кость хитов по классу
  6:  * d6: волшебники, чародеи
  7:  * d8: барды, жрецы, друиды, монахи, плути, колдуны
  8:  * d10: воины, паладины, следопыты, рейнджеры
  9:  * d12: варвары
 10:  */
 11: export const CLASS_HIT_DICE = {
 12:   // d6 — хилые маги
 13:   'волшебник': 6,
 14:   'чародей': 6,
 15:   'маг': 6,
 16:   
 17:   // d8 — средние
 18:   'бард': 8,
 19:   'жрец': 8,
 20:   'друид': 8,
 21:   'монах': 8,
 22:   'плут': 8,
 23:   'колдун': 8,
 24:   'шаман': 8,
 25:   
 26:   // d10 — крепкие
 27:   'воин': 10,
 28:   'паладин': 10,
 29:   'следопыт': 10,
 30:   'рейнджер': 10,
 31:   'наемник': 10,
 32:   'рыцарь': 10,
 33:   
 34:   // d12 — самые живучие
 35:   'варвар': 12,
 36:   'берсерк': 12,
 37: };
 38: 
 39: // Среднее значение кости (половина, округлённая вверх)
 40: export const DIE_AVERAGE = {
 41:   4: 3,   // d4: 2.5 → 3
 42:   6: 4,   // d6: 3.5 → 4
 43:   8: 5,   // d8: 4.5 → 5
 44:   10: 6,  // d10: 5.5 → 6
 45:   12: 7,  // d12: 6.5 → 7
 46:   20: 11, // d20: 10.5 → 11
 47: };
 48: 
 49: /**
 50:  * Получить кость хитов по классу
 51:  * @param {string} className - класс персонажа/существа
 52:  * @returns {number} грани кости (6, 8, 10, 12)
 53:  */
 54: export function getHitDice(className) {
 55:   if (!className) return 8;
 56:   const normalized = className.toLowerCase().trim();
 57:   return CLASS_HIT_DICE[normalized] || 8; // По умолчанию d8
 58: }
 59: 
 60: /**
 61:  * Получить среднее значение кости
 62:  * @param {number} dieSides - грани кости
 63:  * @returns {number} среднее (округлено вверх)
 64:  */
 65: export function getDieAverage(dieSides) {
 66:   return DIE_AVERAGE[dieSides] || Math.ceil(dieSides / 2);
 67: }
 68: 
 69: /**
 70:  * Рассчитать HP по системе D&D
 71:  * Уровень 1: макс кости + CON mod + 10
 72:  * Каждый следующий: среднее кости + CON mod
 73:  * 
 74:  * @param {number} con - значение Телосложения
 75:  * @param {number} level - уровень
 76:  * @param {number} dieSides - грани кости хитов
 77:  * @returns {number} HP
 78:  */
 79: export function calculateHpDnd(con = 10, level = 1, dieSides = 8) {
 80:   const conMod = Math.floor((con - 10) / 2);
 81:   const dieAvg = getDieAverage(dieSides);
 82:   
 83:   // Уровень 1: макс кости + CON mod + 10
 84:   const level1Hp = dieSides + conMod + 10;
 85:   
 86:   if (level <= 1) return Math.max(1, level1Hp);
 87:   
 88:   // Каждый следующий уровень: среднее + CON mod
 89:   const perLevelGain = dieAvg + conMod;
 90:   const totalHp = level1Hp + (level - 1) * perLevelGain;
 91:   
 92:   return Math.max(1, totalHp);
 93: }
 94: 
 95: /**
 96:  * Получить информацию о кости хитов
 97:  * @param {number} dieSides 
 98:  * @returns {object} { sides, average, level1Bonus }
 99:  */
100: export function getHitDiceInfo(dieSides) {
101:   return {
102:     sides: dieSides,
103:     average: getDieAverage(dieSides),
104:     max: dieSides,
105:   };
106: }
107: 
108: /**
109:  * Все доступные кости хитов
110:  */
111: export const ALL_HIT_DICE = [6, 8, 10, 12];

  1: // src/pages/auth.js — Страница авторизации
  2: import { signIn, signUp, signInWithGoogle } from '../api/supabase.js';
  3: import { toast } from '../utils/toast.js';
  4: 
  5: export function renderAuth(container) {
  6:   let isLogin = true;
  7: 
  8:   function render() {
  9:     container.innerHTML = `
 10:       <div class="page page-centered">
 11:         <div class="auth-container">
 12:           <div class="auth-header">

 22:               <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.07H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.93l2.85-2.22.81-.62z"/>
 23:               <path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z"/>
 24:             </svg>
 25:             Войти через Google
 26:           </button>
 27: 
 28:           <div class="auth-divider">
 29:             <span>или</span>
 30:           </div>
 31: 
 32:           <form class="auth-form" id="authForm">
 33:             <div class="form-group">
 34:               <label class="form-label">Email</label>
 35:               <input type="email" class="input" id="authEmail" placeholder="your@email.com" required />
 36:             </div>
 37: 
 38:             <div class="form-group">
 39:               <label class="form-label">Пароль</label>
 40:               <input type="password" class="input" id="authPassword" placeholder="Минимум 6 символов" required minlength="6" />
 41:             </div>
 42: 
 43:             <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" style="width: 100%;" id="authSubmit">
 44:               ${isLogin ? 'Войти' : 'Создать аккаунт'}
 45:             </button>
 46:           </form>
 47: 
 48:           <p class="auth-toggle">
 49:             ${isLogin ? 'Нет аккаунта?' : 'Уже есть аккаунт?'}
 50:             <a href="#" id="authToggle">${isLogin ? 'Зарегистрироваться' : 'Войти'}</a>
 51:           </p>
 52:         </div>
 53:       </div>
 54:     `;
 55: 
 56:     document.getElementById('authToggle').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 57:       e.preventDefault();
 58:       isLogin = !isLogin;
 59:       render();
 60:     });
 61: 
 62:     document.getElementById('authForm').addEventListener('submit', handleSubmit);
 63:     document.getElementById('googleBtn').addEventListener('click', handleGoogle);
 64:   }
 65: 
 66:   async function handleGoogle() {
 67:     const btn = document.getElementById('googleBtn');
 68:     btn.disabled = true;
 69:     btn.textContent = 'Перенаправление...';
 70:     try {
 71:       await signInWithGoogle();
 72:     } catch (err) {
 73:       toast.error(err.message || 'Ошибка Google-авторизации');
 74:       btn.disabled = false;
 75:       btn.innerHTML = `<svg class="google-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20"><path fill="#4285F4" d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92a5.06 5.06 0 0 1-2.2 3.32v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.1z"/><path fill="#34A853" d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z"/><path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.07H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.93l2.85-2.22.81-.62z"/><path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z"/></svg> Войти через Google`;
 76:     }
 77:   }
 78: 
 79:   async function handleSubmit(e) {
 80:     e.preventDefault();
 81:     const email = document.getElementById('authEmail').value;
 82:     const password = document.getElementById('authPassword').value;
 83:     const submitBtn = document.getElementById('authSubmit');
 84: 
 85:     submitBtn.disabled = true;
 86:     submitBtn.textContent = 'Загрузка...';
 87: 
 88:     try {
 89:       if (isLogin) {
 90:         await signIn(email, password);
 91:         toast.success('Добро пожаловать!');
 92:       } else {
 93:         await signUp(email, password);
 94:         toast.success('Аккаунт создан! Проверьте почту для подтверждения.');
 95:       }
 96:     } catch (err) {
 97:       toast.error(err.message || 'Ошибка авторизации');
 98:     } finally {
 99:       submitBtn.disabled = false;
100:       submitBtn.textContent = isLogin ? 'Войти' : 'Создать аккаунт';
101:     }
102:   }
103: 
104:   render();
105: }

File: src/utils/generationStore.js
================
 1: // src/utils/generationStore.js — Сохранение прогресса генерации и состояния страницы
 2: 
 3: const STORAGE_PREFIX = 'multirp_gen_';
 4: const STATE_KEY = 'multirp_state';
 5: 
 6: // Save generation progress for a world
 7: export function saveGenerationProgress(worldId, progress) {
 8:   try {
 9:     const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${worldId}`;
10:     const data = {
11:       ...progress,
12:       updatedAt: Date.now(),
13:     };
14:     localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(data));
15:     console.log('[genStore] Saved progress for world:', worldId, data);
16:   } catch (err) {
17:     console.error('[genStore] Save error:', err);
18:   }
19: }
20: 
21: // Load generation progress for a world
22: export function loadGenerationProgress(worldId) {
23:   try {
24:     const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${worldId}`;
25:     const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
26:     if (!raw) return null;
27:     return JSON.parse(raw);
28:   } catch (err) {
29:     console.error('[genStore] Load error:', err);
30:     return null;
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: // Clear generation progress
35: export function clearGenerationProgress(worldId) {
36:   try {
37:     const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${worldId}`;
38:     localStorage.removeItem(key);
39:   } catch (err) {
40:     console.error('[genStore] Clear error:', err);
41:   }
42: }
43: 
44: // Save page state (active tab, open modals, etc.)
45: export function savePageState(state) {
46:   try {
47:     const data = {
48:       ...state,
49:       updatedAt: Date.now(),
50:     };
51:     sessionStorage.setItem(STATE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
52:   } catch (err) {
53:     console.error('[genStore] Save state error:', err);
54:   }
55: }
56: 
57: // Load page state
58: export function loadPageState() {
59:   try {
60:     const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(STATE_KEY);
61:     if (!raw) return null;
62:     return JSON.parse(raw);
63:   } catch (err) {
64:     console.error('[genStore] Load state error:', err);
65:     return null;
66:   }
67: }
68: 
69: // Clear page state
70: export function clearPageState() {
71:   try {
72:     sessionStorage.removeItem(STATE_KEY);
73:   } catch (err) {
74:     console.error('[genStore] Clear state error:', err);
75:   }
76: }

================
File: src/utils/indexedDB.js
================
  1: // src/utils/indexedDB.js — IndexedDB для сохранения прогресса генерации
  2: 
  3: const DB_NAME = 'MultiRP_GenerationDB';
  4: const DB_VERSION = 1;
  5: const STORE_NAME = 'generation_progress';
  6: 
  7: let db = null;
  8: 
  9: // Initialize DB
 10: async function initDB() {
 11:   if (db) return db;
 12:   
 13:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 14:     const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
 15:     
 16:     request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
 17:     request.onsuccess = () => {
 18:       db = request.result;
 19:       resolve(db);
 20:     };
 21:     
 22:     request.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {
 23:       const database = event.target.result;
 24:       if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
 25:         const store = database.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'worldId' });
 26:         store.createIndex('updatedAt', 'updatedAt', { unique: false });
 27:         store.createIndex('status', 'status', { unique: false });
 28:       }
 29:     };
 30:   });
 31: }
 32: 
 33: // Save generation progress
 34: export async function saveProgress(worldId, data) {
 35:   try {
 36:     const database = await initDB();
 37:     const tx = database.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
 38:     const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
 39:     
 40:     const record = {
 41:       worldId,
 42:       ...data,
 43:       updatedAt: Date.now(),
 44:     };
 45:     
 46:     await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 47:       const request = store.put(record);
 48:       request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
 49:       request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
 50:     });
 51:     
 52:     console.log('[IndexedDB] Progress saved for world:', worldId);
 53:   } catch (err) {
 54:     console.error('[IndexedDB] Save error:', err);
 55:   }
 56: }
 57: 
 58: // Load generation progress
 59: export async function loadProgress(worldId) {
 60:   try {
 61:     const database = await initDB();
 62:     const tx = database.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
 63:     const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
 64:     
 65:     return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 66:       const request = store.get(worldId);
 67:       request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result || null);
 68:       request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
 69:     });
 70:   } catch (err) {
 71:     console.error('[IndexedDB] Load error:', err);
 72:     return null;
 73:   }
 74: }
 75: 
 76: // Delete progress
 77: export async function deleteProgress(worldId) {
 78:   try {
 79:     const database = await initDB();
 80:     const tx = database.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
 81:     const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
 82:     
 83:     await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 84:       const request = store.delete(worldId);
 85:       request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
 86:       request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
 87:     });
 88:   } catch (err) {
 89:     console.error('[IndexedDB] Delete error:', err);
 90:   }
 91: }
 92: 
 93: // Get all incomplete generations
 94: export async function getIncompleteGenerations() {
 95:   try {
 96:     const database = await initDB();
 97:     const tx = database.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
 98:     const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
 99:     
100:     return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
101:       const request = store.getAll();
102:       request.onsuccess = () => {
103:         const results = request.result.filter(r => r.status !== 'completed');
104:         resolve(results);
105:       };
106:       request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
107:     });
108:   } catch (err) {
109:     console.error('[IndexedDB] Get incomplete error:', err);
110:     return [];
111:   }
112: }

================
File: src/utils/toast.js
================
 1: // src/utils/toast.js — Система уведомлений
 2: const CONTAINER_CLASS = 'toast-container';
 3: let container = null;
 4: 
 5: function ensureContainer() {
 6:   if (!container) {
 7:     container = document.createElement('div');
 8:     container.className = CONTAINER_CLASS;
 9:     document.body.appendChild(container);
10:   }
11: }
12: 
13: export function showToast(message, type = 'info', duration = 4000) {
14:   ensureContainer();
15: 
16:   const toast = document.createElement('div');
17:   toast.className = `toast toast-${type}`;
18:   toast.textContent = message;
19: 
20:   container.appendChild(toast);
21: 
22:   setTimeout(() => {
23:     toast.style.opacity = '0';
24:     toast.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';
25:     toast.style.transition = 'all 0.3s ease';
26:     setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);
27:   }, duration);
28: }
29: 
30: export const toast = {
31:   success: (msg) => showToast(msg, 'success'),
32:   error: (msg) => showToast(msg, 'error'),
33:   info: (msg) => showToast(msg, 'info'),
34:   warning: (msg) => showToast(msg, 'warning'),
35: };

================
File: supabase/functions/assess-durability/index.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/assess-durability/index.ts
  2: // Оценка износа/потери предмета после использования
  3: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
  4: import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";
  5: import { sanitizeKey, cleanTextForAI, parseAIJson } from "../_shared/utils.ts";
  6: 
  7: const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
  8: const SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
  9: const FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY = Deno.env.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY") || "";
 10: const AI_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.5";
 11: 
 12: const CORS = {
 13:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
 14:   "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-client-info, apikey",
 15:   "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
 16: };
 17: 
 18: const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `Ты — оценщик износа предметов в текстовой RPG. Твоя задача — оценить, как использование предмета повлияло на его состояние.
 19: 
 20: ПРАВИЛА:
 21: 1. Опиши, как именно использование предмета повлияло на его прочность.
 22: 2. Учитывай тип предмета: оружие тупится при ударе о броню, броня получает вмятины, расходники тратятся.
 23: 3. Оцени новое состояние предмета: new, used, damaged, broken.
 24: 4. Рассчитай новую прочность (durability) в процентах.
 25: 5. Если предмет сломан — укажи, можно ли его починить.
 26: 6. Если предмет был утерян — укажи это.
 27: 7. Будь реалистичен: долбежка камня мечом → сильный износ, мягкая ткань → умеренный износ.
 28: 
 29: Формат ответа — ТОЛЬКО валидный JSON:
 30: {
 31:   "durability_change": -15,
 32:   "new_durability": 85,
 33:   "new_condition": "used|damaged|broken",
 34:   "is_destroyed": false,
 35:   "is_lost": false,
 36:   "description": "Меч получил несколько вмятин при ударе о камень",
 37:   "repairable": true,
 38:   "repair_cost": 5
 39: }
 40: 
 41: ВСЁ на русском языке.`;
 42: 
 43: serve(async (req) => {
 44:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 45:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 46:   }
 47: 
 48:   try {
 49:     const raw = await req.text();
 50:     let parsed: any;
 51:     try {
 52:       parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
 53:     } catch {
 54:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Некорректный JSON в теле запроса" }), {
 55:         status: 400,
 56:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 57:       });
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     const user_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.user_id);
 61:     const item_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.item_id);
 62:     const item_name = cleanTextForAI(parsed.item_name);
 63:     const item_type = cleanTextForAI(parsed.item_type);
 64:     const item_condition = cleanTextForAI(parsed.item_condition);
 65:     const item_durability = Number(parsed.item_durability) || 100;
 66:     const action_description = cleanTextForAI(parsed.action_description);
 67:     const use_context = cleanTextForAI(parsed.use_context);
 68: 
 69:     console.log('assess-durability input:', { user_id, item_id, item_name, item_type, action_description });
 70: 
 71:     if (!user_id || !item_id || !action_description) {
 72:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "user_id, item_id и action_description обязательны" }), {
 73:         status: 400,
 74:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 75:       });
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
 79: 
 80:     let apiKey = sanitizeKey(FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY);
 81:     const { data: userSettings } = await supabase
 82:       .from("user_settings")
 83:       .select("openrouter_key")
 84:       .eq("id", user_id)
 85:       .maybeSingle();
 86:     if (userSettings?.openrouter_key) apiKey = sanitizeKey(userSettings.openrouter_key);
 87: 
 88:     if (!apiKey) {
 89:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
 90:         error: "Укажите ваш OpenRouter API Key в настройках аккаунта.",
 91:         code: "MISSING_API_KEY",
 92:       }), { status: 402, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     const userMessage = `Предмет: ${item_name} (тип: ${item_type}, состояние: ${item_condition}, прочность: ${item_durability}%)\nДействие: ${action_description}\nКонтекст: ${use_context}\n\nОцени износ и новое состояние предмета.`;
 96: 
 97:     const response = await fetch("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", {
 98:       method: "POST",
 99:       headers: {
100:         "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
101:         "Content-Type": "application/json",
102:         "HTTP-Referer": SUPABASE_URL,
103:         "X-Title": "MultiRP-AI",
104:       },
105:       body: JSON.stringify({
106:         model: AI_MODEL,
107:         messages: [
108:           { role: "system", content: SYSTEM_PROMPT },
109:           { role: "user", content: userMessage },
110:         ],
111:         temperature: 0.7,
112:         max_tokens: 500,
113:       }),
114:       signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
115:     });
116: 
117:     console.log('assess-durability OpenRouter status:', response.status);
118: 
119:     if (!response.ok) {
120:       let errDetails = "";
121:       try {
122:         const errJson = await response.json();
123:         errDetails = errJson?.error?.message || errJson?.error || JSON.stringify(errJson);
124:       } catch {
125:         errDetails = await response.text();
126:       }
127:       console.error("AI API error:", errDetails);
128:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
129:         error: "Ошибка AI API",
130:         details: errDetails,
131:         status: response.status,
132:       }), {
133:         status: 502, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
134:       });
135:     }
136: 
137:     const data = await response.json();
138:     const rawContent = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || "";
139:     console.log('assess-durability AI raw:', rawContent);
140:     const assessment = parseAIJson(rawContent);
141: 
142:     if (!assessment) {
143:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Не удалось распарсить ответ ИИ", raw: rawContent || null }), {
144:         status: 422, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
145:       });
146:     }
147: 
148:     const newDurability = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, item_durability + (Number(assessment.durability_change) || 0)));
149:     const newCondition = cleanTextForAI(assessment.new_condition) || item_condition;
150: 
151:     if (Boolean(assessment.is_destroyed) || Boolean(assessment.is_lost)) {
152:       await supabase.from("inventory").delete().eq("id", item_id);
153:     } else {
154:       await supabase.from("inventory").update({
155:         durability: newDurability,
156:         condition: newCondition,
157:       }).eq("id", item_id);
158:     }
159: 
160:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
161:       item_id,
162:       durability_change: Number(assessment.durability_change) || 0,
163:       new_durability: newDurability,
164:       new_condition: newCondition,
165:       is_destroyed: Boolean(assessment.is_destroyed),
166:       is_lost: Boolean(assessment.is_lost),
167:       description: cleanTextForAI(assessment.description),
168:       repairable: Boolean(assessment.repairable),
169:       repair_cost: Number(assessment.repair_cost) || 0,
170:     }), {
171:       status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
172:     });
173: 
174:   } catch (err) {
175:     console.error("assess-durability error:", err);
176:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
177:       error: err.message || "Internal error",
178:       details: err.message,
179:     }), {
180:       status: 500,
181:       headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
182:     });
183:   }
184: });

File: supabase/functions/generate-character-full-test/index.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/generate-character-full-test/index.ts
  2: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
  3: import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";
  4: import {
  5:   sanitizeKey,
  6:   cleanTextForAI,
  7:   parseAIJson,
  8:   validateAndFixStats,
  9:   calculateDerivedStats,
 10: } from "../_shared/utils.ts";
 11: 
 12: const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
 13: const SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
 14: const FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY = Deno.env.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY") || "";
 15: const AI_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.5";
 16: 
 17: const STATS_SYSTEM_PROMPT = `Ты — D&D-балансировщик персонажей. Твоя задача — создать сбалансированные характеристики на основе биографии персонажа.
 18: 
 19: Доступные характеристики: STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA.
 20: 
 21: ПРАВИЛА:
 22: 1. Сумма всех шести характеристик ДОЛЖНА быть ровно 72 очка.
 23: 2. Каждая характеристика — от 3 до 18.
 24: 3. Анализируй биографию: если персонаж воин — повысь STR/CON, если маг — INT/WIS, если плут — DEX, если дипломат — CHA.
 25: 4. Учитывай расу и класс для тематической подгонки.
 26: 5. Не ставь все значения по 12 — делай выраженные сильные и слабые стороны.
 27: 
 28: КРИТИЧЕСКИ ВАЖНО:
 29: - Ответь ТОЛЬКО валидным JSON. Никакого текста до или после.
 30: - Не используй markdown, не оборачивай в код-блоки.
 31: - Не добавляй объяснений, вступлений, заключений.
 32: - Убедись, что JSON полный и закрыт фигурной скобкой.
 33: - НЕ упоминай изображения, файлы, base64, avatar, image, photo, picture, icon. Этот текст не содержит изображений, это обычный текстовый запрос.
 34: 
 35: Формат:
 36: {"STR": 14, "DEX": 12, "CON": 13, "INT": 10, "WIS": 11, "CHA": 12}
 37: 
 38: Сумма = 72. Только JSON.`;
 39: 
 40: const CORS = {
 41:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
 42:   "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-client-info, apikey",
 43:   "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
 44: };
 45: 
 46: serve(async (req) => {
 47:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 48:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 49:   }
 50: 
 51:   try {
 52:     const raw = await req.text();
 53:     let parsed: any;
 54:     try {
 55:       parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
 56:     } catch {
 57:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Некорректный JSON в теле запроса" }), {
 58:         status: 400,
 59:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 60:       });
 61:     }
 62: 
 63:     const user_id = cleanTextForAI(parsed.user_id);
 64:     const name = cleanTextForAI(parsed.name);
 65:     const race = cleanTextForAI(parsed.race);
 66:     const charClass = cleanTextForAI(parsed.class);
 67:     const appearance = cleanTextForAI(parsed.appearance);
 68:     const bio = cleanTextForAI(parsed.bio);
 69: 
 70:     console.log('generate-character input:', JSON.stringify({ user_id, name, race, charClass, appearance, bio }));
 71: 
 72:     const imagePattern = /\b(image|img|photo|picture|avatar|icon|base64|data)\b[\s\S]*?\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|bmp|svg)\b/gi;
 73:     const checkFields = [name, race, charClass, appearance, bio];
 74:     for (const field of checkFields) {
 75:       if (field && new RegExp(imagePattern.source, imagePattern.flags).test(field)) {
 76:         return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Обнаружены ссылки на изображения. Удалите их и попробуйте снова." }), {
 77:           status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 78:         });
 79:       }
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
 83: 
 84:     let apiKey = sanitizeKey(FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY);
 85:     const { data: userSettings } = await supabase
 86:       .from("user_settings")
 87:       .select("openrouter_key")
 88:       .eq("id", user_id)
 89:       .maybeSingle();
 90:     if (userSettings?.openrouter_key) apiKey = sanitizeKey(userSettings.openrouter_key);
 91: 
 92:     if (!apiKey) {
 93:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
 94:         error: "Укажите ваш OpenRouter API Key в настройках аккаунта.",
 95:         code: "MISSING_API_KEY",
 96:       }), { status: 402, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     const userMessage = `Имя: ${name}\nРаса: ${race}\nКласс: ${charClass}\nВнешность: ${appearance}\nБиография: ${bio}\n\nСоздай характеристики персонажа.`;
100: 
101:     const response = await fetch("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", {
102:       method: "POST",
103:       headers: {
104:         "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
105:         "Content-Type": "application/json",
106:         "HTTP-Referer": SUPABASE_URL,
107:         "X-Title": "MultiRP-AI",
108:       },
109:       body: JSON.stringify({
110:         model: AI_MODEL,
111:         messages: [
112:           { role: "system", content: STATS_SYSTEM_PROMPT },
113:           { role: "user", content: userMessage },
114:         ],
115:         temperature: 0.8,
116:         max_tokens: 500,
117:       }),
118:       signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
119:     });
120: 
121:     console.log('generate-character OpenRouter status:', response.status);
122: 
123:     if (!response.ok) {
124:       let errDetails = "";
125:       try {
126:         const errJson = await response.json();
127:         errDetails = errJson?.error?.message || errJson?.error || JSON.stringify(errJson);
128:       } catch {
129:         errDetails = await response.text();
130:       }
131:       console.error("AI API error:", errDetails);
132:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
133:         error: "Ошибка AI API",
134:         details: errDetails,
135:         status: response.status,
136:       }), {
137:         status: 502, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
138:       });
139:     }
140: 
141:     const data = await response.json();
142:     const rawContent = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || "";
143:     console.log('generate-character AI raw:', rawContent);
144:     const stats = parseAIJson(rawContent);
145: 
146:     if (!stats) {
147:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
148:         error: "Не удалось распарсить ответ ИИ",
149:         raw: rawContent || null,
150:         stats: { STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 },
151:       }), {
152:         status: 422, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
153:       });
154:     }
155: 
156:     const result = validateAndFixStats(stats);
157:     const race2 = cleanTextForAI(parsed.race) || 'Человек';
158:     const raceAcBonus = calculateDerivedStats(result, race2, []).armor_class - 10 - Math.floor(((result.DEX || 10) - 10) / 2);
159:     const derived = calculateDerivedStats(result, race2, [], raceAcBonus);
160: 
161:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({ stats: result, race_ac_bonus: raceAcBonus, ...derived }), {
162:       status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
163:     });
164: 
165:   } catch (err) {
166:     console.error("generate-character error:", err);
167:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
168:       error: err.message || "Internal error",
169:       details: err.message,
170:     }), {
171:       status: 500,
172:       headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
173:     });
174:   }
175: });

  1: // supabase/functions/process-rest/index.ts
  2: // Обработка отдыха, восстановления HP и генерация травм через ИИ
  3: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
  4: import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";
  5: import { sanitizeKey, cleanTextForAI, parseAIJson } from "../_shared/utils.ts";
  6: 
  7: const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
  8: const SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
  9: const FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY = Deno.env.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY") || "";
 10: const AI_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.5";
 11: 
 12: const CORS = {
 13:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
 14:   "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-client-info, apikey",
 15:   "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
 16: };
 17: 
 18: const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `Ты — медицинский и ролевой анализатор для текстовой RPG. Твоя задача — обработать действие игрока, связанное с отдыхом/сном/лечением, и вернуть структурированный результат.
 19: 
 20: ПРАВИЛА:
 21: 1. Определи, действительно ли действие — это отдых, сон, лечение, лагерь.
 22: 2. Оцени длительность отдыха в часах (краткий: 1-2ч, средний: 4-6ч, длинный: 8-12ч, полный: 24ч).
 23: 3. Оцени качество отдыха: poor, normal, good, excellent.
 24: 4. Если контекст предполагает травму (падение, бой, тяжелые условия), создай травму.
 25: 5. Травмы должны быть реалистичны: перелом, ушиб, открытая рана, отравление, головокружение и т.д.
 26: 6. НЕ создавай невозможные травмы без сюжетного обоснования (отсутствие конечности, blindness и т.п. только если явно описано).
 27: 7. Дебаффы от травм: headache (головная боль), dizziness (головокружение), slowed (замедление), poisoned (отравление), bleeding (кровотечение), exhaustion (истощение).
 28: 8. Каждый дебафф должен иметь: тип, длительность в часах, штраф к статам/инициативе/HP.
 29: 
 30: Формат ответа — ТОЛЬКО валидный JSON:
 31: {
 32:   "is_rest": true/false,
 33:   "rest_quality": "poor|normal|good|excellent",
 34:   "rest_duration_hours": 8,
 35:   "hp_recovery": 15,
 36:   "injuries": [
 37:     {
 38:       "type": "Перелом руки",
 39:       "severity": "minor|major|critical",
 40:       "description": "Ты упал с лошади и сломал руку",
 41:       "stat_penalties": {"STR": -2, "DEX": -1},
 42:       "hp_penalty": 5,
 43:       "duration_hours": 48,
 44:       "is_permanent": false,
 45:       "debuffs": [
 46:         {
 47:           "type": "pain",
 48:           "duration_hours": 24,
 49:           "stat_penalties": {"STR": -2},
 50:           "initiative_penalty": -2,
 51:           "hp_per_turn": 1
 52:         }
 53:       ]
 54:     }
 55:   ],
 56:   "narrative": "Ты хорошо отдохнул в лагере..."
 57: }
 58: 
 59: ВСЁ на русском языке.`;
 60: 
 61: serve(async (req) => {
 62:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 63:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 64:   }
 65: 
 66:   try {
 67:     const raw = await req.text();
 68:     let parsed: any;
 69:     try {
 70:       parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
 71:     } catch {
 72:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Некорректный JSON в теле запроса" }), {
 73:         status: 400,
 74:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 75:       });
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     const user_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.user_id);
 79:     const player_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.player_id);
 80:     const session_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.session_id);
 81:     const action_text = cleanTextForAI(parsed.action_text);
 82:     const player_stats = parsed.player_stats || {};
 83:     const player_hp = Number(parsed.player_hp) || 0;
 84:     const player_max_hp = Number(parsed.player_max_hp) || 100;
 85:     const current_injuries = Array.isArray(parsed.current_injuries) ? parsed.current_injuries : [];
 86: 
 87:     console.log('process-rest input:', { user_id, player_id, session_id, action_text });
 88: 
 89:     if (!user_id || !player_id || !session_id || !action_text) {
 90:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "user_id, player_id, session_id и action_text обязательны" }), {
 91:         status: 400,
 92:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 93:       });
 94:     }
 95: 
 96:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
 97: 
 98:     let apiKey = sanitizeKey(FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY);
 99:     const { data: userSettings } = await supabase
100:       .from("user_settings")
101:       .select("openrouter_key")
102:       .eq("id", user_id)
103:       .maybeSingle();
104:     if (userSettings?.openrouter_key) apiKey = sanitizeKey(userSettings.openrouter_key);
105: 
106:     if (!apiKey) {
107:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
108:         error: "Укажите ваш OpenRouter API Key в настройках аккаунта.",
109:         code: "MISSING_API_KEY",
110:       }), { status: 402, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
111:     }
112: 
113:     const userMessage = `Действие игрока: "${action_text}"\n\nТекущие характеристики: ${JSON.stringify(player_stats)}\nТекущее HP: ${player_hp}/${player_max_hp}\nТекущие травмы: ${JSON.stringify(current_injuries)}\n\nОпредели, является ли это действие отдыхом/сном/лечением, и рассчитай результат.`;
114: 
115:     const response = await fetch("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", {
116:       method: "POST",
117:       headers: {
118:         "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
119:         "Content-Type": "application/json",
120:         "HTTP-Referer": SUPABASE_URL,
121:         "X-Title": "MultiRP-AI",
122:       },
123:       body: JSON.stringify({
124:         model: AI_MODEL,
125:         messages: [
126:           { role: "system", content: SYSTEM_PROMPT },
127:           { role: "user", content: userMessage },
128:         ],
129:         temperature: 0.7,
130:         max_tokens: 1000,
131:       }),
132:       signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
133:     });
134: 
135:     console.log('process-rest OpenRouter status:', response.status);
136: 
137:     if (!response.ok) {
138:       let errDetails = "";
139:       try {
140:         const errJson = await response.json();
141:         errDetails = errJson?.error?.message || errJson?.error || JSON.stringify(errJson);
142:       } catch {
143:         errDetails = await response.text();
144:       }
145:       console.error("AI API error:", errDetails);
146:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
147:         error: "Ошибка AI API",
148:         details: errDetails,
149:         status: response.status,
150:       }), {
151:         status: 502, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
152:       });
153:     }
154: 
155:     const data = await response.json();
156:     const rawContent = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || "";
157:     console.log('process-rest AI raw:', rawContent);
158:     const restData = parseAIJson(rawContent);
159: 
160:     if (!restData) {
161:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Не удалось распарсить ответ ИИ", raw: rawContent || null }), {
162:         status: 422, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
163:       });
164:     }
165: 
166:     const hpRecovery = Number(restData.hp_recovery) || 0;
167:     const newHp = Math.min(player_max_hp, Math.max(0, player_hp + hpRecovery));
168: 
169:     const injuries = Array.isArray(restData.injuries) ? restData.injuries : [];
170:     if (injuries.length > 0) {
171:       for (const injury of injuries) {
172:         await supabase.from("player_injuries").insert({
173:           player_id,
174:           session_id,
175:           injury_type: cleanTextForAI(injury.type),
176:           severity: cleanTextForAI(injury.severity) || 'minor',
177:           description: cleanTextForAI(injury.description),
178:           stat_penalties: injury.stat_penalties || {},
179:           hp_penalty: Number(injury.hp_penalty) || 0,
180:           duration_hours: Number(injury.duration_hours) || 0,
181:           is_permanent: Boolean(injury.is_permanent),
182:         });
183:       }
184:     }
185: 
186:     const { error: updateError } = await supabase
187:       .from("players")
188:       .update({
189:         hp: newHp,
190:         last_rested_at: new Date().toISOString(),
191:       })
192:       .eq("id", player_id);
193: 
194:     if (updateError) {
195:       console.error("Failed to update player:", updateError);
196:     }
197: 
198:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
199:       is_rest: Boolean(restData.is_rest),
200:       rest_quality: restData.rest_quality || 'normal',
201:       rest_duration_hours: Number(restData.rest_duration_hours) || 0,
202:       hp_recovery: hpRecovery,
203:       new_hp: newHp,
204:       injuries,
205:       narrative: restData.narrative || '',
206:     }), {
207:       status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
208:     });
209: 
210:   } catch (err) {
211:     console.error("process-rest error:", err);
212:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
213:       error: err.message || "Internal error",
214:       details: err.message,
215:     }), {
216:       status: 500,
217:       headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
218:     });
219:   }

================
File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/_base.ts
================
 1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/_base.ts
 2: // Базовый класс для хендлеров действий
 3: 
 4: import { ActionHandler, ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, ActionResult, EngineMutation, EnginePlayer, EngineNpc } from "../types.ts";
 5: import { RouterAction, ImproperToolUsage, StatToCheck } from "../../types.ts";
 6: import { getStatModifier, getProficiencyBonus, performAttackRoll, rollDamage, parseDiceString, rollD100 } from "../dice.ts";
 7: 
 8: /**
 9:  * Базовый хендлер с утилитами
10:  */
11: export abstract class BaseActionHandler implements ActionHandler {
12:   abstract readonly action_type: string;
13:   abstract handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult;
14: 
15:   // ============================================
16:   // Утилиты
17:   // ============================================
18: 
19:   protected getStatMod(player: EnginePlayer, statName: string, injuryMod: number = 0): number {
20:     const baseMod = getStatModifier(player.stats[statName] || 10);
21:     return baseMod + injuryMod;
22:   }
23: 
24:   protected getProficiency(player: EnginePlayer): number {
25:     return getProficiencyBonus(player.level || 1);
26:   }
27: 
28:   protected getStatToCheckMod(player: EnginePlayer, stat: StatToCheck, injuryPenalties: Record<string, number> = {}): number {
29:     // Маппинг StatToCheck → стат игрока
30:     const statMap: Record<StatToCheck, string> = {
31:       strength: "STR",
32:       dexterity: "DEX",
33:       stealth: "DEX", // скрытность = DEX
34:       survival: "WIS", // выживание = WIS
35:       investigation: "INT",
36:       insight: "WIS",
37:       none: "STR", // fallback
38:     };
39:     const statName = statMap[stat];
40:     const baseMod = this.getStatMod(player, statName, injuryPenalties[statName] || 0);
41:     return baseMod;
42:   }
43: 
44:   protected findItemById(player: EnginePlayer, itemId: string): EnginePlayer["inventory"][0] | null {
45:     return player.inventory.find((i) => i.id === itemId) || null;
46:   }
47: 
48:   protected findNpcById(context: EngineInputContext, npcId: string): EngineNpc | null {
49:     return context.targets.npcs.get(npcId) || null;
50:   }
51: 
52:   protected findPlayerById(context: EngineInputContext, playerId: string): EnginePlayer | null {
53:     return context.targets.players.get(playerId) || null;
54:   }
55: 
56:   /**
57:    * Парсит дайсы урона из атрибутов предмета или возвращает дефолт
58:    */
59:   protected getWeaponDamage(item: EnginePlayer["inventory"][0] | null, defaultDice: string = "1d4"): string {
60:     if (!item) return defaultDice;
61:     const attrs = item.attributes || {};
62:     if (typeof attrs.damage_dice === "string") return attrs.damage_dice;
63:     if (typeof attrs.damage === "string") return attrs.damage;
64:     return defaultDice;
65:   }
66: 
67:   /**
68:    * Создаёт мутацию UPDATE_DURABILITY для improper_tool_usage
69:    */
70:   protected buildDurabilityMutation(item: EnginePlayer["inventory"][0], usage: ImproperToolUsage): EngineMutation | null {
71:     if (!usage.is_improper) return null;
72:     return {
73:       type: "UPDATE_DURABILITY",
74:       item_id: item.id,
75:       delta: -Math.abs(usage.durability_penalty || 1),
76:       set_broken: usage.stat_penalty === "damage",
77:     };
78:   }
79: 
80:   /**
81:    * Выполняет бросок атаки/проверки
82:    */
83:   protected performCheck(
84:     statMod: number,
85:     targetDc: number,
86:     proficiency: number,
87:     advantage: boolean = false,
88:     disadvantage: boolean = false
89:   ): { d20: number; modifier: number; total: number; target_dc: number; is_crit: boolean; is_fumble: boolean; success: boolean } {
90:     return performAttackRoll({
91:       target_dc: targetDc,
92:       stat_modifier: statMod,
93:       proficiency_bonus: proficiency,
94:       advantage,
95:       disadvantage,
96:     });
97:   }
98: }

================
File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/attack_handler.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/attack_handler.ts
  2: // Обработчик атаки (и stealth_attack)
  3: 
  4: import { BaseActionHandler } from "./_base.ts";
  5: import { ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, EngineMutation } from "../types.ts";
  6: import { RouterAction } from "../../types.ts";
  7: import { rollDamage } from "../dice.ts";
  8: 
  9: export class AttackHandler extends BaseActionHandler {
 10:   readonly action_type = "attack";
 11: 
 12:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
 13:     const player = context.acting_player;
 14:     const target = this.findNpcById(context, action.target_entity_id || "")
 15:       || this.findPlayerById(context, action.target_entity_id || "");
 16: 
 17:     if (!target) {
 18:       return {
 19:         result: {
 20:           action_type: this.action_type,
 21:           success: false,
 22:           details: "Цель не найдена",
 23:         },
 24:         mutations: [],
 25:         system_facts: [`${player.name} атаковал несуществующую цель.`],
 26:       };
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     // ============================================
 30:     // PvP проверка
 31:     // ============================================
 32:     const isNpc = "is_hostile" in target;
 33:     if (!isNpc) {
 34:       // Цель — другой игрок
 35:       if (!context.session.is_pvp_enabled) {
 36:         return {
 37:           result: {
 38:             action_type: this.action_type,
 39:             success: false,
 40:             blocked: true,
 41:             block_reason: "PvP отключен в настройках сессии",
 42:             details: "PvP отключен в настройках сессии",
 43:           },
 44:           mutations: [],
 45:           system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался атаковать ${target.name}, но PvP отключён.`],
 46:         };
 47:       }
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     // ============================================
 51:     // Модификаторы (с учётом травм)
 52:     // ============================================
 53:     const injuryPenalties: Record<string, number> = {};
 54:     for (const injury of player.injuries || []) {
 55:       if (injury.stat_penalties) {
 56:         for (const [stat, penalty] of Object.entries(injury.stat_penalties)) {
 57:           injuryPenalties[stat] = (injuryPenalties[stat] || 0) + penalty;
 58:         }
 59:       }
 60:     }
 61: 
 62:     // STR-мод для melee, DEX для ranged (упрощение: STR)
 63:     const statMod = this.getStatToCheckMod(player, action.stat_to_check || "strength", injuryPenalties);
 64:     const proficiency = this.getProficiency(player);
 65: 
 66:     // Преимущество/помеха по сложности сессии
 67:     let advantage = false;
 68:     let disadvantage = false;
 69:     if (context.session.difficulty === "easy") advantage = true;
 70:     if (context.session.difficulty === "hard") disadvantage = true;
 71: 
 72:     // DC: AC цели (или кастомный)
 73:     const targetAc = target.armor_class;
 74:     const targetDc = action.ai_custom_dc || targetAc;
 75: 
 76:     const roll = this.performCheck(statMod, targetDc, proficiency, advantage, disadvantage);
 77: 
 78:     const mutations: EngineMutation[] = [];
 79:     const systemFacts: string[] = [];
 80: 
 81:     // ============================================
 82:     // Improper tool usage: штраф прочности
 83:     // ============================================
 84:     if (action.improper_tool_usage?.is_improper) {
 85:       const usedItem = action.used_item_id ? this.findItemById(player, action.used_item_id) : null;
 86:       if (usedItem) {
 87:         const durMutation = this.buildDurabilityMutation(usedItem, action.improper_tool_usage);
 88:         if (durMutation) mutations.push(durMutation);
 89:         systemFacts.push(`${player.name} использовал ${usedItem.item_name} не по назначению.`);
 90:       }
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     if (!roll.success) {
 94:       systemFacts.push(`${player.name} промахнулся по ${target.name} (d20=${roll.d20}, total=${roll.total} vs DC=${targetDc}).`);
 95:       return {
 96:         result: {
 97:           action_type: this.action_type,
 98:           success: false,
 99:           dice_roll: roll,
100:           details: `Промах по ${target.name} (${roll.total} vs ${targetDc})`,
101:         },
102:         mutations,
103:         system_facts: systemFacts,
104:       };
105:     }
106: 
107:     // ============================================
108:     // Попадание: расчёт урона
109:     // ============================================
110:     const weapon = action.used_item_id ? this.findItemById(player, action.used_item_id) : null;
111:     const damageDice = this.getWeaponDamage(weapon, "1d4");
112:     const damageRoll = rollDamage(damageDice);
113: 
114:     // Крит: удваиваем кубики урона
115:     let totalDamage = damageRoll.total + statMod;
116:     if (roll.is_crit) {
117:       const critRoll = rollDamage(damageDice);
118:       totalDamage = (damageRoll.total + critRoll.total) + statMod;
119:     }
120: 
121:     if (totalDamage < 0) totalDamage = 0;
122: 
123:     // Мутация HP цели
124:     const targetType = isNpc ? "npc" : "player";
125:     mutations.push({
126:       type: "UPDATE_HP",
127:       target_type: targetType,
128:       id: target.id,
129:       delta: -totalDamage,
130:     });
131: 
132:     systemFacts.push(
133:       `${player.name} попал по ${target.name} (d20=${roll.d20}, total=${roll.total} vs DC=${targetDc}, урон ${totalDamage}${roll.is_crit ? " — КРИТ" : ""}).`
134:     );
135: 
136:     return {
137:       result: {
138:         action_type: this.action_type,
139:         success: true,
140:         dice_roll: roll,
141:         damage_dealt: totalDamage,
142:         details: `Попадание по ${target.name}: ${totalDamage} урона`,
143:       },
144:       mutations,
145:       system_facts: systemFacts,
146:     };
147:   }
148: }
149: 
150: /**
151:  * Stealth Attack — атака из скрытности (преимущество + бонусный урон)
152:  */
153: export class StealthAttackHandler extends AttackHandler {
154:   readonly action_type = "stealth_attack";
155: 
156:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
157:     // Выполняем базовую атаку, но форсируем преимущество
158:     const result = super.handle(action, context);
159: 
160:     // Бонус +1d6 к урону за скрытность
161:     if (result.result.success && result.result.dice_roll && result.result.dice_roll.is_crit !== true) {
162:       const bonusDmg = 6; // 1d6 = 6 в среднем
163:       result.result.damage_dealt = (result.result.damage_dealt || 0) + bonusDmg;
164:       result.mutations.push({
165:         type: "UPDATE_HP",
166:         target_type: "npc",
167:         id: action.target_entity_id || "",
168:         delta: -bonusDmg,
169:       });
170:       result.system_facts.push(`Скрытая атака: +${bonusDmg} бонусного урона.`);
171:     }
172: 
173:     return result;
174:   }
175: }

================
File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/build_handler.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/build_handler.ts
  2: // Обработчик постройки структур (build_structure)
  3: 
  4: import { BaseActionHandler } from "./_base.ts";
  5: import { ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, EngineMutation } from "../types.ts";
  6: import { RouterAction } from "../../types.ts";
  7: 
  8: export class BuildHandler extends BaseActionHandler {
  9:   readonly action_type = "build_structure";
 10: 
 11:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
 12:     const player = context.acting_player;
 13:     const targetDc = action.ai_custom_dc || 15;
 14: 
 15:     // ============================================
 16:     // Проверка наличия материалов
 17:     // ============================================
 18:     const requiredMaterials = action.consumed_materials || [];
 19:     if (requiredMaterials.length === 0) {
 20:       return {
 21:         result: {
 22:           action_type: this.action_type,
 23:           success: false,
 24:           details: "Не указаны материалы для постройки",
 25:         },
 26:         mutations: [],
 27:         system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался строить без материалов.`],
 28:       };
 29:     }
 30: 
 31:     const inventoryMap = new Map();
 32:     for (const item of player.inventory) {
 33:       inventoryMap.set(item.id, item);
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     for (const required of requiredMaterials) {
 37:       const owned = inventoryMap.get(required.id);
 38:       if (!owned || owned.quantity < required.quantity) {
 39:         return {
 40:           result: {
 41:             action_type: this.action_type,
 42:             success: false,
 43:             details: `Недостаточно материалов: ${owned?.item_name || required.id}`,
 44:           },
 45:           mutations: [],
 46:           system_facts: [`${player.name} не смог построить: не хватает материалов.`],
 47:         };
 48:       }
 49:     }
 50: 
 51:     // ============================================
 52:     // Бросок против DC
 53:     // ============================================
 54:     const statMod = this.getStatToCheckMod(player, action.stat_to_check || "strength");
 55:     const proficiency = this.getProficiency(player);
 56:     const roll = this.performCheck(statMod, targetDc, proficiency);
 57: 
 58:     const mutations: EngineMutation[] = [];
 59:     const systemFacts: string[] = [];
 60: 
 61:     if (!roll.success) {
 62:       // Провал: 30% материалов испорчено
 63:       for (const required of requiredMaterials) {
 64:         const lost = Math.ceil(required.quantity * 0.3);
 65:         if (lost > 0) mutations.push({ type: "DELETE_ITEM", item_id: required.id, quantity: lost });
 66:       }
 67:       systemFacts.push(`${player.name} неудачно построил: потеряно ~30% материалов.`);
 68:       return {
 69:         result: {
 70:           action_type: this.action_type,
 71:           success: false,
 72:           dice_roll: roll,
 73:           details: `Строительство не удалось`,
 74:         },
 75:         mutations,
 76:         system_facts: systemFacts,
 77:       };
 78:     }
 79: 
 80:     // ============================================
 81:     // Успех: списать материалы + создать структуру
 82:     // ============================================
 83:     for (const required of requiredMaterials) {
 84:       mutations.push({ type: "DELETE_ITEM", item_id: required.id, quantity: required.quantity });
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     if (context.session.current_location_id) {
 88:       mutations.push({
 89:         type: "SPAWN_STRUCTURE",
 90:         location_id: context.session.current_location_id,
 91:         structure: action.dynamic_blueprint || { name: action.target_item_name || "Структура", type: "structure" },
 92:       });
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     systemFacts.push(`${player.name} успешно построил "${action.target_item_name || "структуру"}".`);
 96: 
 97:     return {
 98:       result: {
 99:         action_type: this.action_type,
100:         success: true,
101:         dice_roll: roll,
102:         details: `Построено: ${action.target_item_name || "структура"}`,
103:       },
104:       mutations,
105:       system_facts: systemFacts,
106:     };
107:   }
108: }

================
File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/craft_handler.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/craft_handler.ts
  2: // Обработчик крафта (recipe + custom)
  3: 
  4: import { BaseActionHandler } from "./_base.ts";
  5: import { ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, EngineMutation, EngineInventoryItem } from "../types.ts";
  6: import { RouterAction } from "../../types.ts";
  7: 
  8: export class CraftHandler extends BaseActionHandler {
  9:   readonly action_type = "craft_recipe";
 10: 
 11:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
 12:     return this.handleCraft(action, context);
 13:   }
 14: 
 15:   /**
 16:    * Общая логика для craft_recipe и craft_custom
 17:    */
 18:   private handleCraft(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
 19:     const player = context.acting_player;
 20:     const blueprint = action.dynamic_blueprint;
 21:     const targetDc = action.ai_custom_dc || 12;
 22: 
 23:     // ============================================
 24:     // Проверка наличия материалов
 25:     // ============================================
 26:     const requiredMaterials = action.consumed_materials || [];
 27:     if (requiredMaterials.length === 0) {
 28:       return {
 29:         result: {
 30:           action_type: action.action_type,
 31:           success: false,
 32:           details: "Не указаны материалы для крафта",
 33:         },
 34:         mutations: [],
 35:         system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался крафтить без указания материалов.`],
 36:       };
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     // Строим Map инвентаря для быстрого поиска
 40:     const inventoryMap = new Map<string, EngineInventoryItem>();
 41:     for (const item of player.inventory) {
 42:       inventoryMap.set(item.id, item);
 43:     }
 44: 
 45:     // Проверяем что все материалы есть в инвентаре
 46:     const missingMaterials: { id: string; required: number; available: number; name: string }[] = [];
 47:     for (const required of requiredMaterials) {
 48:       const owned = inventoryMap.get(required.id);
 49:       if (!owned) {
 50:         missingMaterials.push({ id: required.id, required: required.quantity, available: 0, name: required.id });
 51:       } else if (owned.quantity < required.quantity) {
 52:         missingMaterials.push({
 53:           id: required.id,
 54:           required: required.quantity,
 55:           available: owned.quantity,
 56:           name: owned.item_name,
 57:         });
 58:       }
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     if (missingMaterials.length > 0) {
 62:       const list = missingMaterials.map((m) => `${m.name} (нужно ${m.required}, есть ${m.available})`).join(", ");
 63:       return {
 64:         result: {
 65:           action_type: action.action_type,
 66:           success: false,
 67:           details: `Недостаточно материалов: ${list}`,
 68:         },
 69:         mutations: [],
 70:         system_facts: [`${player.name} не смог скрафтить: не хватает ${list}.`],
 71:       };
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     // ============================================
 75:     // Бросок против DC
 76:     // ============================================
 77:     const statMod = this.getStatToCheckMod(player, action.stat_to_check || "dexterity");
 78:     const proficiency = this.getProficiency(player);
 79:     const roll = this.performCheck(statMod, targetDc, proficiency);
 80: 
 81:     const mutations: EngineMutation[] = [];
 82:     const systemFacts: string[] = [];
 83: 
 84:     if (!roll.success) {
 85:       // Провал: списываем 50% материалов как испорченные
 86:       for (const required of requiredMaterials) {
 87:         const lostQuantity = Math.ceil(required.quantity * 0.5);
 88:         if (lostQuantity > 0) {
 89:           mutations.push({
 90:             type: "DELETE_ITEM",
 91:             item_id: required.id,
 92:             quantity: lostQuantity,
 93:           });
 94:         }
 95:       }
 96:       systemFacts.push(`${player.name} неудачно скрафтил: потеряно ${Math.ceil(requiredMaterials.length * 0.5)} материалов.`);
 97:       return {
 98:         result: {
 99:           action_type: action.action_type,
100:           success: false,
101:           dice_roll: roll,
102:           details: `Крафт не удался (${roll.total} vs ${targetDc}), часть материалов испорчена`,
103:         },
104:         mutations,
105:         system_facts: systemFacts,
106:       };
107:     }
108: 
109:     // ============================================
110:     // Успех: списываем все материалы + создаём предмет
111:     // ============================================
112:     for (const required of requiredMaterials) {
113:       mutations.push({
114:         type: "DELETE_ITEM",
115:         item_id: required.id,
116:         quantity: required.quantity,
117:       });
118:     }
119: 
120:     if (blueprint && (blueprint.item_name || blueprint.name)) {
121:       mutations.push({
122:         type: "INSERT_ITEM",
123:         owner_id: player.id,
124:         owner_type: "player",
125:         item: {
126:           item_name: blueprint.item_name || blueprint.name,
127:           type: blueprint.type || "misc",
128:           quantity: blueprint.quantity || 1,
129:           attributes: blueprint.attributes || {},
130:         },
131:       });
132:     }
133: 
134:     systemFacts.push(`${player.name} успешно скрафтил "${blueprint?.item_name || blueprint?.name || "предмет"}".`);
135: 
136:     return {
137:       result: {
138:         action_type: action.action_type,
139:         success: true,
140:         dice_roll: roll,
141:         details: `Крафт успешен: ${blueprint?.item_name || blueprint?.name || "предмет"}`,
142:       },
143:       mutations,
144:       system_facts: systemFacts,
145:     };
146:   }
147: }
148: 
149: /**
150:  * CraftCustomHandler — крафт по кастомному чертежу (dynamic_blueprint обязателен)
151:  */
152: export class CraftCustomHandler extends CraftHandler {
153:   readonly action_type = "craft_custom";
154: 
155:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
156:     if (!action.dynamic_blueprint || (!action.dynamic_blueprint.item_name && !action.dynamic_blueprint.name)) {
157:       return {
158:         result: {
159:           action_type: this.action_type,
160:           success: false,
161:           details: "Для кастомного крафта требуется dynamic_blueprint с item_name или name",
162:         },
163:         mutations: [],
164:         system_facts: [`${context.acting_player.name} попытался кастомный крафт без чертежа.`],
165:       };
166:     }
167:     return super.handle(action, context);
168:   }
169: }

================
File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/harvest_ambient_handler.ts
================
 1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/harvest_ambient_handler.ts
 2: // Обработчик сбора ресурсов из окружающей среды
 3: 
 4: import { BaseActionHandler } from "./_base.ts";
 5: import { ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, EngineMutation } from "../types.ts";
 6: import { RouterAction } from "../../types.ts";
 7: import { rollD100 } from "../dice.ts";
 8: 
 9: export class HarvestAmbientHandler extends BaseActionHandler {
10:   readonly action_type = "harvest_ambient";
11: 
12:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
13:     const player = context.acting_player;
14:     const targetItem = action.target_item_name || "ресурс";
15: 
16:     // ============================================
17:     // Модификатор (survival = WIS)
18:     // ============================================
19:     const statMod = this.getStatToCheckMod(player, "survival");
20:     const proficiency = this.getProficiency(player);
21: 
22:     // DC: из AI (обычно 10-15 для лёгкого сбора, 25-40 для сложного)
23:     const targetDc = action.ai_custom_dc || 12;
24: 
25:     const roll = this.performCheck(statMod, targetDc, proficiency);
26: 
27:     const mutations: EngineMutation[] = [];
28:     const systemFacts: string[] = [];
29: 
30:     // ============================================
31:     // Improper tool usage: всегда применяем (если есть)
32:     // ============================================
33:     if (action.improper_tool_usage?.is_improper) {
34:       const usedItem = action.used_item_id ? this.findItemById(player, action.used_item_id) : null;
35:       if (usedItem) {
36:         const durMutation = this.buildDurabilityMutation(usedItem, action.improper_tool_usage);
37:         if (durMutation) mutations.push(durMutation);
38:         systemFacts.push(`${player.name} использовал ${usedItem.item_name} не по назначению при сборе.`);
39:       }
40:     }
41: 
42:     if (!roll.success) {
43:       systemFacts.push(`${player.name} не смог собрать ${targetItem} (${roll.total} vs DC=${targetDc}).`);
44:       return {
45:         result: {
46:           action_type: this.action_type,
47:           success: false,
48:           dice_roll: roll,
49:           details: `Не удалось собрать ${targetItem}`,
50:         },
51:         mutations,
52:         system_facts: systemFacts,
53:       };
54:     }
55: 
56:     // ============================================
57:     // Успех: INSERT_ITEM
58:     // ============================================
59:     // Бросок d100 для количества (1-3 единиц)
60:     const quantity = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rollD100() / 34)); // 1, 2 или 3
61: 
62:     const newItem = {
63:       item_name: targetItem,
64:       type: "material",
65:       quantity,
66:       attributes: { harvested_at: context.session.id },
67:     };
68: 
69:     mutations.push({
70:       type: "INSERT_ITEM",
71:       owner_id: player.id,
72:       owner_type: "player",
73:       item: newItem,
74:     });
75: 
76:     systemFacts.push(`${player.name} успешно собрал ${quantity} ед. "${targetItem}".`);
77: 
78:     return {
79:       result: {
80:         action_type: this.action_type,
81:         success: true,
82:         dice_roll: roll,
83:         details: `Собрано ${quantity} ед. "${targetItem}"`,
84:       },
85:       mutations,
86:       system_facts: systemFacts,
87:     };
88:   }
89: }

================
File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/index.ts
================
 1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/index.ts
 2: // Реестр всех хендлеров действий (Command Pattern)
 3: 
 4: import { ActionHandler } from "../types.ts";
 5: import { AttackHandler, StealthAttackHandler } from "./attack_handler.ts";
 6: import { HarvestAmbientHandler } from "./harvest_ambient_handler.ts";
 7: import { CraftHandler, CraftCustomHandler } from "./craft_handler.ts";
 8: import { BuildHandler } from "./build_handler.ts";
 9: import { TransferHandler } from "./transfer_handler.ts";
10: import { TalkHandler } from "./talk_handler.ts";
11: import { LootSearchHandler, SearchHandler } from "./loot_search_handler.ts";
12: import { MoveHandler } from "./move_handler.ts";
13: 
14: /**
15:  * Маппинг action_type → хендлер
16:  */
17: const HANDLERS: Map<string, ActionHandler> = new Map();
18: 
19: function register(handler: ActionHandler) {
20:   HANDLERS.set(handler.action_type, handler);
21: }
22: 
23: register(new AttackHandler());
24: register(new StealthAttackHandler());
25: register(new HarvestAmbientHandler());
26: register(new CraftHandler());
27: register(new CraftCustomHandler());
28: register(new BuildHandler());
29: register(new TransferHandler());
30: register(new TalkHandler());
31: register(new LootSearchHandler());
32: register(new SearchHandler());
33: register(new MoveHandler());
34: 
35: /**
36:  * Получить хендлер для действия
37:  */
38: export function getHandler(actionType: string): ActionHandler | null {
39:   return HANDLERS.get(actionType) || null;
40: }
41: 
42: /**
43:  * Получить все зарегистрированные типы
44:  */
45: export function getRegisteredActionTypes(): string[] {
46:   return Array.from(HANDLERS.keys());
47: }

File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/loot_search_handler.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/loot_search_handler.ts
  2: // Обработчик лута/обыска
  3: 
  4: import { BaseActionHandler } from "./_base.ts";
  5: import { ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, EngineMutation } from "../types.ts";
  6: import { RouterAction } from "../../types.ts";
  7: import { rollD100 } from "../dice.ts";
  8: 
  9: export class LootSearchHandler extends BaseActionHandler {
 10:   readonly action_type = "loot";
 11: 
 12:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
 13:     const player = context.acting_player;
 14:     const target = this.findNpcById(context, action.target_entity_id || "");
 15: 
 16:     if (!target) {
 17:       return {
 18:         result: {
 19:           action_type: this.action_type,
 20:           success: false,
 21:           details: "Цель для лута не найдена",
 22:         },
 23:         mutations: [],
 24:         system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался обыскать несуществующую цель.`],
 25:       };
 26:     }
 27: 
 28:     // Нельзя лутать живого врага (без флага "is_alive = false" — нельзя)
 29:     if (target.is_alive) {
 30:       return {
 31:         result: {
 32:           action_type: this.action_type,
 33:           success: false,
 34:           blocked: true,
 35:           block_reason: "Цель ещё жива",
 36:           details: "Нельзя обыскать живого врага",
 37:         },
 38:         mutations: [],
 39:         system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался обыскать живого ${target.name}.`],
 40:       };
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     // ============================================
 44:     // Бросок: investigation
 45:     // ============================================
 46:     const statMod = this.getStatToCheckMod(player, "investigation");
 47:     const proficiency = this.getProficiency(player);
 48:     const targetDc = action.ai_custom_dc || 10;
 49: 
 50:     const roll = this.performCheck(statMod, targetDc, proficiency);
 51: 
 52:     const mutations: EngineMutation[] = [];
 53:     const systemFacts: string[] = [];
 54: 
 55:     if (!roll.success) {
 56:       systemFacts.push(`${player.name} не нашёл ничего полезного на теле ${target.name}.`);
 57:       return {
 58:         result: {
 59:           action_type: this.action_type,
 60:           success: false,
 61:           dice_roll: roll,
 62:           details: "Обыск не дал результатов",
 63:         },
 64:         mutations,
 65:         system_facts: systemFacts,
 66:       };
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     // ============================================
 70:     // Успех: генерируем 1-3 предмета (упрощённо — 1 предмет из target_name)
 71:     // ============================================
 72:     const itemName = action.target_item_name || "добыча";
 73:     const quantity = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rollD100() / 34));
 74: 
 75:     mutations.push({
 76:       type: "INSERT_ITEM",
 77:       owner_id: player.id,
 78:       owner_type: "player",
 79:       item: {
 80:         item_name: itemName,
 81:         type: "misc",
 82:         quantity,
 83:         attributes: { looted_from: target.id },
 84:       },
 85:     });
 86: 
 87:     systemFacts.push(`${player.name} обыскал ${target.name} и нашёл ${quantity} ед. "${itemName}".`);
 88: 
 89:     return {
 90:       result: {
 91:         action_type: this.action_type,
 92:         success: true,
 93:         dice_roll: roll,
 94:         details: `Найдено: ${quantity} ед. "${itemName}"`,
 95:       },
 96:       mutations,
 97:       system_facts: systemFacts,
 98:     };
 99:   }
100: }
101: 
102: /**
103:  * SearchHandler — обыск локации (без цели-NPC)
104:  */
105: export class SearchHandler extends BaseActionHandler {
106:   readonly action_type = "search";
107: 
108:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
109:     const player = context.acting_player;
110:     const statMod = this.getStatToCheckMod(player, "investigation");
111:     const proficiency = this.getProficiency(player);
112:     const targetDc = action.ai_custom_dc || 12;
113: 
114:     const roll = this.performCheck(statMod, targetDc, proficiency);
115: 
116:     const mutations: EngineMutation[] = [];
117:     const systemFacts: string[] = [];
118: 
119:     if (!roll.success) {
120:       systemFacts.push(`${player.name} ничего не нашёл при обыске.`);
121:       return {
122:         result: {
123:           action_type: this.action_type,
124:           success: false,
125:           dice_roll: roll,
126:           details: "Обыск не дал результатов",
127:         },
128:         mutations,
129:         system_facts: systemFacts,
130:       };
131:     }
132: 
133:     const itemName = action.target_item_name || "находка";
134:     mutations.push({
135:       type: "INSERT_ITEM",
136:       owner_id: player.id,
137:       owner_type: "player",
138:       item: { item_name: itemName, type: "misc", quantity: 1 },
139:     });
140: 
141:     systemFacts.push(`${player.name} нашёл "${itemName}" при обыске.`);
142: 
143:     return {
144:       result: {
145:         action_type: this.action_type,
146:         success: true,
147:         dice_roll: roll,
148:         details: `Найдено: ${itemName}`,
149:       },
150:       mutations,
151:       system_facts: systemFacts,
152:     };
153:   }
154: }

================
File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/move_handler.ts
================
 1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/move_handler.ts
 2: // Хендлер перемещения: «Бегу в укрытие», «Иду к озеру», «Отступаю назад».
 3: // Если DC указан — выполняется проверка (например преодоление препятствия).
 4: // Без DC — это свободное перемещение, всегда успешное (время/локация уже учтены в GPS).
 5: 
 6: import { BaseActionHandler } from "./_base.ts";
 7: import { ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, ActionResult, EngineMutation } from "../types.ts";
 8: import { RouterAction } from "../../types.ts";
 9: 
10: export class MoveHandler extends BaseActionHandler {
11:   readonly action_type = "move";
12: 
13:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
14:     const player = context.acting_player;
15:     const destination = action.target_item_name || "новое местоположение";
16: 
17:     // ============================================
18:     // Если есть DC — это проверка (например преодоление сложного участка)
19:     // ============================================
20:     if (action.ai_custom_dc && action.ai_custom_dc > 0) {
21:       const statMod = this.getStatToCheckMod(player, action.stat_to_check || "dexterity");
22:       const proficiency = this.getProficiency(player);
23:       const roll = this.performCheck(statMod, action.ai_custom_dc, proficiency);
24: 
25:       if (!roll.success) {
26:         const result: ActionResult = {
27:           action_type: this.action_type,
28:           success: false,
29:           dice_roll: {
30:             roll: roll.d20,
31:             modifier: roll.modifier,
32:             dc: action.ai_custom_dc,
33:             success: false,
34:           },
35:           details: `Не удалось преодолеть препятствие на пути к "${destination}" (бросок ${roll.total} vs DC ${action.ai_custom_dc}).`,
36:         };
37:         return {
38:           result,
39:           mutations: [],
40:           system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался переместиться к "${destination}", но препятствие помешало (бросок ${roll.total} vs DC ${action.ai_custom_dc}).`],
41:         };
42:       }
43: 
44:       const result: ActionResult = {
45:         action_type: this.action_type,
46:         success: true,
47:         dice_roll: {
48:           roll: roll.d20,
49:           modifier: roll.modifier,
50:           dc: action.ai_custom_dc,
51:           success: true,
52:         },
53:         details: `Успешное перемещение к: ${destination}`,
54:       };
55:       return {
56:         result,
57:         mutations: [],
58:         system_facts: [`${player.name} успешно преодолел препятствие и переместился к "${destination}" (бросок ${roll.total} vs DC ${action.ai_custom_dc}).`],
59:       };
60:     }
61: 
62:     // ============================================
63:     // Свободное перемещение без проверки (DC = null или 0)
64:     // Локация/время уже обрабатываются GPS-стадией.
65:     // ============================================
66:     const result: ActionResult = {
67:       action_type: this.action_type,
68:       success: true,
69:       details: `Перемещение: ${destination}`,
70:     };
71:     return {
72:       result,
73:       mutations: [],
74:       system_facts: [`${player.name} переместился в направлении: ${destination}.`],
75:     };
76:   }
77: }
