 1: // supabase/functions/test-ping/index.ts
 2: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
 3: 
 4: const CORS = {
 5:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
 6:   "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-client-info, apikey",
 7:   "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
 8: };
 9: 
10: serve(async (req) => {
11:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
12:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
13:   }
14:   return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true }), {
15:     status: 200,
16:     headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
17:   });
18: });

================
File: supabase/migrations/007_npc_inventory_rpc.sql
================
 1: -- Обновление RPC функций инвентаря для поддержки NPC
 2: -- Применять после миграции 006
 3: 
 4: -- Обновление функции add_item_to_inventory для поддержки NPC
 5: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_item_to_inventory(
 6:   p_player_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
 7:   p_item_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
 8:   p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1,
 9:   p_type TEXT DEFAULT 'misc',
10:   p_attributes JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
11:   p_npc_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
12: )
13: RETURNS UUID LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
14: DECLARE existing_item_id UUID; new_id UUID;
15: BEGIN
16:   -- Ищем существующий предмет по player_id или npc_id
17:   SELECT id INTO existing_item_id
18:   FROM inventory
19:   WHERE (
20:     (p_player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id = p_player_id)
21:     OR (p_npc_id IS NOT NULL AND npc_id = p_npc_id)
22:   )
23:   AND item_name = p_item_name
24:   AND type = p_type
25:   FOR UPDATE;
26: 
27:   IF existing_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN
28:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity + p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item_id;
29:     RETURN existing_item_id;
30:   ELSE
31:     new_id := gen_random_uuid();
32:     INSERT INTO inventory (id, player_id, npc_id, item_name, quantity, type, attributes)
33:     VALUES (new_id, p_player_id, p_npc_id, p_item_name, p_quantity, p_type, p_attributes);
34:     RETURN new_id;
35:   END IF;
36: END;
37: $$;
38: 
39: -- Обновление функции remove_item_from_inventory для поддержки NPC
40: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION remove_item_from_inventory(
41:   p_player_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
42:   p_item_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
43:   p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1,
44:   p_npc_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
45: )
46: RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
47: DECLARE existing_item RECORD;
48: BEGIN
49:   -- Ищем существующий предмет по player_id или npc_id
50:   SELECT id, quantity INTO existing_item
51:   FROM inventory
52:   WHERE (
53:     (p_player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id = p_player_id)
54:     OR (p_npc_id IS NOT NULL AND npc_id = p_npc_id)
55:   )
56:   AND item_name = p_item_name
57:   FOR UPDATE;
58: 
59:   IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;
60: 
61:   IF existing_item.quantity <= p_quantity THEN
62:     DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = existing_item.id;
63:   ELSE
64:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item.id;
65:   END IF;
66: 
67:   RETURN TRUE;
68: END;
69: $$;

================
File: supabase/migrations/008_fix_rls_recursion.sql
================
  1: -- ============================================
  2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 008: Fix RLS Infinite Recursion
  3: -- ============================================
  4: -- Исправляет ошибку "infinite recursion detected in policy for relation players"
  5: -- Создаём SECURITY DEFINER функцию, которая обходит RLS при проверке участия в сессии
  6: 
  7: -- Функция для получения session_id пользователя (обходит RLS через SECURITY DEFINER)
  8: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_session_ids(p_user_id UUID)
  9: RETURNS TABLE(session_id UUID)
 10: SECURITY DEFINER
 11: SET search_path = public
 12: AS $$
 13: BEGIN
 14:   RETURN QUERY SELECT DISTINCT p.session_id FROM public.players p WHERE p.user_id = p_user_id;
 15: END;
 16: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
 17: 
 18: -- Функция для получения player_id пользователя (обходит RLS через SECURITY DEFINER)
 19: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_player_ids(p_user_id UUID)
 20: RETURNS TABLE(player_id UUID)
 21: SECURITY DEFINER
 22: SET search_path = public
 23: AS $$
 24: BEGIN
 25:   RETURN QUERY SELECT p.id FROM public.players p WHERE p.user_id = p_user_id;
 26: END;
 27: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
 28: 
 29: -- ============================================
 30: -- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ПОЛИТИК players
 31: -- ============================================
 32: 
 33: -- Удаляем рекурсивную политику
 34: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Players: read in same session" ON players;
 35: 
 36: -- Создаём нерекурсивную политику через функцию
 37: CREATE POLICY "Players: read in same session" ON players FOR SELECT TO authenticated
 38: USING (
 39:   session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid()))
 40:   OR user_id = auth.uid()
 41: );
 42: 
 43: -- ============================================
 44: -- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ПОЛИТИК sessions
 45: -- ============================================
 46: 
 47: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Sessions: update for participants" ON sessions;
 48: 
 49: CREATE POLICY "Sessions: update for participants" ON sessions FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
 50: USING (id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid())));
 51: 
 52: -- ============================================
 53: -- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ПОЛИТИК inventory
 54: -- ============================================
 55: 
 56: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Inventory: read for owner" ON inventory;
 57: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Inventory: manage for owner" ON inventory;
 58: 
 59: CREATE POLICY "Inventory: read for owner" ON inventory FOR SELECT TO authenticated
 60: USING (player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM public.get_user_player_ids(auth.uid())));
 61: 
 62: CREATE POLICY "Inventory: manage for owner" ON inventory FOR ALL TO authenticated
 63: USING (player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM public.get_user_player_ids(auth.uid())));
 64: 
 65: -- ============================================
 66: -- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ПОЛИТИК messages
 67: -- ============================================
 68: 
 69: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Messages: read for session players" ON messages;
 70: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Messages: players send" ON messages;
 71: 
 72: CREATE POLICY "Messages: read for session players" ON messages FOR SELECT TO authenticated
 73: USING (session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid())));
 74: 
 75: CREATE POLICY "Messages: players send" ON messages FOR INSERT TO authenticated
 76: WITH CHECK (
 77:   sender_type = 'player'
 78:   AND sender_id = auth.uid()
 79:   AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid()))
 80: );
 81: 
 82: -- ============================================
 83: -- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ПОЛИТИК turn_queue
 84: -- ============================================
 85: 
 86: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Turn: read for session players" ON turn_queue;
 87: 
 88: CREATE POLICY "Turn: read for session players" ON turn_queue FOR SELECT TO authenticated
 89: USING (session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid())));
 90: 
 91: -- ============================================
 92: -- ДОБАВЛЕНИЕ ВОЗМОЖНОСТИ СОЗДАВАТЬ NPC ВРУЧНУЮ
 93: -- ============================================
 94: 
 95: -- Функция для создания NPC со всеми полями (вызывается из Edge Function или напрямую)
 96: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_npc(
 97:   p_world_id UUID,
 98:   p_name TEXT,
 99:   p_role TEXT DEFAULT 'secondary',
100:   p_race TEXT DEFAULT 'Человек',
101:   p_appearance TEXT DEFAULT '',
102:   p_background TEXT DEFAULT '',
103:   p_status_tags TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
104:   p_habits TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
105:   p_catchphrases TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
106:   p_stats JSONB DEFAULT '{"STR": 10, "DEX": 10, "CON": 10, "INT": 10, "WIS": 10, "CHA": 10}',
107:   p_hp INT DEFAULT 30,
108:   p_max_hp INT DEFAULT 30,
109:   p_location_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
110:   p_state_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
111: )
112: RETURNS UUID
113: SECURITY DEFINER
114: SET search_path = public
115: AS $$
116: DECLARE
117:   new_npc_id UUID;
118: BEGIN
119:   -- Проверяем, что мир существует
120:   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM worlds WHERE id = p_world_id) THEN
121:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'World with id % not found', p_world_id;
122:   END IF;
123: 
124:   new_npc_id := gen_random_uuid();
125: 
126:   INSERT INTO npcs (
127:     id, world_id, location_id, state_id, role, name, race,
128:     appearance, background, status_tags, habits, catchphrases,
129:     stats, hp, max_hp
130:   ) VALUES (
131:     new_npc_id, p_world_id, p_location_id, p_state_id, p_role, p_name, p_race,
132:     p_appearance, p_background, p_status_tags, p_habits, p_catchphrases,
133:     p_stats, p_hp, p_max_hp
134:   );
135: 
136:   RETURN new_npc_id;
137: END;
138: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

13:   p_user_id UUID,

17: )

File: supabase/migrations/015_add_npc_missing_fields.sql
================
 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 015: NPC Missing Fields
 3: -- Добавляет поля, которые используются в коде/экспорте но отсутствуют в БД
 4: -- ============================================
 5: 
 6: -- class: класс персонажа (воин/маг/жрец/etc), используется для определения hit_dice
 7: ALTER TABLE npcs
 8:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '';
 9: 
10: -- tier: потенциал существа (1-5), определяет количество спецатак
11: ALTER TABLE npcs
12:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tier INT DEFAULT 1 CHECK (tier BETWEEN 1 AND 5);
13: 
14: -- is_unique: уникальный экспр (получает имя), для неуникальных — диапазон уровней
15: ALTER TABLE npcs
16:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_unique BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;
17: 
18: -- level_min: минимальный уровень при спавне (для неуникальных существ)
19: ALTER TABLE npcs
20:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS level_min INT DEFAULT 1 CHECK (level_min >= 1 AND level_min <= 100);
21: 
22: -- level_max: максимальный уровень при спавне (для неуникальных существ)
23: ALTER TABLE npcs
24:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS level_max INT DEFAULT 1 CHECK (level_max >= 1 AND level_max <= 100);
25: 
26: -- Ограничение: level_max >= level_min
27: ALTER TABLE npcs
28:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS npcs_valid_level_range,
29:   ADD CONSTRAINT npcs_valid_level_range CHECK (level_max >= level_min);
30: 
31: -- Индексы для быстрой фильтрации
32: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_class ON npcs(class);
33: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_tier ON npcs(tier);
34: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_is_unique ON npcs(is_unique);
35: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_level_min ON npcs(level_min);
36: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_level_max ON npcs(level_max);
37: 
38: -- Комментарии
39: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.class IS 'Класс персонажа (воин/маг/жрец/etc), используется для определения hit_dice';
40: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.tier IS 'Потенциал существа (1-5), определяет количество спецатак';
41: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.is_unique IS 'Уникальный экземпляр (получает имя), для неуникальных — диапазон уровней';
42: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.level_min IS 'Минимальный уровень при спавне (для неуникальных существ)';
43: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.level_max IS 'Максимальный уровень при спавне (для неуникальных существ)';

 5: -- Добавляет поля gps_model и satellite_model в user_settings
 6: 
 7: -- ============================================
 8: -- Игровое время сессии (год, месяц, день, час, минута)
 9: -- ============================================

================
File: supabase/migrations/017_apply_turn_mutations.sql
================
  1: -- ============================================
  2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 017: Atomic Turn Mutations
  3: -- ============================================
  4: -- Атомарная RPC apply_turn_mutations() для Шага 3
  5: -- Гарантирует ACID-транзакцию для всех мутаций хода (защита от race conditions)
  6: 
  7: -- ============================================
  8: -- Таблица структур локаций (для build_structure)
  9: -- ============================================
 10: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS location_structures (
 11:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 12:   location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 13:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
 14:   type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shelter',
 15:   hp INT DEFAULT 50 CHECK (hp >= 0),
 16:   max_hp INT DEFAULT 50 CHECK (max_hp >= 0),
 17:   created_by UUID REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 18:   tags TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
 19:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 20:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 21: );
 22: 
 23: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_location_structures_location ON location_structures(location_id);
 24: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_location_structures_type ON location_structures(type);
 25: 
 26: COMMENT ON TABLE location_structures IS 'Структуры, построенные игроками (укрытия, мосты, ловушки)';
 27: COMMENT ON COLUMN location_structures.type IS 'Тип структуры: shelter, bridge, trap, decoration, etc.';
 28: 
 29: -- ============================================
 30: -- Патч колонок инвентаря: durability, condition, updated_at
 31: -- (необходимо для assess-durability и UPDATE_DURABILITY мутаций)
 32: -- ============================================
 33: ALTER TABLE inventory
 34:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS durability INT DEFAULT 100,
 35:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS condition TEXT DEFAULT 'good',
 36:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW();
 37: 
 38: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inventory_durability ON inventory(durability);
 39: 
 40: COMMENT ON COLUMN inventory.durability IS 'Прочность предмета (0-100). 0 = сломан';
 41: COMMENT ON COLUMN inventory.condition IS 'Состояние: good, worn, damaged, broken';
 42: COMMENT ON COLUMN inventory.updated_at IS 'Время последнего изменения предмета';
 43: 
 44: -- ============================================
 45: -- RPC: apply_turn_mutations
 46: -- ============================================
 47: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION apply_turn_mutations(
 48:   p_mutations JSONB,
 49:   p_session_id UUID
 50: )
 51: RETURNS JSONB
 52: LANGUAGE plpgsql
 53: SECURITY DEFINER
 54: AS $$
 55: DECLARE
 56:   v_mutation JSONB;
 57:   v_mutation_type TEXT;
 58:   v_applied_count INT := 0;
 59:   v_current_time JSONB;
 60:   v_session_year INT;
 61:   v_session_month INT;
 62:   v_session_day INT;
 63:   v_session_hour INT;
 64:   v_session_minute INT;
 65:   v_total_minutes INT;
 66:   v_new_minute INT;
 67:   v_new_hour INT;
 68:   v_new_day INT;
 69:   v_new_month INT;
 70:   v_new_year INT;
 71: 
 72:   -- UPDATE_HP
 73:   v_target_type TEXT;
 74:   v_target_id UUID;
 75:   v_delta INT;
 76:   v_current_hp INT;
 77:   v_max_hp INT;
 78: 
 79:   -- UPDATE_DURABILITY
 80:   v_item_id UUID;
 81:   v_durability_delta INT;
 82:   v_set_broken BOOLEAN;
 83:   v_current_durability INT;
 84:   v_attrs JSONB;
 85:   v_item_name TEXT;
 86:   v_item_quantity INT;
 87: 
 88:   -- DELETE_ITEM
 89:   v_delete_qty INT;
 90: 
 91:   -- INSERT_ITEM
 92:   v_owner_id UUID;
 93:   v_owner_type TEXT;
 94:   v_item JSONB;
 95: 
 96:   -- TRANSFER_ITEM
 97:   v_from_id UUID;
 98:   v_to_id UUID;
 99:   v_from_type TEXT;
100:   v_to_type TEXT;
101:   v_transfer_qty INT;
102: 
103:   -- SPAWN_STRUCTURE
104:   v_location_id UUID;
105:   v_structure JSONB;
106: BEGIN
107:   -- ============================================
108:   -- Загружаем текущее время сессии (для ADVANCE_TIME)
109:   -- ============================================
110:   SELECT game_year, game_month, game_day, game_hour, game_minute
111:   INTO v_session_year, v_session_month, v_session_day, v_session_hour, v_session_minute
112:   FROM sessions
113:   WHERE id = p_session_id
114:   FOR UPDATE;
115: 
116:   IF NOT FOUND THEN
117:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND: %', p_session_id
118:       USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
119:   END IF;
120: 
121:   v_new_year := v_session_year;
122:   v_new_month := v_session_month;
123:   v_new_day := v_session_day;
124:   v_new_hour := v_session_hour;
125:   v_new_minute := v_session_minute;
126: 
127:   -- ============================================
128:   -- Цикл по мутациям
129:   -- ============================================
130:   FOR v_mutation IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_mutations)
131:   LOOP
132:     v_mutation_type := v_mutation->>'type';
133: 
134:     CASE v_mutation_type
135:       WHEN 'UPDATE_HP' THEN
136:         v_target_type := v_mutation->>'target_type';
137:         v_target_id := (v_mutation->>'id')::UUID;
138:         v_delta := (v_mutation->>'delta')::INT;
139: 
140:         IF v_target_type = 'player' THEN
141:           SELECT hp, max_hp INTO v_current_hp, v_max_hp
142:           FROM players WHERE id = v_target_id FOR UPDATE;
143: 
144:           IF NOT FOUND THEN
145:             RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET_NOT_FOUND: player %', v_target_id
146:               USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
147:           END IF;
148: 
149:           UPDATE players
150:           SET hp = GREATEST(0, LEAST(max_hp, hp + v_delta)),
151:               updated_at = NOW()
152:           WHERE id = v_target_id;
153: 
154:           v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
155: 
156:         ELSIF v_target_type = 'npc' THEN
157:           SELECT hp, max_hp INTO v_current_hp, v_max_hp
158:           FROM npcs WHERE id = v_target_id FOR UPDATE;
159: 
160:           IF NOT FOUND THEN
161:             RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET_NOT_FOUND: npc %', v_target_id
162:               USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
163:           END IF;
164: 
165:           UPDATE npcs
166:           SET hp = GREATEST(0, LEAST(max_hp, hp + v_delta)),
167:               updated_at = NOW()
168:           WHERE id = v_target_id;
169: 
170:           v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
171:         ELSE
172:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TARGET_TYPE: %', v_target_type
173:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
174:         END IF;
175: 
176:       WHEN 'UPDATE_DURABILITY' THEN
177:         v_item_id := (v_mutation->>'item_id')::UUID;
178:         v_durability_delta := (v_mutation->>'delta')::INT;
179:         v_set_broken := COALESCE((v_mutation->>'set_broken')::BOOLEAN, FALSE);
180: 
181:         SELECT item_name, attributes, durability
182:         INTO v_item_name, v_attrs, v_current_durability
183:         FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id FOR UPDATE;
184: 
185:         IF NOT FOUND THEN
186:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_FOUND: %', v_item_id
187:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
188:         END IF;
189: 
190:         -- Обновляем durability в attributes JSONB
191:         v_attrs := COALESCE(v_attrs, '{}'::JSONB);
192:         v_attrs := v_attrs || jsonb_build_object(
193:           'durability', GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, COALESCE((v_attrs->>'durability')::INT, 100) + v_durability_delta))
194:         );
195: 
196:         IF v_set_broken OR (v_attrs->>'durability')::INT = 0 THEN
197:           v_attrs := v_attrs || jsonb_build_object('condition', 'broken');
198:         END IF;
199: 
200:         UPDATE inventory
201:         SET attributes = v_attrs,
202:             durability = COALESCE((v_attrs->>'durability')::INT, durability),
203:             updated_at = NOW()
204:         WHERE id = v_item_id;
205: 
206:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
207: 
208:       WHEN 'DELETE_ITEM' THEN
209:         v_item_id := (v_mutation->>'item_id')::UUID;
210:         v_delete_qty := COALESCE((v_mutation->>'quantity')::INT, 1);
211: 
212:         SELECT item_name, quantity
213:         INTO v_item_name, v_item_quantity
214:         FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id FOR UPDATE;
215: 
216:         IF NOT FOUND THEN
217:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE: %', v_item_id
218:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
219:         END IF;
220: 
221:         IF v_item_quantity < v_delete_qty THEN
222:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE: % (have %, need %)',
223:             v_item_id, v_item_quantity, v_delete_qty
224:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
225:         END IF;
226: 
227:         IF v_item_quantity = v_delete_qty THEN
228:           DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id;
229:         ELSE
230:           UPDATE inventory
231:           SET quantity = quantity - v_delete_qty,
232:               updated_at = NOW()
233:           WHERE id = v_item_id;
234:         END IF;
235: 
236:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
237: 
238:       WHEN 'INSERT_ITEM' THEN
239:         v_owner_id := (v_mutation->>'owner_id')::UUID;
240:         v_owner_type := v_mutation->>'owner_type';
241:         v_item := v_mutation->'item';
242: 
243:         IF v_owner_type = 'player' THEN
244:           -- Используем существующий add_item_to_inventory
245:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
246:             p_player_id := v_owner_id,
247:             p_item_name := v_item->>'item_name',
248:             p_quantity := COALESCE((v_item->>'quantity')::INT, 1),
249:             p_type := COALESCE(v_item->>'type', 'misc'),
250:             p_attributes := COALESCE(v_item->'attributes', '{}'::JSONB)
251:           );
252:         ELSIF v_owner_type = 'npc' THEN
253:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
254:             p_npc_id := v_owner_id,
255:             p_item_name := v_item->>'item_name',
256:             p_quantity := COALESCE((v_item->>'quantity')::INT, 1),
257:             p_type := COALESCE(v_item->>'type', 'misc'),
258:             p_attributes := COALESCE(v_item->'attributes', '{}'::JSONB)
259:           );
260:         ELSE
261:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_OWNER_TYPE: %', v_owner_type
262:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
263:         END IF;
264: 
265:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
266: 
267:       WHEN 'TRANSFER_ITEM' THEN
268:         v_item_id := (v_mutation->>'item_id')::UUID;
269:         v_from_id := (v_mutation->>'from_id')::UUID;
270:         v_to_id := (v_mutation->>'to_id')::UUID;
271:         v_from_type := v_mutation->>'from_type';
272:         v_to_type := v_mutation->>'to_type';
273:         v_transfer_qty := COALESCE((v_mutation->>'quantity')::INT, 1);
274: 
275:         -- Списываем у from (с блокировкой)
276:         SELECT item_name, quantity
277:         INTO v_item_name, v_item_quantity
278:         FROM inventory
279:         WHERE id = v_item_id
280:           AND (
281:             (v_from_type = 'player' AND player_id = v_from_id)
282:             OR (v_from_type = 'npc' AND npc_id = v_from_id)
283:           )
284:         FOR UPDATE;
285: 
286:         IF NOT FOUND THEN
287:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_TRANSFER: %', v_item_id
288:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
289:         END IF;
290: 
291:         IF v_item_quantity < v_transfer_qty THEN
292:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_TRANSFER: % (have %, need %)',
293:             v_item_id, v_item_quantity, v_transfer_qty
294:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
295:         END IF;
296: 
297:         -- Списываем
298:         IF v_item_quantity = v_transfer_qty THEN
299:           DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id;
300:         ELSE
301:           UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - v_transfer_qty WHERE id = v_item_id;
302:         END IF;
303: 
304:         -- Начисляем получателю
305:         IF v_to_type = 'player' THEN
306:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
307:             p_player_id := v_to_id,
308:             p_item_name := v_item_name,
309:             p_quantity := v_transfer_qty,
310:             p_type := 'misc',
311:             p_attributes := jsonb_build_object('transferred', true)
312:           );
313:         ELSIF v_to_type = 'npc' THEN
314:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
315:             p_npc_id := v_to_id,
316:             p_item_name := v_item_name,
317:             p_quantity := v_transfer_qty,
318:             p_type := 'misc',
319:             p_attributes := jsonb_build_object('transferred', true)
320:           );
321:         END IF;
322: 
323:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
324: 
325:       WHEN 'SPAWN_STRUCTURE' THEN
326:         v_location_id := (v_mutation->>'location_id')::UUID;
327:         v_structure := v_mutation->'structure';
328: 
329:         INSERT INTO location_structures (location_id, name, type, hp, max_hp, tags)
330:         VALUES (
331:           v_location_id,
332:           COALESCE(v_structure->>'name', 'Структура'),
333:           COALESCE(v_structure->>'type', 'shelter'),
334:           COALESCE((v_structure->>'hp')::INT, 50),
335:           COALESCE((v_structure->>'max_hp')::INT, 50),
336:           COALESCE(
337:             ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(v_structure->'tags')),
338:             ARRAY[]::TEXT[]
339:           )
340:         );
341: 
342:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
343: 
344:       WHEN 'ADVANCE_TIME' THEN
345:         v_total_minutes := (v_mutation->>'minutes')::INT;
346:         v_total_minutes := v_total_minutes + (v_new_hour * 60) + v_new_minute;
347: 
348:         -- Минуты и часы (0..59, 0..23)
349:         v_new_minute := v_total_minutes % 60;
350:         v_new_hour := (v_total_minutes / 60) % 24;
351: 
352:         -- Дни, месяцы и годы (1-based: дни 1..30, месяцы 1..12)
353:         -- Переводим в 0-based, делим/модулируем, возвращаем в 1-based
354:         v_new_day := (v_session_day - 1) + (v_total_minutes / 1440);
355:         v_new_month := (v_session_month - 1) + (v_new_day / 30);
356:         v_new_day := (v_new_day % 30) + 1;
357: 
358:         v_new_year := v_session_year + (v_new_month / 12);
359:         v_new_month := (v_new_month % 12) + 1;
360: 
361:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
362: 
363:       ELSE
364:         RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNKNOWN_MUTATION_TYPE: %', v_mutation_type
365:           USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
366:     END CASE;
367:   END LOOP;
368: 
369:   -- ============================================
370:   -- Финальное обновление времени
371:   -- ============================================
372:   UPDATE sessions
373:   SET game_year = v_new_year,
374:       game_month = v_new_month,
375:       game_day = v_new_day,
376:       game_hour = v_new_hour,
377:       game_minute = v_new_minute,
378:       updated_at = NOW()
379:   WHERE id = p_session_id;
380: 
381:   v_current_time := jsonb_build_object(
382:     'year', v_new_year,
383:     'month', v_new_month,
384:     'day', v_new_day,
385:     'hour', v_new_hour,
386:     'minute', v_new_minute
387:   );
388: 
389:   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
390:     'success', TRUE,
391:     'applied_count', v_applied_count,
392:     'new_time', v_current_time
393:   );
394: 
395: EXCEPTION
396:   WHEN OTHERS THEN
397:     -- Возвращаем ошибку (откат неявный)
398:     RETURN jsonb_build_object(
399:       'success', FALSE,
400:       'error_code', 'RACE_CONDITION_CONFLICT',
401:       'details', SQLERRM,
402:       'sql_state', SQLSTATE
403:     );
404: END;
405: $$;
406: 
407: COMMENT ON FUNCTION apply_turn_mutations IS
408:   'Атомарное применение мутаций хода. Возвращает {success, applied_count, new_time} или {success:false, error_code, details} при ошибке.';

  1: // tests/steps/step2_engine.test.ts

  3: import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";

 17: function makePlayer(overrides: Partial<any> = {}): any {
 18:   return {
 19:     id: "player-1",
 20:     name: "Элария",
 21:     stats: { STR: 12, DEX: 18, CON: 14, INT: 13, WIS: 12, CHA: 15 },
 22:     hp: 45, max_hp: 50,
 23:     armor_class: 14,
 24:     initiative: 4,
 25:     level: 5,
 26:     inventory: [
 27:       { id: "item-sword", item_name: "Стальной меч", type: "weapon", quantity: 1, durability: 15, condition: "good", attributes: { damage_dice: "1d8+2" } },
 28:       { id: "item-wood", item_name: "Дерево", type: "material", quantity: 5, durability: null, condition: null, attributes: null },
 29:       { id: "item-stone", item_name: "Камень", type: "material", quantity: 10, durability: null, condition: null, attributes: null },
 30:     ],
 31:     injuries: [],
 32:     ...overrides,
 33:   };
 34: }
 35: 
 36: function makeNpc(overrides: Partial<any> = {}): any {
 37:   return {
 38:     id: "npc-goblin-1",
 39:     name: "Гоблин-разведчик",
 40:     race: "Гоблин",
 41:     hp: 12, max_hp: 15,
 42:     armor_class: 13,
 43:     level: 1,
 44:     stats: { STR: 8, DEX: 14, CON: 10, INT: 8, WIS: 8, CHA: 8 },
 45:     is_hostile: true,
 46:     is_alive: true,
 47:     ...overrides,
 48:   };
 49: }
 50: 
 51: function makeContext(overrides: Partial<EngineInputContext> = {}): EngineInputContext {
 52:   const player = overrides.acting_player || makePlayer();
 53:   const npc = makeNpc();
 54:   const playerMap = new Map([[player.id, player]]);
 55:   const npcMap = new Map([[npc.id, npc]]);
 56: 
 57:   return {
 58:     router_output: overrides.router_output || {
 59:       status: "success",
 60:       clarification_msg: null,
 61:       actions: [],
 62:       encounter_intent: { type: "none", target_name: null },
 63:       time_estimate_minutes: 0,
 64:       atmosphere: { sounds: [], visuals: [] },
 65:     },
 66:     session: overrides.session || {
 67:       id: "session-1",
 68:       difficulty: "normal",
 69:       is_pvp_enabled: false,
 70:       game_year: 1, game_month: 1, game_day: 1,
 71:       game_hour: 8, game_minute: 0,
 72:       current_location_id: "loc-1",
 73:     },
 74:     acting_player: player,
 75:     targets: overrides.targets || {
 76:       players: playerMap,
 77:       npcs: npcMap,
 78:       location_items: new Map(),
 79:     },
 80:   };
 81: }
 82: 
 83: function makeRouterOutput(actions: any[], opts: Partial<RouterOutputPayload> = {}): RouterOutputPayload {
 84:   return {
 85:     status: "success",
 86:     clarification_msg: null,
 87:     actions,
 88:     encounter_intent: { type: "none", target_name: null },
 89:     time_estimate_minutes: 0,
 90:     atmosphere: { sounds: [], visuals: [] },
 91:     ...opts,
 92:   };
 93: }
 94: 
 95: // ============================================
 96: // ТЕСТЫ: Кубики (dice.ts)
 97: // ============================================
 98: describe("Кубики (dice.ts)", () => {
 99:   it("getStatModifier: floor((STAT-10)/2)", () => {
100:     expect(getStatModifier(10)).toBe(0);
101:     expect(getStatModifier(14)).toBe(2);
102:     expect(getStatModifier(18)).toBe(4);
103:     expect(getStatModifier(8)).toBe(-1);
104:     expect(getStatModifier(7)).toBe(-2);
105:   });
106: 
107:   it("getProficiencyBonus: ceil(level/4)+1", () => {
108:     expect(getProficiencyBonus(1)).toBe(2);
109:     expect(getProficiencyBonus(4)).toBe(2);
110:     expect(getProficiencyBonus(5)).toBe(3);
111:     expect(getProficiencyBonus(8)).toBe(3);
112:     expect(getProficiencyBonus(9)).toBe(4);
113:   });
114: 
115:   it("parseDiceString парсит корректные строки", () => {
116:     expect(parseDiceString("1d8")).toEqual({ count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 0 });
117:     expect(parseDiceString("1d8+2")).toEqual({ count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 2 });
118:     expect(parseDiceString("2d6-1")).toEqual({ count: 2, sides: 6, modifier: -1 });
119:     expect(parseDiceString("invalid")).toBeNull();
120:   });
121: 
122:   it("rollDamage выдаёт total в ожидаемом диапазоне", () => {
123:     for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
124:       const r = rollDamage("1d8+2");
125:       expect(r.total).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
126:       expect(r.total).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10);
127:       expect(r.rolls).toHaveLength(1);
128:     }
129:   });
130: 
131:   it("performAttackRoll: crit=20 → success, fumble=1 → fail (мок через spy)", () => {
132:     // Тестируем логику crit/fumble без мока Math.random (ненадёжен в Vitest)
133:     // Создаём 1000 бросков и считаем статистику
134:     let crits = 0, fumbles = 0, successes = 0;
135:     for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
136:       const r = performAttackRoll({ target_dc: 50, stat_modifier: 0 });
137:       if (r.is_crit) crits++;
138:       if (r.is_fumble) fumbles++;
139:       if (r.success) successes++;
140:     }
141: 
142:     // crit и fumble должны быть ~5% каждый (1/20)
143:     expect(crits).toBeGreaterThan(20);
144:     expect(crits).toBeLessThan(80);
145:     expect(fumbles).toBeGreaterThan(20);
146:     expect(fumbles).toBeLessThan(80);
147:     // При DC=50 и mod=0 — успехи только от crit (~5%)
148:     expect(successes).toBeGreaterThan(20);
149:     expect(successes).toBeLessThan(80);
150:   });
151: 
152:   it("performAttackRoll: advantage/disadvantage (использует 2 броска)", () => {
153:     // Используем [5, 18] через прямое присваивание
154:     const adv = { rolls: [5, 18] as [number, number], best: 18 };
155:     const dis = { rolls: [5, 18] as [number, number], worst: 5 };
156: 
157:     expect(adv.best).toBeGreaterThan(adv.rolls[0]);
158:     expect(dis.worst).toBeLessThan(dis.rolls[1]);
159: 
160:     // Реальный вызов: 2 броска d20 в диапазоне 1-20
161:     for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
162:       const a = rollD20Advantage();
163:       const d = rollD20Disadvantage();
164:       expect(a.rolls).toHaveLength(2);
165:       expect(d.rolls).toHaveLength(2);
166:       expect(a.best).toBe(Math.max(a.rolls[0], a.rolls[1]));
167:       expect(d.worst).toBe(Math.min(d.rolls[0], d.rolls[1]));
168:       expect(a.rolls[0]).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
169:       expect(a.rolls[0]).toBeLessThanOrEqual(20);
170:     }
171:   });
172: });
173:

207:   });

271:     try {
272:       const targetPlayer = makePlayer({ id: "player-2", name: "Другой игрок" });

275:       ["player-2", targetPlayer],
276:     ]);
277: 
278:     const ctx = makeContext({
279:       router_output: makeRouterOutput([
280:         {
281:           action_type: "attack",
282:           target_entity_id: "player-2",
283:           target_item_name: null,
284:           used_item_id: "item-sword",
285:           consumed_materials: null,
286:           stat_to_check: "strength",

344: describe("CraftHandler", () => {
345:   it("провал крафта при нехватке материалов", () => {
346:     const ctx = makeContext({
347:       router_output: makeRouterOutput([
348:         {
349:           action_type: "craft_recipe",
350:           target_entity_id: null,
351:           target_item_name: "Меч",
352:           used_item_id: null,
353:           consumed_materials: [
354:             { id: "item-wood", quantity: 100 }, // нужно 100, есть 5
355:           ],
356:           stat_to_check: "dexterity",
357:           ai_custom_dc: 10,
358:           improper_tool_usage: null,
359:         },
360:       ]),
361:     });
362: 
363:     const result = executeEngine(ctx);
364:     expect(result.action_results[0].success).toBe(false);
365:     expect(result.action_results[0].details).toContain("Недостаточно материалов");
366:     expect(result.mutations.find((m) => m.type === "DELETE_ITEM")).toBeUndefined();
367:   });
368: 
369:   it("успешный крафт с правильным количеством материалов", () => {
370:     // Мокаем Math.random чтобы гарантировать успех проверки (d20 = 20)
371:     const randomSpy = vi.spyOn(Math, "random").mockReturnValue(0.9999);
372:     try {
373:     const ctx = makeContext({
374:       router_output: makeRouterOutput([
375:         {
376:           action_type: "craft_recipe",
377:           target_entity_id: null,
378:           target_item_name: "Деревянный меч",
379:           used_item_id: null,
380:           consumed_materials: [
381:             { id: "item-wood", quantity: 2 },
382:           ],
383:           stat_to_check: "dexterity",
384:           ai_custom_dc: 1, // гарантированный успех
385:           improper_tool_usage: null,
386:           dynamic_blueprint: { item_name: "Деревянный меч", type: "weapon", quantity: 1 },
387:         },
388:       ]),
389:     });
390: 
391:     const result = executeEngine(ctx);
392:     expect(result.action_results[0].success).toBe(true);
393: 
394:     // DELETE_ITEM для материалов
395:     const deleteMutation = result.mutations.find((m) => m.type === "DELETE_ITEM" && (m as any).item_id === "item-wood");
396:     expect(deleteMutation).toBeDefined();
397:     expect((deleteMutation as any).quantity).toBe(2);
398: 
399:     // INSERT_ITEM для нового предмета
400:     const insertMutation = result.mutations.find((m) => m.type === "INSERT_ITEM");
401:     expect(insertMutation).toBeDefined();
402:     expect((insertMutation as any).item.item_name).toBe("Деревянный меч");
403:     } finally {
404:       randomSpy.mockRestore();
405:     }
406:   });
407: 
408:   it("провал крафта списывает 50% материалов", () => {
409:     const ctx = makeContext({
410:       router_output: makeRouterOutput([
411:         {
412:           action_type: "craft_recipe",
413:           target_entity_id: null,
414:           target_item_name: "Меч",
415:           used_item_id: null,
416:           consumed_materials: [
417:             { id: "item-wood", quantity: 4 },
418:           ],
419:           stat_to_check: "dexterity",
420:           ai_custom_dc: 100, // гарантированный провал
421:           improper_tool_usage: null,
422:           dynamic_blueprint: { item_name: "Меч" },
423:         },
424:       ]),
425:     });
426: 
427:     const result = executeEngine(ctx);
428:     expect(result.action_results[0].success).toBe(false);
429:     
430:     const deleteMutation = result.mutations.find((m) => m.type === "DELETE_ITEM");
431:     expect(deleteMutation).toBeDefined();
432:     // 50% от 4 = 2
433:     expect((deleteMutation as any).quantity).toBe(2);
434:     
435:     // Нет INSERT_ITEM при провале
436:     expect(result.mutations.find((m) => m.type === "INSERT_ITEM")).toBeUndefined();
437:   });
438: });

508: 
509:     for (const difficulty of ["easy", "normal", "hard"] as const) {
510:       const ctx = makeContext({

521:         },
522:       });
523:       const result = executeEngine(ctx);

528:   });
529:

708: });

  1: // tests/steps/step3_persistence.test.ts
  2: // Тесты для Шага 3: ACID Транзакция (Persistence)
  3: import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
  4:

 10:       if (key === "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") return "test-service-key";
 11:       return null;
 12:     }),
 13:   },
 14: });

 16: // Мокаем Supabase

 29: import { applyTurnMutations, PersistenceInputContext } from "../../supabase/functions/process-turn/steps/step3_persistence.ts";
 30: import { EngineOutputPayload } from "../../supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/types.ts";
 31: 
 32: function makeEngineOutput(mutations: any[] = [], facts: string[] = []): EngineOutputPayload {
 33:   return {
 34:     success: true,
 35:     action_results: [],
 36:     mutations: mutations as any,
 37:     encounter_triggered: { triggered: false },
 38:     raw_system_facts: facts,
 39:   };
 40: }
 41: 
 42: describe("Step 3: Persistence (ACID Транзакция)", () => {
 43:   beforeEach(() => {
 44:     vi.clearAllMocks();
 45:   });
 46: 
 47:   // ============================================
 48:   // Базовые случаи
 49:   // ============================================
 50:   it("возвращает committed если мутаций нет", async () => {
 51:     const ctx: PersistenceInputContext = {
 52:       session_id: "session-1",
 53:       engine_output: makeEngineOutput([], ["Some fact"]),
 54:     };
 55: 
 56:     const result = await applyTurnMutations(ctx);
 57: 
 58:     expect(result.status).toBe("committed");
 59:     expect(result.applied_mutations_count).toBe(0);
 60:     expect(result.enriched_system_facts).toContain("Нет мутаций для применения.");
 61:     expect(mockSupabase.rpc).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 62:   });
 63: 
 64:   it("успешно коммитит мутации (UPDATE_HP, DELETE_ITEM, INSERT_ITEM)", async () => {
 65:     const ctx: PersistenceInputContext = {
 66:       session_id: "session-1",
 67:       engine_output: makeEngineOutput([
 68:         { type: "UPDATE_HP", target_type: "npc", id: "npc-1", delta: -15 },
 69:         { type: "DELETE_ITEM", item_id: "item-1", quantity: 1 },
 70:         { type: "INSERT_ITEM", owner_id: "player-1", owner_type: "player", item: { item_name: "Сокровище", quantity: 1, type: "misc" } },
 71:       ]),
 72:     };
 73: 
 74:     mockSupabase.rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({
 75:       data: {
 76:         success: true,
 77:         applied_count: 3,
 78:         new_time: { year: 1, month: 1, day: 5, hour: 14, minute: 30 },
 79:       },
 80:       error: null,
 81:     });
 82: 
 83:     const result = await applyTurnMutations(ctx);
 84: 
 85:     expect(result.status).toBe("committed");
 86:     expect(result.applied_mutations_count).toBe(3);
 87:     expect(result.new_game_time).toEqual({ year: 1, month: 1, day: 5, hour: 14, minute: 30 });
 88:     expect(mockSupabase.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith("apply_turn_mutations", {
 89:       p_mutations: ctx.engine_output.mutations,
 90:       p_session_id: "session-1",
 91:     });
 92:   });
 93: 
 94:   // ============================================
 95:   // Race Condition / Conflict
 96:   // ============================================
 97:   it("возвращает aborted_conflict при ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE", async () => {
 98:     const ctx: PersistenceInputContext = {
 99:       session_id: "session-1",
100:       engine_output: makeEngineOutput([
101:         { type: "DELETE_ITEM", item_id: "item-stolen", quantity: 1 },
102:       ]),
103:     };
104: 
105:     mockSupabase.rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({
106:       data: null,
107:       error: { message: "ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE: item-stolen (have 0, need 1)" },
108:     });
109: 
110:     const result = await applyTurnMutations(ctx);
111: 
112:     expect(result.status).toBe("aborted_conflict");
113:     expect(result.applied_mutations_count).toBe(0);
114:     expect(result.conflict_details).toContain("ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE");
115:     expect(result.enriched_system_facts.some((f) => f.includes("race condition"))).toBe(true);
116:   });
117: 
118:   it("возвращает aborted_conflict при TARGET_NOT_FOUND", async () => {
119:     const ctx: PersistenceInputContext = {
120:       session_id: "session-1",
121:       engine_output: makeEngineOutput([
122:         { type: "UPDATE_HP", target_type: "npc", id: "deleted-npc", delta: -10 },
123:       ]),
124:     };
125: 
126:     mockSupabase.rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({
127:       data: null,
128:       error: { message: "TARGET_NOT_FOUND: npc deleted-npc" },
129:     });
130: 
131:     const result = await applyTurnMutations(ctx);
132: 
133:     expect(result.status).toBe("aborted_conflict");
134:     expect(result.conflict_details).toContain("TARGET_NOT_FOUND");
135:   });
136: 
137:   it("обрабатывает структуру {success: false} из RPC", async () => {
138:     const ctx: PersistenceInputContext = {
139:       session_id: "session-1",
140:       engine_output: makeEngineOutput([
141:         { type: "TRANSFER_ITEM", item_id: "item-1", from_id: "p-1", to_id: "p-2", from_type: "player", to_type: "player", quantity: 5 },
142:       ]),
143:     };
144: 
145:     mockSupabase.rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({
146:       data: {
147:         success: false,
148:         error_code: "RACE_CONDITION_CONFLICT",
149:         details: "ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_TRANSFER: item-1",
150:         sql_state: "P0001",
151:       },
152:       error: null,
153:     });
154: 
155:     const result = await applyTurnMutations(ctx);
156: 
157:     expect(result.status).toBe("aborted_conflict");
158:     expect(result.conflict_details).toContain("ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_TRANSFER");
159:   });
160:

162:   // Ошибка применения
163:   // ============================================

166:       session_id: "session-1",
167:       engine_output: makeEngineOutput([
168:         { type: "UPDATE_HP", target_type: "player", id: "p-1", delta: -5 },
169:       ]),
170:     };
171: 
172:     mockSupabase.rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({
173:       data: null,
174:       error: { message: "Connection timeout" },
175:     });

178:

180:     expect(result.conflict_details).toContain("Connection timeout");
181:   });
182: 
183:   it("пробрасывает исключение при критической ошибке", async () => {
184:     const ctx: PersistenceInputContext = {
185:       session_id: "session-1",

187:         { type: "UPDATE_HP", target_type: "player", id: "p-1", delta: -5 },
188:       ]),
189:     };

199:   it("корректно обрабатывает каскадный пересчёт времени", async () => {

204:       ]),
205:     };

212:         new_time: { year: 1, month: 1, day: 2, hour: 0, minute: 10 },

214:       error: null,

221:   });
222: 
223:   it("обрабатывает переход через месяц и год", async () => {
224:     const ctx: PersistenceInputContext = {
225:       session_id: "session-1",
226:       engine_output: makeEngineOutput([
227:         { type: "ADVANCE_TIME", minutes: 60 * 24 * 30 * 6 + 60 }, // 6 месяцев + 1 час
228:       ]),
229:     };

231:     mockSupabase.rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({
232:       data: {
233:         success: true,
234:         applied_count: 1,
235:         new_time: { year: 2, month: 7, day: 2, hour: 1, minute: 0 },
236:       },
237:       error: null,
238:     });
239:

241:     expect(result.status).toBe("committed");

246:   // Обогащение фактов
247:   // ============================================
248:   it("обогащает system_facts подтверждёнными данными", async () => {
249:     const ctx: PersistenceInputContext = {
250:       session_id: "session-1",
251:       engine_output: makeEngineOutput([
252:         { type: "UPDATE_HP", target_type: "npc", id: "npc-goblin", delta: -10 },
253:         { type: "DELETE_ITEM", item_id: "item-potion", quantity: 1 },
254:         { type: "INSERT_ITEM", owner_id: "player-1", owner_type: "player", item: { item_name: "Зелье лечения", quantity: 1, type: "consumable" } },
255:         { type: "UPDATE_DURABILITY", item_id: "item-sword", delta: -5, set_broken: false },
256:         { type: "ADVANCE_TIME", minutes: 15 },
257:       ]),
258:     };
259: 
260:     mockSupabase.rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({
261:       data: {
262:         success: true,
263:         applied_count: 5,
264:         new_time: { year: 1, month: 1, day: 1, hour: 8, minute: 15 },
265:       },
266:       error: null,
267:     });
268: 
269:     const result = await applyTurnMutations(ctx);
270: 
271:     expect(result.enriched_system_facts.length).toBeGreaterThan(5);
272:     expect(result.enriched_system_facts.some((f) => f.includes("10 урона"))).toBe(true);
273:     expect(result.enriched_system_facts.some((f) => f.includes("Удалено 1 ед"))).toBe(true);
274:     expect(result.enriched_system_facts.some((f) => f.includes("Зелье лечения"))).toBe(true);
275:     expect(result.enriched_system_facts.some((f) => f.includes("Прочность"))).toBe(true);
276:     expect(result.enriched_system_facts.some((f) => f.includes("Текущее время"))).toBe(true);
277:   });
278: 
279:   // ============================================
280:   // Откат при ошибке: мутации не применяются частично
281:   // ============================================
282:   it("не применяет мутации частично при ошибке (atomicity)", async () => {
283:     const ctx: PersistenceInputContext = {
284:       session_id: "session-1",
285:       engine_output: makeEngineOutput([
286:         { type: "DELETE_ITEM", item_id: "item-1", quantity: 1 },
287:         { type: "DELETE_ITEM", item_id: "item-2", quantity: 1 }, // Этот упадёт
288:         { type: "UPDATE_HP", target_type: "npc", id: "npc-1", delta: -10 },
289:       ]),
290:     };
291: 
292:     // RPC: атомарный откат всей транзакции
293:     mockSupabase.rpc.mockResolvedValueOnce({
294:       data: {
295:         success: false,
296:         error_code: "RACE_CONDITION_CONFLICT",
297:         details: "ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE: item-2",
298:       },
299:       error: null,
300:     });
301: 
302:     const result = await applyTurnMutations(ctx);
303: 
304:     // Несмотря на то, что первая мутация могла бы пройти,
305:     // весь batch откатывается
306:     expect(result.status).toBe("aborted_conflict");
307:     expect(result.applied_mutations_count).toBe(0);
308:     expect(result.conflict_details).toContain("item-2");
309:   });
310: 
311:   // ============================================
312:   // TRANSFER_ITEM
313:   // ============================================

332:       error: null,
333:     });

File: tests/steps/step4_system_truth.test.ts

  1: // tests/steps/step4_system_truth.test.ts
  2: // Тесты для Шага 4: System Truth Compiler
  3: 
  4: import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
  5: 
  6: // Мокаем Deno и Supabase
  7: vi.stubGlobal("Deno", {
  8:   env: {
  9:     get: vi.fn((key: string) => {
 10:       if (key === "SUPABASE_URL") return "https://test.supabase.co";
 11:       if (key === "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") return "test-service-key";
 12:       return null;
 13:     }),
 14:   },
 15: });
 16: 
 17: const mockRpc = vi.fn();
 18: const mockFrom = vi.fn();
 19: 
 20: vi.mock("https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2", () => ({
 21:   createClient: () => ({
 22:     rpc: mockRpc,
 23:     from: mockFrom,
 24:   }),
 25: }));
 26: 
 27: vi.mock("https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts", () => ({
 28:   serve: vi.fn(),
 29: }));
 30: 
 31: import { compileSystemTruth, SystemTruthInputContext } from "../../supabase/functions/process-turn/steps/step4_system_truth.ts";
 32: import { EngineOutputPayload } from "../../supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/types.ts";
 33: 
 34: // ============================================
 35: // Утилиты
 36: // ============================================
 37: function makePlayers() {
 38:   return [
 39:     { id: "p1", name: "Элария", hp: 45, max_hp: 50, inventory: [] },
 40:     { id: "p2", name: "Торин", hp: 40, max_hp: 50, inventory: [] },
 41:   ];
 42: }
 43: 
 44: function makeNpcs() {
 45:   return [
 46:     { id: "npc-1", name: "Гоблин-разведчик", race: "Гоблин", role: "Разведчик", status_tags: ["hostile", "alive"] },
 47:     { id: "npc-2", name: "Торговец Лиор", race: "Человек", role: "Торговец", status_tags: ["friendly"] },
 48:   ];
 49: }
 50: 
 51: function makeBaseContext(overrides: Partial<SystemTruthInputContext> = {}): SystemTruthInputContext {
 52:   return {
 53:     session_id: "session-1",
 54:     acting_player_id: "p1",
 55:     engine_output: {
 56:       action_results: [],
 57:       mutations: [],
 58:       raw_system_facts: [],
 59:       success: true,
 60:     },
 61:     persistence_output: {
 62:       status: "committed",
 63:       applied_mutations_count: 0,
 64:       enriched_system_facts: [],
 65:     },
 66:     session: {
 67:       game_year: 1, game_month: 1, game_day: 1,
 68:       game_hour: 14, game_minute: 30,
 69:       current_location_id: "loc-1",
 70:     },
 71:     location: { name: "Таверна 'Бронзовый дракон'", weather: null },
 72:     players: makePlayers(),
 73:     npcs: makeNpcs(),
 74:     atmosphere: { sounds: ["потрескивание камина"], visuals: ["тёплый свет"] },
 75:     time_passed_minutes: 0,
 76:     encounter_alert: null,
 77:     ...overrides,
 78:   };
 79: }
 80: 
 81: // ============================================
 82: // ТЕСТЫ
 83: // ============================================
 84: describe("Step 4: System Truth Compiler", () => {
 85:   beforeEach(() => {
 86:     mockRpc.mockReset();
 87:     mockFrom.mockReset();
 88:   });
 89: 
 90:   // ============================================
 91:   // Тест 1: Асимметричная скрытная атака
 92:   // ============================================
 93:   it("асимметричная скрытная атака: жертва НЕ видит ID/имя атакующего", async () => {
 94:     const context = makeBaseContext({
 95:       engine_output: {
 96:         action_results: [
 97:           {
 98:             action_type: "stealth_attack",
 99:             success: true,
100:             blocked: false,
101:             dice_roll: { roll: 18, modifier: 4, dc: 12, success: true },
102:             damage_dealt: 12,
103:             target_entity_id: "p2",
104:             target_item_name: null,
105:             used_item_id: "item-dagger",
106:             consumed_materials: null,
107:             stat_to_check: "dexterity",
108:             ai_custom_dc: 12,
109:             improper_tool_usage: null,
110:           } as any,
111:         ],
112:         mutations: [
113:           { type: "UPDATE_HP", target_type: "player", id: "p2", delta: -12 } as any,
114:         ],
115:         raw_system_facts: [],
116:         success: true,
117:       },
118:       time_passed_minutes: 6,
119:     });
120: 
121:     const result = await compileSystemTruth(context);
122: 
123:     // Атакующий (p1) видит свои броски
124:     const attackerKnowledge = result.player_truths["p1"].knowledge;
125:     expect(attackerKnowledge.some((f) => f.includes("Бросок") || f.includes("Нанесено"))).toBe(true);
126: 
127:     // Жертва (p2) НЕ должна видеть "Элария" или "p1"
128:     const victimKnowledge = result.player_truths["p2"].knowledge;
129:     const hasAttackerName = victimKnowledge.some((f) => f.includes("Элария") || f.includes("p1"));
130:     expect(hasAttackerName).toBe(false);
131: 
132:     // Жертва должна получить урон
133:     expect(result.player_truths["p2"].hp_status.delta).toBe(-12);
134: 
135:     // В фактах жертвы должно быть "Источник урона неизвестен" или подобное
136:     expect(victimKnowledge.some((f) => f.toLowerCase().includes("неизвестен") || f.toLowerCase().includes("из ниоткуда"))).toBe(true);
137:   });
138: 
139:   // ============================================
140:   // Тест 2: Открытый бой — оба игрока видят
141:   // ============================================
142:   it("открытый бой: атакующий и жертва видят корректные факты", async () => {
143:     const context = makeBaseContext({
144:       engine_output: {
145:         action_results: [
146:           {
147:             action_type: "attack",
148:             success: true,
149:             blocked: false,
150:             dice_roll: { roll: 16, modifier: 3, dc: 13, success: true },
151:             damage_dealt: 9,
152:             target_entity_id: "p2",
153:             target_item_name: null,
154:             used_item_id: "item-sword",
155:             consumed_materials: null,
156:             stat_to_check: "strength",
157:             ai_custom_dc: 13,
158:             improper_tool_usage: null,
159:           } as any,
160:         ],
161:         mutations: [
162:           { type: "UPDATE_HP", target_type: "player", id: "p2", delta: -9 } as any,
163:         ],
164:         raw_system_facts: [],
165:         success: true,
166:       },
167:     });
168: 
169:     const result = await compileSystemTruth(context);
170: 
171:     // Жертва (p2) ДОЛЖНА видеть имя атакующего
172:     const victimKnowledge = result.player_truths["p2"].knowledge;
173:     expect(victimKnowledge.some((f) => f.includes("Элария"))).toBe(true);
174:     expect(victimKnowledge.some((f) => f.includes("9"))).toBe(true);
175:   });
176: 
177:   // ============================================
178:   // Тест 3: Race Condition / Отмена хода
179:   // ============================================
180:   it("Race Condition: корректное сообщение об ошибке в knowledge инициатора", async () => {
181:     const context = makeBaseContext({
182:       persistence_output: {
183:         status: "aborted_conflict",
184:         applied_mutations_count: 0,
185:         conflict_details: "ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE",
186:         enriched_system_facts: ["Конфликт"],
187:       },
188:     });
189: 
190:     const result = await compileSystemTruth(context);
191:

File: tests/memory-engine.test.ts

  1: import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
  2: 
  3: // Мокаем все зависимости до импорта модуля
  4: const mockSupabaseFrom = vi.fn();
  5: const mockSupabase = {
  6:   from: mockSupabaseFrom,
  7: };
  8: 
  9: // Мокаем все импорты модуля
 10: vi.mock("https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2", () => ({
 11:   createClient: () => mockSupabase,
 12: }));
 13: 
 14: vi.mock("https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts", () => ({
 15:   serve: vi.fn(),
 16: }));
 17: 
 18: // Мокаем fetch
 19: const mockFetch = vi.fn();
 20: globalThis.fetch = mockFetch;
 21: 
 22: // Мокаем Deno.env
 23: vi.stubGlobal("Deno", {
 24:   env: {
 25:     get: vi.fn((key: string) => {
 26:       if (key === "SUPABASE_URL") return "https://test.supabase.co";
 27:       if (key === "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") return "test-service-key";
 28:       if (key === "OPENROUTER_API_KEY") return "test-api-key";
 29:       return null;
 30:     }),
 31:   },
 32: });
 33: 
 34: // Хелпер для создания цепочки моков Supabase
 35: function createSupabaseChain(returnValue: any) {
 36:   const chain: any = {
 37:     select: vi.fn(() => chain),
 38:     insert: vi.fn(() => chain),
 39:     update: vi.fn(() => chain),
 40:     delete: vi.fn(() => chain),
 41:     eq: vi.fn(() => chain),
 42:     in: vi.fn(() => chain),
 43:     order: vi.fn(() => chain),
 44:     limit: vi.fn(() => chain),
 45:     single: vi.fn(() => chain),
 46:     maybeSingle: vi.fn(() => chain),
 47:   };
 48:   // Для await цепочки - возвращаем промис
 49:   Object.defineProperty(chain, 'then', {
 50:     get() {
 51:       return (resolve: any) => resolve(returnValue);
 52:     },
 53:   });
 54:   return chain;
 55: }
 56: 
 57: describe("npc-memory-engine", () => {
 58:   beforeEach(() => {
 59:     vi.clearAllMocks();
 60:     vi.resetModules();
 61:   });
 62: 
 63:   it("should add vivid memory and vectorize it", async () => {
 64:     // Настраиваем мок для from()
 65:     const playerChain = createSupabaseChain({ data: { user_id: "user-123" } });
 66:     const settingsChain = createSupabaseChain({ data: { openrouter_key: "test-key" } });
 67:     const insertChain = createSupabaseChain({ error: null });
 68:     const countVividChain = createSupabaseChain({ count: 1, error: null });
 69:     const countMediumChain = createSupabaseChain({ count: 0, error: null });
 70:     const countBeliefChain = createSupabaseChain({ count: 0, error: null });
 71: 
 72:     mockSupabaseFrom
 73:       .mockReturnValueOnce(playerChain) // players
 74:       .mockReturnValueOnce(settingsChain) // user_settings
 75:       .mockReturnValueOnce(insertChain) // npc_memories insert
 76:       .mockReturnValueOnce(countVividChain) // npc_memories count vivid
 77:       .mockReturnValueOnce(countMediumChain) // npc_memories count medium
 78:       .mockReturnValueOnce(countBeliefChain); // npc_memories count belief
 79: 
 80:     // Мокаем успешный ответ от embeddings API
 81:     mockFetch.mockResolvedValueOnce({
 82:       ok: true,
 83:       json: async () => ({
 84:         data: [{ embedding: new Array(1024).fill(0.1) }],
 85:       }),
 86:     });
 87: 
 88:     // Динамически импортируем модуль (он зарегистрирует serve)
 89:     await import("../supabase/functions/npc-memory-engine/index.ts");
 90: 
 91:     // Получаем зарегистрированный serve handler
 92:     const { serve } = await import("https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts");
 93:     const handler = (serve as any).mock.calls[0][0];
 94: 
 95:     // Создаем тестовый запрос
 96:     const req = new Request("https://example.com", {
 97:       method: "POST",
 98:       headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 99:       body: JSON.stringify({
100:         npc_id: "npc-123",
101:         player_id: "player-456",
102:         memory_text: "Тестовое воспоминание",
103:       }),
104:     });
105: 
106:     const res = await handler(req);
107:     const body = await res.json();
108: 
109:     // Проверяем что вызывался fetch к embeddings
110:     expect(mockFetch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
111:       "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/embeddings",
112:       expect.objectContaining({
113:         method: "POST",
114:         body: expect.stringContaining("bge-m3"),
115:       }),
116:     );
117: 
118:     // Проверяем что вызывался insert со статусом vivid
119:     expect(insertChain.insert).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
120:       expect.objectContaining({
121:         npc_id: "npc-123",
122:         player_id: "player-456",
123:         memory_text: "Тестовое воспоминание",
124:         memory_type: "vivid",
125:         embedding: expect.any(Array),
126:       }),
127:     );
128: 
129:     expect(body.success).toBe(true);
130:   });
131: 
132:   it("should cascade vivid to medium when count > 5", async () => {
133:     // Настраиваем мок для from()
134:     const playerChain = createSupabaseChain({ data: { user_id: "user-123" } });

 11:       if (key === "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") return "test-service-key";

 18: // Mocked Supabase client
 19: const mockRpc = vi.fn();
 20: const mockFrom = vi.fn();
 21: const mockInsert = vi.fn();
 22: const mockUpdate = vi.fn();
 23: const mockSelect = vi.fn();
 24: const mockEq = vi.fn();
 25: const mockMaybeSingle = vi.fn();
 26: const mockSingle = vi.fn();
 27: const mockIn = vi.fn();
 28: const mockOrder = vi.fn();
 29: const mockLimit = vi.fn();
 30: 
 31: // Helper: создаёт цепочку thenable
 32: function makeChain(result: any) {
 33:   const chain: any = {};
 34:   chain.then = (onFulfilled: any) => Promise.resolve(result).then(onFulfilled);
 35:   chain.select = vi.fn(() => chain);
 36:   chain.eq = vi.fn(() => chain);
 37:   chain.in = vi.fn(() => chain);
 38:   chain.order = vi.fn(() => chain);
 39:   chain.limit = vi.fn(() => chain);
 40:   chain.maybeSingle = vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(result));
 41:   chain.single = vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(result));
 42:   chain.insert = vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve({ error: null }));
 43:   chain.update = vi.fn(() => chain);
 44:   return chain;
 45: }
 46: 
 47: vi.mock("https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2", () => ({
 48:   createClient: () => ({
 49:     rpc: (...args: any[]) => mockRpc(...args),
 50:     from: (table: string) => {
 51:       const builder: any = {
 52:         select: vi.fn(() => builder),
 53:         eq: vi.fn(() => builder),
 54:         in: vi.fn(() => builder),
 55:         order: vi.fn(() => builder),
 56:         limit: vi.fn(() => builder),
 57:         maybeSingle: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null })),
 58:         single: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null })),
 59:         insert: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null })),
 60:         update: vi.fn(() => builder),
 61:       };
 62:       return builder;
 63:     },
 64:   }),
 65: }));
 66: 
 67: vi.mock("https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts", () => ({
 68:   serve: vi.fn(),
 69: }));

353:       stats: { STR: 12, DEX: 14, CON: 12, INT: 12, WIS: 12, CHA: 14 },
354:       hp: 45, max_hp: 50, armor_class: 14, initiative: 4, level: 5,
355:       inventory: [{ id: "item-potion", item_name: "Зелье", type: "consumable", quantity: 1, durability: null, condition: null, attributes: null }],
356:       injuries: [],
357:     };
358:     const p2 = {
359:       id: "p2", name: "Торин",
360:       stats: { STR: 16, DEX: 10, CON: 14, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 8 },
361:       hp: 40, max_hp: 50, armor_class: 12, initiative: 0, level: 3,
362:       inventory: [], injuries: [],
363:     };
364: 
365:     const engineCtx: EngineInputContext = {
366:       router_output: routerOutput,
367:       session: { id: "session-1", difficulty: "normal", is_pvp_enabled: true, game_year: 1, game_month: 1, game_day: 1, game_hour: 12, game_minute: 0, current_location_id: "loc-1" },
368:       acting_player: p1,
369:       targets: { players: new Map([["p1", p1], ["p2", p2]]), npcs: new Map(), location_items: new Map() },
370:     };
371: 
372:     const engineResult = executeEngine(engineCtx);
373:     // Engine может не создать мутаций в этом сценарии (transfer с pvp) — подменим
374:     // на минимальный конфликтный сценарий через прямую подмену engine_output
375:     const conflictEngineResult = {
376:       ...engineResult,
377:       mutations: [
378:         { type: "TRANSFER_ITEM", from_type: "player", from_id: "p1", to_type: "player", to_id: "p2", item_id: "item-potion", quantity: 1 } as any,
379:       ],
380:       raw_system_facts: ["Конфликт при передаче"],
381:     };
382:     console.log("[TEST] engine mutations:", conflictEngineResult.mutations.length);
383: 
384:     // Mock persistence: aborted_conflict via DI
385:     const fakeSupabase = {
386:       rpc: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
387:         data: { success: false, details: "ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE" },
388:         error: null,
389:       }),
390:     };
391:     const { applyTurnMutations } = await import("../supabase/functions/process-turn/steps/step3_persistence.ts");
392:     const persistenceResult = await applyTurnMutations({ session_id: "session-1", engine_output: conflictEngineResult as any }, fakeSupabase);
393:     console.log("[TEST] persistence status:", persistenceResult.status, "details:", persistenceResult.conflict_details);
394: 
395:     expect(persistenceResult.status).toBe("aborted_conflict");
396: 
397:     const systemTruth = await compileSystemTruth({
398:       session_id: "session-1",
399:       acting_player_id: "p1",
400:       engine_output: conflictEngineResult as any,
401:       persistence_output: persistenceResult,
402:       session: { game_year: 1, game_month: 1, game_day: 1, game_hour: 12, game_minute: 0, current_location_id: "loc-1" },
403:       location: { name: "Лагерь", weather: null },
404:       players: [
405:         { id: "p1", name: "Элария", hp: 45, max_hp: 50, inventory: p1.inventory },
406:         { id: "p2", name: "Торин", hp: 40, max_hp: 50, inventory: [] },
407:       ],
408:       npcs: [],
409:       atmosphere: { sounds: [], visuals: [] },
410:       time_passed_minutes: 0,
411:       encounter_alert: null,
412:     });
413: 
414:     expect(systemTruth.turn_status).toBe("conflict");
415:     expect(systemTruth.player_truths["p1"].knowledge.some((f) => f.includes("не удалось"))).toBe(true);
416:   });
417: });

107: describe("Memory Embedding Validation", () => {
108:   it("validates embedding dimension is 1024 for bge-m3 model", () => {
109:     const EMBEDDING_DIMENSION = 1024;
110:     expect(EMBEDDING_DIMENSION).toBe(1024);
111:   });
112: 
113:   it("validates cosine similarity range", () => {
114:     const cosineSimilarity = (a: number[], b: number[]) => {
115:       const dotProduct = a.reduce((sum, val, i) => sum + val * b[i], 0);
116:       const magnitudeA = Math.sqrt(a.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val * val, 0));
117:       const magnitudeB = Math.sqrt(b.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val * val, 0));
118:       return dotProduct / (magnitudeA * magnitudeB);
119:     };
120: 
121:     const vec1 = [1, 0, 0];
122:     const vec2 = [1, 0, 0];
123:     const vec3 = [0, 1, 0];
124: 
125:     expect(cosineSimilarity(vec1, vec2)).toBeCloseTo(1);
126:     expect(cosineSimilarity(vec1, vec3)).toBeCloseTo(0);
127:   });
128: });
129:

================
File: README.md
================
  1: # MultiRP AI v2.0 — Гибридный ИИ-Движок для текстовых RPG
  2: 
  3: Асинхронная многопользовательская текстовая RPG с ИИ-Мастером на базе MiMo v2.5.
  4: 
  5: ## Архитектура
  6: 
  7: ```
  8: Frontend (PWA/Vite)  →  Supabase Backend  →  OpenRouter API (MiMo v2.5)
  9:      ↓                      ↓                        ↓
 10:   GitHub Pages          PostgreSQL +           AI-Парсер → JSON
 11:   (статика)             Edge Functions         AI-Рассказчик → Нарратив
 12: ```
 13: 
 14: **Ключевой принцип:** Supabase выступает строгим судьёй (математика, инвентарь, честность бросков), а нейросеть MiMo v2.5 — Гейммастером (парсинг действий + генерация нарратива).
 15: 
 16: ## Двухшаговый конвейер хода
 17: 
 18: 1. **Парсинг** — текст игрока → JSON (намерение, навыки, предметы)
 19: 2. **Математика** — Edge Function валидирует JSON, бросает кубики (d20), обновляет БД
 20: 3. **Нарратив** — результаты броска + лор → AI генерирует ответ
 21: 4. **Трансляция** — ответ пушится всем через Supabase Realtime
 22: 
 23: ## Быстрый старт
 24: 
 25: ### 1. Установка
 26: 
 27: ```bash
 28: git clone https://github.com/YOU/multirp-ai.git
 29: cd multirp-ai
 30: npm install
 31: ```
 32: 
 33: ### 2. Настройка Supabase
 34: 
 35: 1. Создайте проект в [Supabase](https://supabase.com)
 36: 2. Выполните SQL-миграцию:
 37:    - Перейдите SQL Editor → скопируйте содержимое `supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql`
 38: 3. Создайте Edge Function:
 39:    - `supabase functions deploy process-turn`
 40: 4. Установите секреты:
 41:    ```bash
 42:    supabase secrets set OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-...
 43:    ```
 44: 
 45: ### 3. Настройка окружения
 46: 
 47: Скопируйте `.env.example` в `.env.local` и заполните:
 48: 
 49: ```bash
 50: cp .env.example .env.local
 51: ```
 52: 
 53: ```
 54: VITE_SUPABASE_URL=https://xxx.supabase.co
 55: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=eyJ...
 56: VITE_OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-...
 57: ```
 58: 
 59: ### 4. Запуск
 60: 
 61: ```bash
 62: npm run dev
 63: ```
 64: 
 65: ### 5. Деплой на GitHub Pages
 66: 
 67: ```bash
 68: npm run build
 69: # Деплой папки dist/
 70: ```
 71: 
 72: ## Структура проекта
 73: 
 74: ```
 75: multirp-ai/
 76: ├── index.html                 # Точка входа PWA
 77: ├── public/
 78: │   ├── manifest.json          # PWA Manifest
 79: │   ├── sw.js                  # Service Worker (офлайн)
 80: │   └── favicon.svg
 81: ├── src/
 82: │   ├── main.js                # Entry point
 83: │   ├── config.js              # Конфигурация
 84: │   ├── router.js              # SPA-роутер
 85: │   ├── api/
 86: │   │   ├── supabase.js        # Клиент Supabase + Auth
 87: │   │   └── game.js            # API-методы (CRUD)
 88: │   ├── pages/
 89: │   │   ├── auth.js            # Авторизация
 90: │   │   ├── lobby.js           # Глобальное лобби
 91: │   │   ├── session-settings.js# Настройки сессии
 92: │   │   └── game.js            # Игровой экран
 93: │   ├── styles/
 94: │   │   ├── variables.css      # CSS Custom Properties
 95: │   │   ├── main.css           # Глобальные стили
 96: │   │   └── game.css           # Стили игрого экрана
 97: │   └── utils/
 98: │       ├── toast.js           # Уведомления
 99: │       └── dice.js            # Броски кубиков (UI)
100: ├── supabase/
101: │   ├── config.toml
102: │   ├── migrations/
103: │   │   └── 001_initial_schema.sql  # Вся БД + RPC
104: │   └── functions/
105: │       └── process-turn/
106: │           └── index.ts       # AI Pipeline Edge Function
107: └── .env.example
108: ```
109: 
110: ## База данных
111: 
112: | Таблица       | Описание                          |
113: |--------------|-----------------------------------|
114: | `worlds`     | Миры и сеттинги                   |
115: | `lore_files` | База знаний мира (Markdown)       |
116: | `sessions`   | Игровые комнаты                   |
117: | `players`    | Карточки персонажей               |
118: | `inventory`  | Вещи и экипировка                 |
119: | `messages`   | Игровой чат (только ответы Мастера)|
120: | `turn_queue` | Очередь ходов                     |
121: 
122: ## RPC-функции
123: 
124: | Функция                      | Описание                                  |
125: |-----------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
126: | `roll_d20(stat, mod)`       | Бросок d20 с модификатором                |
127: | `roll_d20_advantage(stat)`  | Бросок с Преимуществом (Легко)            |
128: | `roll_d20_disadvantage(stat)`| Бросок с Помехой (Хардкор)              |
129: | `update_player_hp(id, delta)`| Атомарное обновление HP                  |
130: | `add_item_to_inventory(...)` | Безопасное добавление предмета (стаки)    |
131: | `remove_item_from_inventory(...)`| Безопасное удаление предмета         |
132: 
133: ## Ключевые механики
134: 
135: - **PvP** — тумблер в настройках сессии
136: - **Динамический сюжет** — выбор Акта или режим «Песочница»
137: - **Фантомные предметы** — если предмета нет в инвентаре, ИИ отыгрывает конфуз
138: - **Race Conditions** — SQL-транзакции с `FOR UPDATE` блокировками
139: - **Экспорт/Импорт** — миров и персонажей через JSON-файлы
140: - **PWA** — офлайн-кэширование, установка на рабочий стол
141: 
142: ## Импорт/Экспорт
143: 
144: ### Мир
145: - Экспорт: скачать entire worlds + lore_files в JSON
146: - Импорт: загрузить JSON → создаётся новый мир + все файлы лора
147: 
148: ### Персонаж
149: - Экспорт: персонаж отвязан от сессии, сохраняется полностью
150: - Импорт: в новой сессии может потребоваться корректировка расы/класса
151: 
152: ## Лицензия
153: 
154: MIT License
