 5:   build: {
 6:     outDir: 'dist',
 7:     assetsDir: 'assets',
 8:   },
 9:   server: {
10:     port: 3000,
11:   },
12: });

================
File: src/utils/dice.js
================
  1: // src/utils/dice.js
  2: // Утилита для бросков кубиков в стиле D&D
  3: 
  4: /**
  5:  * Парсит строку кубиков формата "XdY+Z" или "XdY-Z"
  6:  * @param {string} diceStr - строка типа "1d6", "3d4+2", "2d8-1"
  7:  * @returns {object} { count, sides, bonus, raw }
  8:  */
  9: export function parseDice(diceStr) {
 10:   if (!diceStr || typeof diceStr !== 'string') {
 11:     return { count: 1, sides: 6, bonus: 0, raw: '1d6' };
 12:   }
 13:   
 14:   const cleaned = diceStr.toString().toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, '');
 15:   const match = cleaned.match(/^(\d+)d(\d+)([+-]\d+)?$/);
 16:   
 17:   if (!match) {
 18:     // Пробуем распознать просто число
 19:     const num = parseInt(cleaned, 10);
 20:     if (!isNaN(num)) {
 21:       return { count: 0, sides: 0, bonus: num, raw: cleaned };
 22:     }
 23:     return { count: 1, sides: 6, bonus: 0, raw: '1d6' };
 24:   }
 25:   
 26:   return {
 27:     count: parseInt(match[1], 10),
 28:     sides: parseInt(match[2], 10),
 29:     bonus: match[3] ? parseInt(match[3], 10) : 0,
 30:     raw: cleaned,
 31:   };
 32: }
 33: 
 34: /**
 35:  * Бросает один кубик
 36:  * @param {number} sides - количество граней
 37:  * @returns {number} результат броска
 38:  */
 39: export function rollDie(sides) {
 40:   return Math.floor(Math.random() * sides) + 1;
 41: }
 42: 
 43: /**
 44:  * Бросает кубики по строке формата "XdY+Z"
 45:  * @param {string} diceStr - строка типа "1d6", "3d4+2"
 46:  * @returns {object} { total, rolls, bonus, raw }
 47:  */
 48: export function rollDice(diceStr) {
 49:   const { count, sides, bonus, raw } = parseDice(diceStr);
 50:   
 51:   if (count === 0) {
 52:     return { total: bonus, rolls: [], bonus, raw };
 53:   }
 54:   
 55:   const rolls = [];
 56:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 57:     rolls.push(rollDie(sides));
 58:   }
 59:   
 60:   const rollsTotal = rolls.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
 61:   
 62:   return {
 63:     total: rollsTotal + bonus,
 64:     rolls,
 65:     bonus,
 66:     raw,
 67:   };
 68: }
 69: 
 70: /**
 71:  * Бросает кубики и возвращает только число (для быстрого расчёта)
 72:  * @param {string} diceStr 
 73:  * @returns {number}
 74:  */
 75: export function rollDamage(diceStr) {
 76:   return rollDice(diceStr).total;
 77: }
 78: 
 79: /**
 80:  * Бросает  Initiative (1d20 + модификатор)
 81:  * @param {number} modifier - модификатор ловкости
 82:  * @returns {object} { total, roll, modifier }
 83:  */
 84: export function rollInitiative(modifier = 0) {
 85:   const roll = rollDie(20);
 86:   return {
 87:     total: roll + modifier,
 88:     roll,
 89:     modifier,
 90:   };
 91: }
 92: 
 93: /**
 94:  * Бросок спасброска (1d20 + модификатор)
 95:  * @param {number} modifier - модификатор способности
 96:  * @returns {object} { total, roll, modifier }
 97:  */
 98: export function rollSave(modifier = 0) {
 99:   const roll = rollDie(20);
100:   return {
101:     total: roll + modifier,
102:     roll,
103:     modifier,
104:   };
105: }
106: 
107: /**
108:  * Проверка попадания по КД
109:  * @param {number} attackBonus - бонус атаки
110:  * @param {number} targetAC - класс брони цели
111:  * @returns {object} { hit, roll, total, critical }
112:  */
113: export function rollAttack(attackBonus, targetAC) {
114:   const roll = rollDie(20);
115:   const isCritical = roll === 20;
116:   const isFumble = roll === 1;
117:   
118:   return {
119:     hit: isCritical || (!isFumble && roll + attackBonus >= targetAC),
120:     roll,
121:     total: roll + attackBonus,
122:     critical: isCritical,
123:     fumble: isFumble,
124:   };
125: }
126: 
127: /**
128:  * Рассчитывает средний урон от кубиков (для балансировки)
129:  * @param {string} diceStr 
130:  * @returns {number}
131:  */
132: export function getAverageDamage(diceStr) {
133:   const { count, sides, bonus } = parseDice(diceStr);
134:   if (count === 0) return bonus;
135:   return count * ((sides + 1) / 2) + bonus;
136: }
137: 
138: /**
139:  * Рассчитывает минимальный и максимальный урон
140:  * @param {string} diceStr 
141:  * @returns {object} { min, max }
142:  */
143: export function getDamageRange(diceStr) {
144:   const { count, sides, bonus } = parseDice(diceStr);
145:   return {
146:     min: count * 1 + bonus,
147:     max: count * sides + bonus,
148:   };
149: }
150: 
151: /**
152:  * Форматирует строку кубиков для отображения
153:  * @param {string} diceStr 
154:  * @returns {string}
155:  */
156: export function formatDice(diceStr) {
157:   const { count, sides, bonus } = parseDice(diceStr);
158:   if (count === 0) return bonus.toString();
159:   
160:   let result = `${count}d${sides}`;
161:   if (bonus > 0) result += `+${bonus}`;
162:   if (bonus < 0) result += `${bonus}`;
163:   
164:   return result;
165: }
166: 
167: /**
168:  * Генерирует строку кубиков на основе уровня и тира
169:  * @param {number} level - уровень существа
170:  * @param {number} tier - тир существа
171:  * @param {boolean} isSpecial - спецатака (больше урона)
172:  * @returns {string} строка типа "2d6+3"
173:  */
174: export function generateDamageDice(level, tier, isSpecial = false) {
175:   // Базовое количество кубиков от уровня
176:   // Level 1-10: 1 die, 11-20: 2 dice, 21-30: 3 dice, etc.
177:   const dieCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.ceil(level / 10)));
178:   
179:   // Грани кубика от тира
180:   // Tier 1: d4, Tier 2: d6, Tier 3: d8, Tier 4: d10, Tier 5: d12
181:   const dieSides = [4, 6, 8, 10, 12][tier - 1] || 6;
182:   
183:   // Бонус от уровня и тира
184:   const bonus = Math.floor(level / 5) + tier;
185:   
186:   // Сецатаки наносят больше урона
187:   const specialMultiplier = isSpecial ? 1.5 : 1;
188:   const finalCount = Math.max(1, Math.round(dieCount * specialMultiplier));
189:   
190:   return `${finalCount}d${dieSides}+${bonus}`;
191: }
192: 
193: /**
194:  * Все стандартные грани кубиков D&D
195:  */
196: export const DIE_TYPES = [4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 20, 100];

================
File: src/router.js
================
 1: // src/router.js — SPA-роутер с Hash-based routing (совместим с GitHub Pages)
 2: import { ROUTES } from './config.js';
 3: 
 4: class Router {
 5:   constructor() {
 6:     this.routes = [];
 7:     this.currentRoute = null;
 8:     this.onNavigate = null;
 9: 
10:     window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => this.resolve());
11:     document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
12:       const link = e.target.closest('a[href]');
13:       if (link) {
14:         const href = link.getAttribute('href');
15:         // Обрабатываем внутренние ссылки (начинаются с /)
16:         if (href && href.startsWith('/') && !href.startsWith('//')) {
17:           e.preventDefault();
18:           this.navigate(href);
19:         }
20:       }
21:     });
22:   }
23: 
24:   add(pattern, handler) {
25:     const paramNames = [];
26:     const regexStr = pattern.replace(/:(\w+)/g, (_, name) => {
27:       paramNames.push(name);
28:       return '([^/]+)';
29:     });
30:     this.routes.push({
31:       pattern,
32:       regex: new RegExp(`^${regexStr}$`),
33:       paramNames,
34:       handler,
35:     });
36:     return this;
37:   }
38: 
39:   // Извлекаем путь из hash: #/session/123 → /session/123
40:   _getPath() {
41:     const hash = window.location.hash.slice(1) || '/';
42:     return hash.split('?')[0]; // Убираем query string
43:   }
44: 
45:   resolve() {
46:     const path = this._getPath();
47: 
48:     for (const route of this.routes) {
49:       const match = path.match(route.regex);
50:       if (match) {
51:         const params = {};
52:         route.paramNames.forEach((name, i) => {
53:           params[name] = match[i + 1];
54:         });
55:         this.currentRoute = { pattern: route.pattern, params };
56:         route.handler(params);
57:         return;
58:       }
59:     }
60: 
61:     // Fallback to lobby
62:     this.navigate('/');
63:   }
64: 
65:   navigate(path) {
66:     const currentPath = this._getPath();
67:     if (currentPath === path) return;
68:     window.location.hash = '#' + path;
69:   }
70: }
71: 
72: export const router = new Router();

  1: // supabase/functions/generate-loot/index.ts
  2: // Генерация лута, построек или предметов через отдельную нейросеть
  3: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
  4: import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";

  9: const FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY = Deno.env.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY") || "";
 10: const AI_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.5";
 11: 
 12: const CORS = {
 13:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
 14:   "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-client-info, apikey",
 15:   "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",

 18: const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `Ты — генератор предметов и построений для текстовой RPG. Твоя задача — создать реалистичный, сбалансированный предмет/постройку/лут на основе контекста.
 19: 
 20: ПРАВИЛА:
 21: 1. Предмет должен соответствовать контексту (локация, сюжет, уровень, раса, класс).
 22: 2. Не создавай "Экскалибур в подвале", если это не указано в сюжете.
 23: 3. Учитывай характеристики игрока (STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA) для подбора редкости и параметров.
 24: 4. Баланс: обычные предметы → 1-2 параметра, редкие → 3-4 параметра, легендарные → только если явно указано в сюжете.
 25: 5. Оцени состояние предмета: new, used, damaged, broken.
 26: 6. Если контекст бедный — создай простой предмет подходящего уровня.
 27: 
 28: Формат ответа — ТОЛЬКО валидный JSON без markdown:
 29: {
 30:   "name": "Название",
 31:   "type": "weapon|armor|consumable|misc|building|material",
 32:   "rarity": "common|uncommon|rare|legendary",
 33:   "description": "Описание внешнего вида и истории",
 34:   "stats": {
 35:     "STR": 0,
 36:     "DEX": 0,
 37:     "CON": 0,
 38:     "INT": 0,
 39:     "WIS": 0,
 40:     "CHA": 0
 41:   },
 42:   "ac_bonus": 0,
 43:   "damage": "1d8",
 44:   "heal_amount": 0,
 45:   "value": 10,
 46:   "condition": "new|used|damaged|broken",
 47:   "durability": 100,
 48:   "requirements": {
 49:     "level": 1,
 50:     "stats": {}
 51:   },
 52:   "effects": ["Эффект 1", "Эффект 2"],
 53:   "world_hints": {
 54:     "location": "Таверна",
 55:     "theme": " medieval",
 56:     "plot_relevance": "низкая"
 57:   }
 58: }
 59: 
 60: ВСЁ на русском языке.`;
 61: 
 62: serve(async (req) => {
 63:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 64:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 65:   }
 66: 
 67:   try {
 68:     const raw = await req.text();
 69:     let parsed: any;
 70:     try {
 71:       parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
 72:     } catch {
 73:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Некорректный JSON в теле запроса" }), {
 74:         status: 400,
 75:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 76:       });
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     const user_id = cleanTextForAI(parsed.user_id);
 80:     const context = cleanTextForAI(parsed.context);
 81:     const recent_messages = Array.isArray(parsed.recent_messages) ? parsed.recent_messages.map((m: any) => cleanTextForAI(m)).join('\n') : '';
 82:     const plot_stage = cleanTextForAI(parsed.plot_stage);
 83:     const player_stats = parsed.player_stats || {};
 84:     const player_race = cleanTextForAI(parsed.player_race) || 'Человек';
 85:     const item_type = cleanTextForAI(parsed.item_type) || 'misc';
 86:     const rarity = cleanTextForAI(parsed.rarity) || 'common';
 87:     const location = cleanTextForAI(parsed.location) || 'Неизвестно';
 88:     const save_to_inventory = Boolean(parsed.save_to_inventory);
 89:     const player_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.player_id);
 90: 
 91:     console.log('generate-loot input:', { user_id, item_type, rarity, player_race, location, save_to_inventory });
 92: 
 93:     if (!user_id || !context) {
 94:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "user_id и context обязательны" }), {
 95:         status: 400,
 96:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 97:       });
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
101: 
102:     let apiKey = sanitizeKey(FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY);
103:     const { data: userSettings } = await supabase
104:       .from("user_settings")
105:       .select("openrouter_key")
106:       .eq("id", user_id)
107:       .maybeSingle();
108:     if (userSettings?.openrouter_key) apiKey = sanitizeKey(userSettings.openrouter_key);
109: 
110:     if (!apiKey) {
111:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
112:         error: "Укажите ваш OpenRouter API Key в настройках аккаунта.",
113:         code: "MISSING_API_KEY",
114:       }), { status: 402, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
115:     }
116: 
117:     const userMessage = `Контекст: ${context}\nЛокация: ${location}\n\n${recent_messages ? `Последние события:\n${recent_messages}\n\n` : ''}${plot_stage ? `Сюжет: ${plot_stage}\n\n` : ''}Игрок (${player_race}) имеет характеристики: ${JSON.stringify(player_stats)}.\n\nСоздай ${rarity === 'legendary' ? 'легендарный' : rarity === 'rare' ? 'редкий' : rarity === 'uncommon' ? 'необычный' : 'обычный'} предмет типа ${item_type}.`;
118: 
119:     const response = await fetch("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", {
120:       method: "POST",
121:       headers: {
122:         "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
123:         "Content-Type": "application/json",
124:         "HTTP-Referer": SUPABASE_URL,
125:         "X-Title": "MultiRP-AI",
126:       },
127:       body: JSON.stringify({
128:         model: AI_MODEL,
129:         messages: [
130:           { role: "system", content: SYSTEM_PROMPT },
131:           { role: "user", content: userMessage },
132:         ],
133:         temperature: 0.7,
134:         max_tokens: 1000,
135:       }),
136:       signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
137:     });
138: 
139:     console.log('generate-loot OpenRouter status:', response.status);
140: 
141:     if (!response.ok) {
142:       let errDetails = "";
143:       try {
144:         const errJson = await response.json();
145:         errDetails = errJson?.error?.message || errJson?.error || JSON.stringify(errJson);
146:       } catch {
147:         errDetails = await response.text();
148:       }
149:       console.error("AI API error:", errDetails);
150:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
151:         error: "Ошибка AI API",
152:         details: errDetails,
153:         status: response.status,
154:       }), {
155:         status: 502, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
156:       });
157:     }
158: 
159:     const data = await response.json();
160:     const rawContent = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || "";
161:     console.log('generate-loot AI raw:', rawContent);
162:     const item = parseAIJson(rawContent);
163: 
164:     if (!item) {
165:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Не удалось распарсить ответ ИИ", raw: rawContent || null }), {
166:         status: 422, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
167:       });
168:     }
169: 
170:     const normalizedItem = {
171:       name: cleanTextForAI(item.name),
172:       type: cleanTextForAI(item.type) || 'misc',
173:       rarity: cleanTextForAI(item.rarity) || 'common',
174:       description: cleanTextForAI(item.description),
175:       stats: item.stats || {},
176:       ac_bonus: Number(item.ac_bonus) || 0,
177:       damage: cleanTextForAI(item.damage) || '',
178:       heal_amount: Number(item.heal_amount) || 0,
179:       value: Number(item.value) || 10,
180:       condition: cleanTextForAI(item.condition) || 'new',
181:       durability: Number(item.durability) || 100,
182:       requirements: item.requirements || {},
183:       effects: Array.isArray(item.effects) ? item.effects.map((e: any) => cleanTextForAI(String(e))) : [],
184:       world_hints: item.world_hints || {},
185:     };
186: 
187:     let inventoryItem = null;
188:     if (save_to_inventory && player_id) {
189:       const { data: inventoryData, error: inventoryError } = await supabase
190:         .from("inventory")
191:         .insert({
192:           player_id,
193:           item_name: normalizedItem.name,
194:           type: normalizedItem.type,
195:           rarity: normalizedItem.rarity,
196:           description: normalizedItem.description,
197:           stats: normalizedItem.stats,
198:           ac_bonus: normalizedItem.ac_bonus,
199:           damage: normalizedItem.damage,
200:           heal_amount: normalizedItem.heal_amount,
201:           value: normalizedItem.value,
202:           condition: normalizedItem.condition,
203:           durability: normalizedItem.durability,
204:           requirements: normalizedItem.requirements,
205:           effects: normalizedItem.effects,
206:           quantity: 1,
207:         })
208:         .select()
209:         .single();
210: 
211:       if (inventoryError) {
212:         console.error('Failed to save item to inventory:', inventoryError);
213:       } else {
214:         inventoryItem = inventoryData;
215:       }
216:     }
217: 
218:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
219:       item: normalizedItem,
220:       inventory_item: inventoryItem,
221:       location,
222:     }), {
223:       status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
224:     });
225: 
226:   } catch (err) {
227:     console.error("generate-loot error:", err);
228:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
229:       error: err.message || "Internal error",
230:       details: err.message,
231:     }), {
232:       status: 500,
233:       headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
234:     });
235:   }
236: });

  1: // supabase/functions/npc-memory-engine/index.ts
  2: // Движок Каскадной Памяти NPC: управление воспоминаниями (vivid -> medium -> belief)

 13: const OPENROUTER_EMBEDDINGS_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/embeddings";

 17:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",

 29: async function generateEmbedding(text: string, apiKey: string): Promise<number[]> {
 30:   const response = await fetch(OPENROUTER_EMBEDDINGS_URL, {
 31:     method: "POST",
 32:     headers: {
 33:       "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
 34:       "Content-Type": "application/json",
 35:       "HTTP-Referer": SUPABASE_URL,
 36:       "X-Title": "MultiRP-AI",
 37:     },
 38:     body: JSON.stringify({
 39:       model: EMBEDDING_MODEL,
 40:       input: text,
 41:     }),
 42:     signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30000),
 43:   });
 44: 
 45:   if (!response.ok) {
 46:     const errText = await response.text();
 47:     throw new Error(`Embedding API error: ${response.status} - ${errText}`);
 48:   }
 49: 
 50:   const data = await response.json();
 51:   return data.data[0].embedding;
 52: }
 53: 
 54: async function callChatLLM(systemPrompt: string, userMessage: string, apiKey: string): Promise<string> {
 55:   const response = await fetch(OPENROUTER_CHAT_URL, {
 56:     method: "POST",
 57:     headers: {
 58:       "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
 59:       "Content-Type": "application/json",
 60:       "HTTP-Referer": SUPABASE_URL,
 61:       "X-Title": "MultiRP-AI",
 62:     },
 63:     body: JSON.stringify({
 64:       model: CHAT_MODEL,
 65:       messages: [
 66:         { role: "system", content: systemPrompt },
 67:         { role: "user", content: userMessage },
 68:       ],
 69:       temperature: 0.7,
 70:       max_tokens: 1000,
 71:     }),
 72:     signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
 73:   });
 74: 
 75:   if (!response.ok) {
 76:     const errText = await response.text();
 77:     throw new Error(`Chat API error: ${response.status} - ${errText}`);
 78:   }
 79: 
 80:   const data = await response.json();
 81:   return data.choices[0].message.content;
 82: }

 85: // Основной обработчик

 87: 
 88: serve(async (req) => {
 89:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 90:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 91:   }
 92: 
 93:   try {
 94:     const raw = await req.text();
 95:     let parsed: any;
 96:     try {
 97:       parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
 98:     } catch {
 99:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Некорректный JSON в теле запроса" }), {
100:         status: 400,
101:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
102:       });
103:     }
104: 
105:     const npc_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.npc_id);
106:     const player_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.player_id);
107:     const memory_text = cleanTextForAI(parsed.memory_text);
108: 
109:     console.log(`\n[npc-memory-engine] ═══════════════════════════════════════════════`);
110:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🧠 NPC MEMORY ENGINE START`);
111:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] ═══════════════════════════════════════════════`);
112:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 📥 INPUT:`);
113:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine]    • npc_id: ${npc_id}`);
114:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine]    • player_id: ${player_id}`);
115:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine]    • memory_text: "${memory_text.slice(0, 80)}${memory_text.length > 80 ? '...' : ''}"`);
116: 
117:     if (!npc_id || !player_id || !memory_text) {
118:       console.error(`[npc-memory-engine] ❌ Missing required fields`);
119:       return new Response(
120:         JSON.stringify({ error: "npc_id, player_id и memory_text обязательны" }),
121:         { status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
122:       );
123:     }
124: 
125:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
126: 
127:     // Получаем API ключ
128:     let apiKey = sanitizeKey(FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY);
129:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🔑 Fallback key available: ${apiKey ? 'YES' : 'NO'}`);
130: 
131:     // Получаем player для нахождения user_id
132:     const { data: player } = await supabase
133:       .from("players")
134:       .select("user_id")
135:       .eq("id", player_id)
136:       .maybeSingle();
137: 
138:     if (player?.user_id) {
139:       const { data: userSettings } = await supabase
140:         .from("user_settings")
141:         .select("openrouter_key")
142:         .eq("id", player.user_id)
143:         .maybeSingle();
144:       if (userSettings?.openrouter_key) {
145:         apiKey = sanitizeKey(userSettings.openrouter_key);
146:         console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🔑 Using user key from settings`);
147:       }
148:     }
149: 
150:     if (!apiKey) {
151:       console.error(`[npc-memory-engine] ❌ No API key available`);
152:       return new Response(
153:         JSON.stringify({
154:           error: "Укажите ваш OpenRouter API Key в настройках аккаунта.",
155:           code: "MISSING_API_KEY",
156:         }),
157:         { status: 402, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
158:       );
159:     }
160: 
161:     // ============================================
162:     // Задача 1: Векторизация и сохранение (Яркая память)
163:     // ============================================
164:     console.log(`\n[npc-memory-engine] 📝 STEP 1: Generating embedding...`);
165:     let embedding: number[];
166:     try {
167:       embedding = await generateEmbedding(memory_text, apiKey);
168:       console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 📝 Embedding generated (${embedding.length} dims)`);
169:     } catch (err) {
170:       console.error(`[npc-memory-engine] ❌ Embedding generation failed:`, err);
171:       return new Response(
172:         JSON.stringify({ error: "Ошибка генерации эмбеддинга", details: err.message }),
173:         { status: 502, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
174:       );
175:     }
176: 
177:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 📝 Saving vivid memory to DB...`);
178:     const { error: insertError } = await supabase.from("npc_memories").insert({
179:       npc_id,
180:       player_id,
181:       memory_text,
182:       memory_type: "vivid",
183:       embedding,
184:     });
185: 
186:     if (insertError) {
187:       console.error(`[npc-memory-engine] ❌ Failed to insert vivid memory:`, insertError);
188:       return new Response(
189:         JSON.stringify({ error: "Ошибка сохранения воспоминания", details: insertError.message }),
190:         { status: 500, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
191:       );
192:     }
193: 
194:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] ✅ Vivid memory saved for npc: ${npc_id}`);
195: 
196:     // ============================================
197:     // Задача 2: Логика каскада "Смещение 5-5-5"
198:     // ============================================
199:     console.log(`\n[npc-memory-engine] 🔄 STEP 2: Checking cascade logic...`);
200: 
201:     let newBeliefCreated = false;
202:     let newBeliefText: string | null = null;
203: 
204:     // 2.1 Проверяем количество vivid воспоминаний
205:     const { count: vividCount, error: vividCountErr } = await supabase
206:       .from("npc_memories")
207:       .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true })
208:       .eq("npc_id", npc_id)
209:       .eq("player_id", player_id)
210:       .eq("memory_type", "vivid");
211: 
212:     if (vividCountErr) {
213:       console.error(`[npc-memory-engine] ❌ Failed to count vivid memories:`, vividCountErr);
214:     }
215: 
216:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 📊 Vivid count: ${vividCount ?? 0} (limit: ${CASCADE_LIMIT})`);
217: 
218:     // Если vivid > 5 → перемещаем самую старую в medium
219:     if ((vividCount ?? 0) > CASCADE_LIMIT) {
220:       console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🔄 Vivid limit exceeded, moving oldest to medium...`);
221:       const { data: oldestVivid } = await supabase
222:         .from("npc_memories")
223:         .select("id")
224:         .eq("npc_id", npc_id)
225:         .eq("player_id", player_id)
226:         .eq("memory_type", "vivid")
227:         .order("created_at", { ascending: true })
228:         .limit(1)
229:         .single();
230: 
231:       if (oldestVivid) {
232:         const { error: updateError } = await supabase
233:           .from("npc_memories")
234:           .update({ memory_type: "medium" })
235:           .eq("id", oldestVivid.id);
236: 
237:         if (updateError) {
238:           console.error(`[npc-memory-engine] ❌ Failed to update vivid to medium:`, updateError);
239:         } else {
240:           console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] ✅ Moved oldest vivid to medium: ${oldestVivid.id}`);
241:         }
242:       }
243:     }
244: 
245:     // 2.2 Проверяем количество medium воспоминаний
246:     const { count: mediumCount, error: mediumCountErr } = await supabase
247:       .from("npc_memories")
248:       .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true })
249:       .eq("npc_id", npc_id)
250:       .eq("player_id", player_id)
251:       .eq("memory_type", "medium");
252: 
253:     if (mediumCountErr) {
254:       console.error(`[npc-memory-engine] ❌ Failed to count medium memories:`, mediumCountErr);
255:     }
256: 
257:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 📊 Medium count: ${mediumCount ?? 0} (limit: ${CASCADE_LIMIT})`);
258: 
259:     // Если medium > 5 → сжимаем 6 в 1 belief
260:     if ((mediumCount ?? 0) > CASCADE_LIMIT) {
261:       console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🔄 Medium limit exceeded, compressing to belief...`);
262:       // Извлекаем текст всех 6 medium записей
263:       const { data: mediumMemories } = await supabase
264:         .from("npc_memories")
265:         .select("id, memory_text")
266:         .eq("npc_id", npc_id)
267:         .eq("player_id", player_id)
268:         .eq("memory_type", "medium")
269:         .order("created_at", { ascending: true })
270:         .limit(6);
271: 
272:       if (mediumMemories && mediumMemories.length === 6) {
273:         const memoriesText = mediumMemories.map((m, i) => `${i + 1}. ${m.memory_text}`).join("\n");
274: 
275:         console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🤖 Calling LLM to compress 6 memories into belief...`);
276:         const compressionPrompt = `Ты психолог. Прочитай 6 воспоминаний NPC об игроке. Объедини их смысл в 1 короткое фундаментальное Убеждение (Belief) NPC об этом игроке. Верни строго 1 предложение без списков и вступлений.`;
277: 
278:         try {
279:           const beliefText = await callChatLLM(compressionPrompt, memoriesText, apiKey);
280:           const cleanBelief = beliefText.trim();
281:           console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🤖 Generated belief: "${cleanBelief}"`);
282: 
283:           // Удаляем 6 старых medium записей
284:           const idsToDelete = mediumMemories.map((m) => m.id);
285:           await supabase
286:             .from("npc_memories")
287:             .delete()
288:             .in("id", idsToDelete);
289:           console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🗑️ Deleted 6 medium memories`);
290: 
291:           // Генерируем вектор для нового убеждения
292:           console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 📝 Generating embedding for belief...`);
293:           const beliefEmbedding = await generateEmbedding(cleanBelief, apiKey);
294: 
295:           // Сохраняем belief
296:           await supabase.from("npc_memories").insert({
297:             npc_id,
298:             player_id,
299:             memory_text: cleanBelief,
300:             memory_type: "belief",
301:             embedding: beliefEmbedding,
302:           });
303: 
304:           newBeliefCreated = true;
305:           newBeliefText = cleanBelief;
306:           console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] ✅ New belief saved`);
307:         } catch (err) {
308:           console.error(`[npc-memory-engine] ❌ Failed to compress medium to belief:`, err);
309:         }
310:       }
311:     }
312: 
313:     // 2.3 Проверяем количество belief воспоминаний
314:     const { count: beliefCount, error: beliefCountErr } = await supabase
315:       .from("npc_memories")
316:       .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true })
317:       .eq("npc_id", npc_id)
318:       .eq("player_id", player_id)
319:       .eq("memory_type", "belief");
320: 
321:     if (beliefCountErr) {
322:       console.error(`[npc-memory-engine] ❌ Failed to count belief memories:`, beliefCountErr);
323:     }
324: 
325:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 📊 Belief count: ${beliefCount ?? 0} (limit: ${CASCADE_LIMIT})`);
326: 
327:     // Если belief > 5 → удаляем самое старое
328:     if ((beliefCount ?? 0) > CASCADE_LIMIT) {
329:       console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🔄 Belief limit exceeded, removing oldest...`);
330:       const { data: oldestBelief } = await supabase
331:         .from("npc_memories")
332:         .select("id")
333:         .eq("npc_id", npc_id)
334:         .eq("player_id", player_id)
335:         .eq("memory_type", "belief")
336:         .order("created_at", { ascending: true })
337:         .limit(1)
338:         .single();
339: 
340:       if (oldestBelief) {
341:         await supabase
342:           .from("npc_memories")
343:           .delete()
344:           .eq("id", oldestBelief.id);
345:         console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🗑️ Deleted oldest belief: ${oldestBelief.id}`);
346:       }
347:     }
348: 
349:     // ============================================
350:     // Задача 3: Обновление Статуса (status_tags)
351:     // ============================================
352:     if (newBeliefCreated && newBeliefText) {
353:       console.log(`\n[npc-memory-engine] 🏷️ STEP 3: Updating NPC status tags...`);
354:       // Получаем текущие status_tags NPC
355:       const { data: npcData } = await supabase
356:         .from("npcs")
357:         .select("status_tags")
358:         .eq("id", npc_id)
359:         .single();
360: 
361:       const currentTags = npcData?.status_tags ?? [];
362:       console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🏷️ Current tags: ${JSON.stringify(currentTags)}`);
363: 
364:       const statusPrompt = `Учитывая новое убеждение NPC об игроке, обнови его статус отношения. Верни массив из 1-3 коротких тегов в формате JSON: { "tags": ["друг", "наставник"] }. Допустимые примеры: Враг, Должник, Предатель, Раб, Любовь, Страх. Не пиши текст, только JSON.`;
365: 
366:       try {
367:         const tagsResponse = await callChatLLM(
368:           statusPrompt,
369:           `Текущие теги: ${JSON.stringify(currentTags)}\nНовое убеждение: ${newBeliefText}`,
370:           apiKey,
371:         );
372: 
373:         console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] 🏷️ LLM response: ${tagsResponse}`);
374: 
375:         // Парсим JSON ответ
376:         const parsed = JSON.parse(tagsResponse);
377:         if (parsed.tags && Array.isArray(parsed.tags)) {
378:           await supabase
379:             .from("npcs")
380:             .update({ status_tags: parsed.tags })
381:             .eq("id", npc_id);
382:           console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] ✅ Updated NPC status_tags: ${JSON.stringify(parsed.tags)}`);
383:         }
384:       } catch (err) {
385:         console.error(`[npc-memory-engine] ❌ Failed to update status_tags:`, err);
386:       }
387:     }
388: 
389:     console.log(`\n[npc-memory-engine] ✅ NPC MEMORY ENGINE COMPLETE`);
390:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine]    • New belief created: ${newBeliefCreated}`);
391:     console.log(`[npc-memory-engine] ═══════════════════════════════════════════════\n`);
392: 
393:     return new Response(
394:       JSON.stringify({
395:         success: true,
396:         message: "Memory processed successfully",
397:         new_belief_created: newBeliefCreated,
398:         new_belief_text: newBeliefText,
399:       }),
400:       { status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
401:     );
402:   } catch (err) {
403:     console.error("npc-memory-engine error:", err);
404:     return new Response(
405:       JSON.stringify({
406:         error: err.message || "Internal error",
407:         details: err.message,
408:       }),
409:       { status: 500, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
410:     );
411:   }
412: });

================
File: supabase/functions/simulate-npc-background/index.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/simulate-npc-background/index.ts
  2: // Фоновая автономность NPC: действия главных персонажей за кадром
  3: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
  4: import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";
  5: import { sanitizeKey, cleanTextForAI, parseAIJson } from "../_shared/utils.ts";
  6: 
  7: const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
  8: const SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
  9: const FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY = Deno.env.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY") || "";
 10: const AI_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.5";
 11: const OPENROUTER_CHAT_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions";
 12: 
 13: const CORS = {
 14:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
 15:   "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-client-info, apikey",
 16:   "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
 17: };
 18: 
 19: const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `Прошло дней: [days_passed]. Опиши 1 предложением, что NPC сделал за кадром (на основе его background и habits). Если он нашел или создал предмет, укажи его. JSON: { action_summary: 'текст', obtained_item_name: 'Название или null', item_type: 'weapon|misc' }`;
 20: 
 21: async function callChatLLM(systemPrompt: string, userMessage: string, apiKey: string): Promise<string> {
 22:   const response = await fetch(OPENROUTER_CHAT_URL, {
 23:     method: "POST",
 24:     headers: {
 25:       "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
 26:       "Content-Type": "application/json",
 27:       "HTTP-Referer": SUPABASE_URL,
 28:       "X-Title": "MultiRP-AI",
 29:     },
 30:     body: JSON.stringify({
 31:       model: AI_MODEL,
 32:       messages: [
 33:         { role: "system", content: systemPrompt },
 34:         { role: "user", content: userMessage },
 35:       ],
 36:       temperature: 0.7,
 37:       max_tokens: 1000,
 38:     }),
 39:     signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
 40:   });
 41: 
 42:   if (!response.ok) {
 43:     const errText = await response.text();
 44:     throw new Error(`Chat API error: ${response.status} - ${errText}`);
 45:   }
 46: 
 47:   const data = await response.json();
 48:   return data.choices[0].message.content;
 49: }
 50: 
 51: serve(async (req) => {
 52:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 53:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 54:   }
 55: 
 56:   try {
 57:     const raw = await req.text();
 58:     let parsed: any;
 59:     try {
 60:       parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
 61:     } catch {
 62:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Некорректный JSON в теле запроса" }), {
 63:         status: 400,
 64:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 65:       });
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     const session_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.session_id);
 69:     const days_passed = Number(parsed.days_passed) || 1;
 70:     const user_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.user_id);
 71: 
 72:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] ═══════════════════════════════════════════════`);
 73:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🎭 NPC BACKGROUND SIMULATION START`);
 74:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] ═══════════════════════════════════════════════`);
 75:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 📥 INPUT:`);
 76:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background]    • session_id: ${session_id}`);
 77:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background]    • days_passed: ${days_passed}`);
 78:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background]    • user_id: ${user_id}`);
 79: 
 80:     if (!session_id) {
 81:       console.error(`[simulate-npc-background] ❌ Missing session_id`);
 82:       return new Response(
 83:         JSON.stringify({ error: "session_id обязателен" }),
 84:         { status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
 85:       );
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
 89: 
 90:     // Получаем мир сессии
 91:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] 📊 Loading session...`);
 92:     const { data: session } = await supabase
 93:       .from("sessions")
 94:       .select("world_id")
 95:       .eq("id", session_id)
 96:       .single();
 97: 
 98:     if (!session) {
 99:       console.error(`[simulate-npc-background] ❌ Session not found`);
100:       return new Response(
101:         JSON.stringify({ error: "Сессия не найдена" }),
102:         { status: 404, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
103:       );
104:     }
105: 
106:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🌍 World ID: ${session.world_id}`);
107: 
108:     // Получаем главных NPC мира
109:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] 🐉 Loading main NPCs...`);
110:     const { data: mainNpcs } = await supabase
111:       .from("npcs")
112:       .select("*")
113:       .eq("world_id", session.world_id)
114:       .eq("role", "main");
115: 
116:     if (!mainNpcs || mainNpcs.length === 0) {
117:       console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] ⚠️ No main NPCs found, returning empty result`);
118:       return new Response(
119:         JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: "Нет главных NPC для симуляции", actions: [] }),
120:         { status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
121:       );
122:     }
123: 
124:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🐉 Found ${mainNpcs.length} main NPCs:`);
125:     for (const npc of mainNpcs) {
126:       console.log(`[simulate-npc-background]    • ${npc.name} (${npc.race})`);
127:     }
128: 
129:     // Получаем API ключ
130:     let apiKey = sanitizeKey(FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY);
131:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] 🔑 Fallback key available: ${apiKey ? 'YES' : 'NO'}`);
132:     if (user_id) {
133:       const { data: userSettings } = await supabase
134:         .from("user_settings")
135:         .select("openrouter_key")
136:         .eq("id", user_id)
137:         .maybeSingle();
138:       if (userSettings?.openrouter_key) {
139:         apiKey = sanitizeKey(userSettings.openrouter_key);
140:         console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🔑 Using user key from settings`);
141:       }
142:     }
143: 
144:     if (!apiKey) {
145:       console.error(`[simulate-npc-background] ❌ No API key available`);
146:       return new Response(
147:         JSON.stringify({
148:           error: "Укажите ваш OpenRouter API Key в настройках аккаунта.",
149:           code: "MISSING_API_KEY",
150:         }),
151:         { status: 402, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
152:       );
153:     }
154: 
155:     const actions: any[] = [];
156: 
157:     // Симулируем каждого главного NPC
158:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] 🎭 Simulating ${mainNpcs.length} NPCs for ${days_passed} days...`);
159:     for (const npc of mainNpcs) {
160:       console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] 🎭 Simulating: ${npc.name}`);
161:       const userMessage = `NPC: ${npc.name}
162: Раса: ${npc.race}
163: Предыстория: ${npc.background || "Неизвестно"}
164: Привычки: ${(npc.habits || []).join(", ") || "Неизвестно"}
165: Прошло дней: ${days_passed}`;
166: 
167:       try {
168:         const aiResponse = await callChatLLM(SYSTEM_PROMPT.replace("[days_passed]", String(days_passed)), userMessage, apiKey);
169:         console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🤖 AI response: ${aiResponse.slice(0, 100)}...`);
170: 
171:         const actionData = parseAIJson(aiResponse);
172: 
173:         if (actionData) {
174:           const action = {
175:             npc_id: npc.id,
176:             npc_name: npc.name,
177:             action_summary: actionData.action_summary || "",
178:             obtained_item_name: actionData.obtained_item_name || null,
179:             item_type: actionData.item_type || "misc",
180:           };
181: 
182:           // Если NPC получил предмет - добавляем в инвентарь
183:           if (actionData.obtained_item_name) {
184:             console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🎒 NPC ${npc.name} obtained item: ${actionData.obtained_item_name} (${actionData.item_type})`);
185:             const { error: itemError } = await supabase.rpc("add_item_to_inventory", {
186:               p_npc_id: npc.id,
187:               p_item_name: cleanTextForAI(actionData.obtained_item_name),
188:               p_quantity: 1,
189:               p_type: ["weapon", "armor", "consumable", "misc"].includes(actionData.item_type) ? actionData.item_type : "misc",
190:               p_attributes: {},
191:             });
192: 
193:             if (itemError) {
194:               console.error(`[simulate-npc-background] ❌ Failed to add item to NPC ${npc.id} inventory:`, itemError);
195:             } else {
196:               console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] ✅ Item added to NPC inventory`);
197:             }
198:           } else {
199:             console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 📝 No item obtained`);
200:           }
201: 
202:           actions.push(action);
203:           console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] ✅ Action: ${actionData.action_summary}`);
204:         }
205:       } catch (err) {
206:         console.error(`[simulate-npc-background] ❌ Failed to simulate NPC ${npc.id}:`, err);
207:       }
208:     }
209: 
210:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] ✅ NPC BACKGROUND SIMULATION COMPLETE`);
211:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background]    • Actions generated: ${actions.length}`);
212:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] ═══════════════════════════════════════════════\n`);
213: 
214:     return new Response(
215:       JSON.stringify({
216:         success: true,
217:         days_passed,
218:         actions_count: actions.length,
219:         actions,
220:       }),
221:       { status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
222:     );
223:   } catch (err) {
224:     console.error("simulate-npc-background error:", err);
225:     return new Response(
226:       JSON.stringify({
227:         error: err.message || "Internal error",
228:         details: err.message,
229:       }),
230:       { status: 500, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
231:     );
232:   }
233: });

================
File: supabase/migrations/002_user_settings.sql
================
 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 002: User Settings
 3: -- ============================================
 4: 
 5: -- Таблица настроек пользователя (API-ключи и пр.)
 6: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_settings (
 7:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 8:   openrouter_key TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
 9:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
10:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
11: );
12: 
13: -- Drop existing policies to allow re-running
14: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "UserSettings: owner read" ON user_settings;
15: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "UserSettings: owner insert" ON user_settings;
16: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "UserSettings: owner update" ON user_settings;
17: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "UserSettings: service read" ON user_settings;
18: 
19: -- RLS: пользователь видит и редактирует ТОЛЬКО свою строку
20: ALTER TABLE user_settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
21: 
22: CREATE POLICY "UserSettings: owner read"
23:   ON user_settings FOR SELECT
24:   USING (auth.uid() = id);
25: 
26: CREATE POLICY "UserSettings: owner insert"
27:   ON user_settings FOR INSERT
28:   WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id);
29: 
30: CREATE POLICY "UserSettings: owner update"
31:   ON user_settings FOR UPDATE
32:   USING (auth.uid() = id);
33: 
34: -- Service role (Edge Functions) может читать настройки любого пользователя
35: CREATE POLICY "UserSettings: service read"
36:   ON user_settings FOR SELECT
37:   USING (true);
38: 
39: -- Drop existing trigger to allow re-running
40: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trigger_user_settings_updated_at ON user_settings;
41: 
42: -- Триггер auto-updated_at
43: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_user_settings_updated_at
44:   BEFORE UPDATE ON user_settings
45:   FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
46: 
47: -- ============================================
48: -- RPC: Upsert настроек пользователя
49: -- ============================================
50: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION upsert_user_settings(
51:   p_user_id UUID,
52:   p_openrouter_key TEXT DEFAULT NULL
53: )
54: RETURNS UUID
55: LANGUAGE plpgsql
56: SECURITY DEFINER
57: AS $$
58: DECLARE
59:   existing_id UUID;
60: BEGIN
61:   SELECT id INTO existing_id FROM user_settings WHERE id = p_user_id;
62: 
63:   IF existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN
64:     UPDATE user_settings
65:     SET openrouter_key = COALESCE(p_openrouter_key, openrouter_key),
66:         updated_at = NOW()
67:     WHERE id = p_user_id;
68:     RETURN existing_id;
69:   ELSE
70:     INSERT INTO user_settings (id, openrouter_key)
71:     VALUES (p_user_id, p_openrouter_key);
72:     RETURN p_user_id;
73:   END IF;
74: END;
75: $$;
76: 
77: -- ============================================
78: -- RPC: Получить ключ пользователя (для Edge Functions)
79: -- ============================================
80: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_openrouter_key(p_user_id UUID)
81: RETURNS TEXT
82: LANGUAGE plpgsql
83: SECURITY DEFINER
84: AS $$
85: DECLARE
86:   v_key TEXT;
87: BEGIN
88:   SELECT openrouter_key INTO v_key
89:   FROM user_settings
90:   WHERE id = p_user_id;
91: 
92:   RETURN v_key;
93: END;
94: $$;

 1: -- ============================================

 4: -- ============================================

 6: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS character_cards (

 9:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
10:   race TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Человек',
11:   class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Воин',
12:   appearance TEXT DEFAULT '',
13:   personality JSONB DEFAULT '{"ideals": [], "bonds": [], "flaws": []}',
14:   bio TEXT DEFAULT '',
15:   power_level INT DEFAULT 10 CHECK (power_level >= 1 AND power_level <= 100),
16:   stats JSONB DEFAULT '{"STR": 10, "DEX": 10, "CON": 10, "INT": 10, "WIS": 10, "CHA": 10}',
17:   hp INT DEFAULT 30,
18:   max_hp INT DEFAULT 30,
19:   money INT DEFAULT 50,
20:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
21:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
22: );
23: 
24: -- Drop existing policies to allow re-running
25: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "CharCards: owner read" ON character_cards;
26: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "CharCards: owner insert" ON character_cards;
27: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "CharCards: owner update" ON character_cards;
28: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "CharCards: owner delete" ON character_cards;
29:

31: 
32: ALTER TABLE character_cards ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
33: 
34: CREATE POLICY "CharCards: owner read" ON character_cards
35:   FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = owner_id);
36: 
37: CREATE POLICY "CharCards: owner insert" ON character_cards
38:   FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = owner_id);
39: 
40: CREATE POLICY "CharCards: owner update" ON character_cards
41:   FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = owner_id);
42: 
43: CREATE POLICY "CharCards: owner delete" ON character_cards
44:   FOR DELETE USING (auth.uid() = owner_id);
45: 
46: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trigger_character_cards_updated_at ON character_cards;
47: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_character_cards_updated_at
48:   BEFORE UPDATE ON character_cards

File: supabase/migrations/005_injuries_and_rest.sql
================
 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 005: Injuries and rest
 3: -- Травмы, дебаффы и отслеживание отдыха
 4: -- ============================================
 5: 
 6: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_injuries (
 7:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 8:   player_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 9:   session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
10:   injury_type TEXT NOT NULL,
11:   severity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'minor',
12:   description TEXT DEFAULT '',
13:   stat_penalties JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
14:   hp_penalty INT DEFAULT 0,
15:   duration_hours INT DEFAULT 0,
16:   is_permanent BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
17:   cured_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
18:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
19: );
20: 
21: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_injuries_player ON player_injuries(player_id);
22: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_injuries_session ON player_injuries(session_id);
23: 
24: ALTER TABLE player_injuries ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
25: 
26: -- Drop existing policies to allow re-running
27: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Injuries: session players read" ON player_injuries;
28: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Injuries: system insert" ON player_injuries;
29: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Injuries: system update" ON player_injuries;
30: 
31: CREATE POLICY "Injuries: session players read" ON player_injuries
32:   FOR SELECT USING (
33:     EXISTS (
34:       SELECT 1 FROM players p
35:       WHERE p.id = player_injuries.player_id
36:         AND p.session_id = player_injuries.session_id
37:     )
38:   );
39: 
40: CREATE POLICY "Injuries: system insert" ON player_injuries
41:   FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (false);
42: 
43: CREATE POLICY "Injuries: system update" ON player_injuries
44:   FOR UPDATE USING (false);
45: 
46: ALTER TABLE players
47:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS active_injuries JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
48:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rest_penalty_hours INT DEFAULT 0;

File: supabase/migrations/006_world_geography_and_npcs.sql
================
  1: -- ============================================
  2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 006: World Geography & NPC Matrix
  3: -- География мира (государства, локации, маршруты) и Матрица NPC с векторной памятью (RAG)
  4: -- ============================================
  5: 
  6: -- Задача 1: Активация pgvector
  7: -- Критично для работы RAG-системы с векторными эмбеддингами
  8: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
  9: 
 10: -- ============================================
 11: -- Задача 2 & 3: География и Матрица NPC
 12: -- Создаём таблицы без циклических FK, затем добавляем FK через ALTER TABLE
 13: -- ============================================
 14: 
 15: -- Государства (без ruler_id — добавим позже)
 16: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS states (
 17:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 18:   world_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 19:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
 20:   description TEXT DEFAULT '',
 21:   ruler_id UUID,
 22:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 23:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 24: );
 25: 
 26: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_states_world ON states(world_id);
 27: 
 28: -- Локации (города, деревни, руины, достопримечательности)
 29: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (
 30:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 31:   state_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES states(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 32:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
 33:   type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'city' CHECK (type IN ('capital', 'city', 'village', 'ruins', 'landmark')),
 34:   description TEXT DEFAULT '',
 35:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 36:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 37: );
 38: 
 39: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_locations_state ON locations(state_id);
 40: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_locations_type ON locations(type);
 41: 
 42: -- Маршруты (дороги/связи между локациями)
 43: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS routes (
 44:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 45:   location_a_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 46:   location_b_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 47:   distance_km INT DEFAULT 0 CHECK (distance_km >= 0),
 48:   travel_days INT DEFAULT 0 CHECK (travel_days >= 0),
 49:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 50: );
 51: 
 52: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_routes_location_a ON routes(location_a_id);
 53: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_routes_location_b ON routes(location_b_id);
 54: 
 55: -- Добавляем ограничения после создания таблицы для идемпотентности
 56: ALTER TABLE routes
 57:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS routes_no_duplicates,
 58:   ADD CONSTRAINT routes_no_duplicates CHECK (location_a_id < location_b_id);
 59: 
 60: ALTER TABLE routes
 61:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS routes_different_locations,
 62:   ADD CONSTRAINT routes_different_locations CHECK (location_a_id != location_b_id);
 63: 
 64: -- Матрица NPC (без location_id и state_id — добавим позже)
 65: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS npcs (
 66:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 67:   world_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 68:   location_id UUID,
 69:   state_id UUID,
 70:   -- Лор
 71:   role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'secondary' CHECK (role IN ('main', 'secondary')),
 72:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
 73:   race TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Человек',
 74:   appearance TEXT DEFAULT '',
 75:   background TEXT DEFAULT '',
 76:   status_tags TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
 77:   habits TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
 78:   catchphrases TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
 79:   -- Механика
 80:   stats JSONB DEFAULT '{"STR": 10, "DEX": 10, "CON": 10, "INT": 10, "WIS": 10, "CHA": 10}',
 81:   hp INT DEFAULT 30,
 82:   max_hp INT DEFAULT 30,
 83:   -- Системные
 84:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 85:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 86: );
 87: 
 88: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_world ON npcs(world_id);
 89: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_location ON npcs(location_id);
 90: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_state ON npcs(state_id);
 91: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_role ON npcs(role);
 92: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_status_tags ON npcs USING GIN(status_tags);
 93: 
 94: -- Теперь добавляем циклические FK через ALTER TABLE
 95: ALTER TABLE states
 96:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_states_ruler,
 97:   ADD CONSTRAINT fk_states_ruler FOREIGN KEY (ruler_id) REFERENCES npcs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
 98: 
 99: ALTER TABLE npcs
100:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_npcs_location,
101:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_npcs_state,
102:   ADD CONSTRAINT fk_npcs_location FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
103:   ADD CONSTRAINT fk_npcs_state FOREIGN KEY (state_id) REFERENCES states(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
104: 
105: -- Изменение таблицы inventory: поддержка NPC
106: ALTER TABLE inventory
107:   ALTER COLUMN player_id DROP NOT NULL,
108:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS npc_id UUID REFERENCES npcs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
109: 
110: -- Добавляем ограничение: хотя бы одно из полей должно быть заполнено
111: ALTER TABLE inventory
112:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS inventory_owner_check,
113:   ADD CONSTRAINT inventory_owner_check CHECK (
114:     (player_id IS NOT NULL) OR (npc_id IS NOT NULL)
115:   );
116: 
117: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inventory_npc ON inventory(npc_id);
118: 
119: -- ============================================
120: -- Задача 4: Каскадная векторная память NPC (RAG)
121: -- ============================================
122: 
123: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS npc_memories (
124:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
125:   npc_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES npcs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
126:   player_id UUID REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
127:   memory_text TEXT NOT NULL,
128:   memory_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium' CHECK (memory_type IN ('vivid', 'medium', 'belief')),
129:   embedding vector(1024),
130:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
131: );
132: 
133: -- HNSW индекс для быстрого поиска по косинусному расстоянию
134: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npc_memories_embedding ON npc_memories
135:   USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)
136:   WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 64);
137: 
138: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npc_memories_npc ON npc_memories(npc_id);
139: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npc_memories_player ON npc_memories(player_id);
140: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npc_memories_type ON npc_memories(memory_type);
141: 
142: -- ============================================
143: -- Задача 5: RPC-функция для поиска воспоминаний
144: -- ============================================
145: 
146: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION match_npc_memories(
147:   query_embedding vector(1024),
148:   match_threshold float,
149:   match_count int,
150:   p_npc_id uuid,
151:   p_player_id uuid
152: )
153: RETURNS TABLE (
154:   id uuid,
155:   npc_id uuid,
156:   player_id uuid,
157:   memory_text text,
158:   memory_type text,
159:   embedding vector(1024),
160:   created_at timestamptz,
161:   similarity float
162: )
163: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
164: BEGIN
165:   RETURN QUERY
166:   SELECT
167:     nm.id,
168:     nm.npc_id,
169:     nm.player_id,
170:     nm.memory_text,
171:     nm.memory_type,
172:     nm.embedding,
173:     nm.created_at,
174:     1 - (nm.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
175:   FROM npc_memories nm
176:   WHERE nm.npc_id = p_npc_id
177:     AND nm.player_id = p_player_id
178:     AND nm.embedding IS NOT NULL
179:     AND 1 - (nm.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
180:   ORDER BY nm.embedding <=> query_embedding
181:   LIMIT match_count;
182: END;
183: $$;
184: 
185: -- ============================================
186: -- TRIGGERS для updated_at
187: -- ============================================
188: 
189: -- Drop existing triggers to allow re-running
190: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trigger_states_updated_at ON states;
191: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trigger_locations_updated_at ON locations;
192: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trigger_npcs_updated_at ON npcs;
193: 
194: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_states_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON states FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
195: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_locations_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON locations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
196: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_npcs_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON npcs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
197: 
198: -- ============================================
199: -- RLS POLICIES
200: -- ============================================
201: 
202: ALTER TABLE states ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
203: -- Drop existing policies to allow re-running
204: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "States: read for authenticated" ON states;
205: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "States: owner write" ON states;
206: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Locations: read for authenticated" ON locations;
207: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Locations: owner write" ON locations;
208: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Routes: read for authenticated" ON routes;
209: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Routes: owner write" ON routes;
210: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "NPCs: read for authenticated" ON npcs;
211: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "NPCs: owner write" ON npcs;
212: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Memories: read for authenticated" ON npc_memories;
213: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Memories: system manage" ON npc_memories;
214: 
215: CREATE POLICY "States: read for authenticated" ON states FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
216: CREATE POLICY "States: owner write" ON states FOR ALL USING (world_id IN (SELECT id FROM worlds WHERE owner_id = auth.uid()));
217: 
218: ALTER TABLE locations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
219: CREATE POLICY "Locations: read for authenticated" ON locations FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
220: CREATE POLICY "Locations: owner write" ON locations FOR ALL USING (state_id IN (SELECT id FROM states WHERE world_id IN (SELECT id FROM worlds WHERE owner_id = auth.uid())));
221: 
222: ALTER TABLE routes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
223: CREATE POLICY "Routes: read for authenticated" ON routes FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
224: CREATE POLICY "Routes: owner write" ON routes FOR ALL USING (
225:   location_a_id IN (SELECT id FROM locations WHERE state_id IN (SELECT id FROM states WHERE world_id IN (SELECT id FROM worlds WHERE owner_id = auth.uid())))
226: );
227: 
228: ALTER TABLE npcs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
229: CREATE POLICY "NPCs: read for authenticated" ON npcs FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
230: CREATE POLICY "NPCs: owner write" ON npcs FOR ALL USING (world_id IN (SELECT id FROM worlds WHERE owner_id = auth.uid()));
231: 
232: ALTER TABLE npc_memories ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
233: CREATE POLICY "Memories: read for authenticated" ON npc_memories FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
234: CREATE POLICY "Memories: system manage" ON npc_memories FOR ALL USING (true);
235: 
236: -- ============================================
237: -- TESTS:
238: -- ============================================
239: /*
240: -- Тест 1: Создание государства, столицы, второго города и маршрута
241: 
242: -- Создаем тестовый мир (если нет)
243: INSERT INTO worlds (owner_id, name, settings)
244: VALUES ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 'Тестовый мир', '{}')
245: RETURNING id AS test_world_id;
246: 
247: -- Создаем государство
248: INSERT INTO states (world_id, name, description)
249: VALUES (
250:   '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',  -- заменить на реальный world_id
251:   'Королевство Этерия',
252:   'Древнее королевство, известное своими магами и воинами.'
253: )
254: RETURNING id AS state_id;
255: 
256: -- Создаем столицу
257: INSERT INTO locations (state_id, name, type, description)
258: VALUES (
259:   '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',  -- заменить на реальный state_id
260:   'Этергард',
261:   'capital',
262:   'Великая столица с белокаменными башнями.'
263: )
264: RETURNING id AS capital_id;
265: 
266: -- Создаем второй город

268: VALUES (
269:   '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',  -- заменить на реальный state_id

277: INSERT INTO routes (location_a_id, location_b_id, distance_km, travel_days)
278: VALUES (
279:   '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',  -- заменить на capital_id

297:   {'Корона тяжела', 'Нард превыше всего'},
298:   '{"STR": 14, "DEX": 10, "CON": 12, "INT": 16, "WIS": 18, "CHA": 20}',
299:   85,

310:   'vivid',

315: SELECT * FROM match_npc_memories(

317:   0.5,                                 -- match_threshold
318:   10,                                  -- match_count
319:   '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',  -- p_npc_id
320:   '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'   -- p_player_id
321: );
322: */
323: 
324: -- ============================================
325: -- ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ RPC ФУНКЦИЙ ИНВЕНТАРЯ ДЛЯ ПОДДЕРЖКИ NPC
326: -- ============================================
327: 
328: -- Обновление функции add_item_to_inventory для поддержки NPC
329: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_item_to_inventory(
330:   p_player_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
331:   p_item_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
332:   p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1,
333:   p_type TEXT DEFAULT 'misc',
334:   p_attributes JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
335:   p_npc_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
336: )
337: RETURNS UUID LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
338: DECLARE existing_item_id UUID; new_id UUID;
339: BEGIN
340:   -- Ищем существующий предмет по player_id или npc_id
341:   SELECT id INTO existing_item_id
342:   FROM inventory
343:   WHERE (
344:     (p_player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id = p_player_id)
345:     OR (p_npc_id IS NOT NULL AND npc_id = p_npc_id)
346:   )
347:   AND item_name = p_item_name
348:   AND type = p_type
349:   FOR UPDATE;
350: 
351:   IF existing_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN
352:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity + p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item_id;
353:     RETURN existing_item_id;
354:   ELSE
355:     new_id := gen_random_uuid();
356:     INSERT INTO inventory (id, player_id, npc_id, item_name, quantity, type, attributes)
357:     VALUES (new_id, p_player_id, p_npc_id, p_item_name, p_quantity, p_type, p_attributes);
358:     RETURN new_id;
359:   END IF;
360: END;
361: $$;
362: 
363: -- Обновление функции remove_item_from_inventory для поддержки NPC
364: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION remove_item_from_inventory(
365:   p_player_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
366:   p_item_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
367:   p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1,
368:   p_npc_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
369: )
370: RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
371: DECLARE existing_item RECORD;
372: BEGIN
373:   -- Ищем существующий предмет по player_id или npc_id
374:   SELECT id, quantity INTO existing_item
375:   FROM inventory
376:   WHERE (
377:     (p_player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id = p_player_id)
378:     OR (p_npc_id IS NOT NULL AND npc_id = p_npc_id)
379:   )
380:   AND item_name = p_item_name
381:   FOR UPDATE;
382: 
383:   IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;
384: 
385:   IF existing_item.quantity <= p_quantity THEN
386:     DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = existing_item.id;
387:   ELSE
388:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item.id;
389:   END IF;
390: 
391:   RETURN TRUE;
392: END;
393: $$;

File: supabase/migrations/009_npc_category_and_geography.sql
================
 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 009: NPC Category & Location Binding
 3: -- ============================================
 4: -- Добавляет категорию NPC (npc, beast, monster, boss)
 5: -- Привязка NPC к локациям и государствам
 6: 
 7: -- Добавляем колонку category в таблицу npcs
 8: ALTER TABLE npcs
 9:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'npc' CHECK (category IN ('npc', 'beast', 'monster', 'boss'));
10: 
11: -- Индекс для быстрой фильтрации по категории
12: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_category ON npcs(category);
13: 
14: -- Комментарий к колонке
15: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.category IS 'Категория NPC: npc (разумное существо), beast (зверь), monster (монстр), boss (босс)';
16: 
17: -- RPC функция для получения списка государств и локаций мира
18: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_world_geography(p_world_id UUID)
19: RETURNS TABLE (
20:   states JSONB,
21:   locations JSONB
22: )
23: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
24: BEGIN
25:   RETURN QUERY
26:   SELECT
27:     COALESCE(
28:       (SELECT jsonb_agg(
29:         jsonb_build_object(
30:           'id', s.id,
31:           'name', s.name,
32:           'description', s.description
33:         ) ORDER BY s.name)
34:       FROM states s WHERE s.world_id = p_world_id),
35:       '[]'::jsonb
36:     ) AS states,
37:     COALESCE(
38:       (SELECT jsonb_agg(
39:         jsonb_build_object(
40:           'id', l.id,
41:           'name', l.name,
42:           'type', l.type,
43:           'state_id', l.state_id
44:         ) ORDER BY l.type, l.name)
45:       FROM locations l
46:       JOIN states s ON l.state_id = s.id
47:       WHERE s.world_id = p_world_id),
48:       '[]'::jsonb
49:     ) AS locations;
50: END;
51: $$;
52: 
53: COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_world_geography IS 'Возвращает список государств и локаций мира для привязки NPC';

File: supabase/migrations/012_creature_templates_and_combat.sql
================
  1: -- Migration 012: Creature templates & combat system overhaul
  2: -- Tier = potential, Level = current power (1-100)
  3: -- Separate table for beast/monster species templates
  4: -- Stat sum: creatures 50-200 (player starts at 72)
  5: 
  6: -- =====================================================
  7: -- CREATURE TEMPLATES: species definitions with level ranges
  8: -- =====================================================
  9: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creature_templates (
 10:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 11:   world_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 12:   
 13:   -- Identity
 14:   species_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- "Волк", "Дракон", "Гоблин" (not individual name)
 15:   race TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Чудовище',
 16:   category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monster' CHECK (category IN ('beast', 'monster', 'boss')),
 17:   
 18:   -- Potential vs Current power
 19:   tier INT NOT NULL CHECK (tier BETWEEN 1 AND 5), -- Max potential (determines special attacks count)
 20:   level_min INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (level_min >= 1 AND level_min <= 100),
 21:   level_max INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 CHECK (level_max >= 1 AND level_max <= 100),
 22:   
 23:   -- Base stats (at level 1) — sum ~50 for weak creatures (player starts at 72)
 24:   stats_base JSONB DEFAULT '{"STR": 8, "DEX": 8, "CON": 8, "INT": 6, "WIS": 6, "CHA": 4}',
 25:   
 26:   -- Combat
 27:   special_attacks JSONB DEFAULT '[]', -- Array of special abilities (count = tier)
 28:   base_attacks JSONB DEFAULT '[]', -- Array of basic attacks (2-3 per 10 levels)
 29:   hp_multiplier DECIMAL DEFAULT 1.5, -- HP = CON * level * multiplier
 30:   
 31:   -- Behavior
 32:   is_pack BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- Can appear in packs/groups
 33:   is_unique BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- If true, only one instance exists (gets a name)
 34:   
 35:   -- Lore
 36:   description TEXT DEFAULT '',
 37:   habitat TEXT DEFAULT '', -- Preferred environment
 38:   loot_tier INT DEFAULT 1 CHECK (loot_tier BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
 39:   
 40:   -- System
 41:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 42:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 43:   
 44:   CONSTRAINT valid_level_range CHECK (level_max >= level_min)
 45: );
 46: 
 47: -- Index for fast lookup
 48: CREATE INDEX idx_creature_templates_world ON creature_templates(world_id);
 49: CREATE INDEX idx_creature_templates_category ON creature_templates(category);
 50: CREATE INDEX idx_creature_templates_species ON creature_templates(species_name);
 51: 
 52: -- =====================================================
 53: -- Update NPCs table: link to template, add attacks
 54: -- =====================================================
 55: ALTER TABLE npcs
 56:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS template_id UUID REFERENCES creature_templates(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 57:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS special_attacks JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
 58:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS base_attacks JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
 59:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_pack_instance BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
 60:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pack_size INT DEFAULT 1;
 61: 
 62: -- Ensure max level is 100
 63: ALTER TABLE npcs DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS npcs_level_check;
 64: ALTER TABLE npcs ADD CONSTRAINT npcs_level_check CHECK (level >= 1 AND level <= 100);
 65: 
 66: -- Create index for template lookups
 67: CREATE INDEX idx_npcs_template ON npcs(template_id);
 68: 
 69: -- =====================================================
 70: -- Function to calculate stats at a given level
 71: -- Base sum at level 1: ~50 (creatures weaker than starting player at 72)
 72: -- Each level: +2 to stat sum
 73: -- Each tier: +10 to stat sum (bonus potential)
 74: -- Max at level 100 + tier 5: 50 + 198 + 50 = ~200
 75: -- =====================================================
 76: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_creature_stats(
 77:   base_stats JSONB,
 78:   current_level INT,
 79:   creature_tier INT
 80: ) RETURNS JSONB AS $$
 81: DECLARE
 82:   result JSONB := '{}';
 83:   stat_key TEXT;
 84:   base_val INT;
 85:   scaled_val INT;
 86:   final_sum INT := 0;
 87:   target_sum INT;
 88:   diff INT;
 89:   adjust_stat TEXT;
 90:   max_dist INT := 0;
 91:   current_dist INT;
 92:   stat_count INT := 6;
 93:   per_stat_gain DECIMAL;
 94:   tier_bonus_per_stat DECIMAL;
 95: BEGIN
 96:   -- Target sum: base 50 + (level-1)*2 + (tier-1)*10, capped at 200
 97:   target_sum := 50 + ((current_level - 1) * 2) + ((creature_tier - 1) * 10);
 98:   IF target_sum > 200 THEN target_sum := 200; END IF;
 99:   
100:   -- Per-stat gain: each level adds ~0.33 to each stat (2 points / 6 stats)
101:   -- Each tier adds ~1.67 to each stat (10 points / 6 stats)
102:   per_stat_gain := (current_level - 1) * 0.33;
103:   tier_bonus_per_stat := (creature_tier - 1) * 1.67;
104:   
105:   -- First pass: scale each stat proportionally
106:   FOR stat_key IN SELECT unnest(ARRAY['STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA'])
107:   LOOP
108:     base_val := COALESCE((base_stats->>stat_key)::INT, 8);
109:     scaled_val := base_val + (per_stat_gain::INT) + (tier_bonus_per_stat::INT);
110:     -- Bonus for primary stats (STR for beasts, INT for monsters)
111:     IF stat_key = 'STR' AND creature_tier >= 3 THEN
112:       scaled_val := scaled_val + 2;
113:     ELSIF stat_key = 'INT' AND creature_tier >= 4 THEN
114:       scaled_val := scaled_val + 2;
115:     END IF;
116:     IF scaled_val > 30 THEN scaled_val := 30; END IF;
117:     IF scaled_val < 1 THEN scaled_val := 1; END IF;
118:     result := result || jsonb_build_object(stat_key, scaled_val);
119:     final_sum := final_sum + scaled_val;
120:   END LOOP;
121:   
122:   -- Adjust to match target sum
123:   diff := target_sum - final_sum;
124:   IF diff != 0 THEN
125:     -- Find stat furthest from base 8 to adjust
126:     adjust_stat := 'STR';
127:     max_dist := 0;
128:     FOR stat_key IN SELECT unnest(ARRAY['STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA'])
129:     LOOP
130:       current_dist := ABS((result->>stat_key)::INT - 8);
131:       IF current_dist > max_dist THEN
132:         max_dist := current_dist;
133:         adjust_stat := stat_key;
134:       END IF;
135:     END LOOP;
136:     result := result || jsonb_build_object(adjust_stat, GREATEST(1, LEAST(30, (result->>adjust_stat)::INT + diff)));
137:   END IF;
138:   
139:   RETURN result;
140: END;
141: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE;
142: 
143: -- =====================================================
144: -- Function to calculate HP from CON and level
145: -- Unified formula for players AND creatures:
146: -- HP = (CON * 2 + 10) + level * CON * 0.5
147: -- =====================================================
148: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_creature_hp(
149:   con_stat INT,
150:   current_level INT,
151:   creature_tier INT,
152:   hp_mult DECIMAL DEFAULT 1.5
153: ) RETURNS INT AS $$
154: DECLARE
155:   base_hp INT;
156:   level_bonus INT;
157: BEGIN
158:   -- Unified formula: (CON * 2 + 10) + level * CON * 0.5
159:   base_hp := GREATEST(1, con_stat * 2 + 10);
160:   level_bonus := GREATEST(0, (current_level * con_stat * 5 / 10)::INT);
161:   
162:   RETURN base_hp + level_bonus;
163: END;
164: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE;
165: 
166: -- =====================================================
167: -- Function to calculate special attacks count by tier
168: -- =====================================================
169: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_special_attacks_count(creature_tier INT)
170: RETURNS INT AS $$
171: BEGIN
172:   -- Tier 1: 1 special attack, Tier 5: 5 special attacks
173:   RETURN GREATEST(1, LEAST(5, creature_tier));
174: END;
175: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE;
176: 
177: -- =====================================================
178: -- Function to calculate base attacks count by level
179: -- =====================================================
180: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_base_attacks_count(current_level INT)
181: RETURNS INT AS $$
182: BEGIN
183:   -- 2 base attacks at level 1-10, +1 per 10 levels, max 10
184:   RETURN GREATEST(2, LEAST(10, 2 + ((current_level - 1) / 10)));
185: END;
186: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE;
