File: src/main.js
================
 1: // src/main.js — Точка входа приложения
 2: import { onAuthStateChange } from './api/supabase.js';
 3: import { renderAuth } from './pages/auth.js';
 4: import { renderLobby } from './pages/lobby.js';
 5: import { renderSessionSettings } from './pages/session-settings.js';
 6: import { renderGame } from './pages/game.js';
 7: import { router } from './router.js';
 8: import './styles/main.css';
 9: import './styles/game.css';
10: 
11: const app = document.getElementById('app');
12: let currentUser = null;
13: let cleanupFn = null;
14: 
15: // Register service worker
16: if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
17:   navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js').catch(() => {});
18: }
19: 
20: // Show loading state while Supabase resolves auth
21: app.innerHTML = '<div class="page page-centered"><p style="color: var(--text-muted);">Загрузка...</p></div>';
22: 
23: // Auth state listener — handles both initial check AND OAuth callback
24: // Supabase client automatically processes tokens from URL hash
25: onAuthStateChange((user) => {
26:   currentUser = user;
27:   if (cleanupFn) {
28:     cleanupFn();
29:     cleanupFn = null;
30:   }
31: 
32:   if (!user) {
33:     renderAuth(app);
34:     return;
35:   }
36: 
37:   // Define routes
38:   router
39:     .add('/', () => {
40:       renderLobby(app, user);
41:     })
42:     .add('/auth', () => {
43:       renderAuth(app);
44:     })
45:     .add('/session/:id/settings', (params) => {
46:       renderSessionSettings(app, params.id, user);
47:     })
48:     .add('/session/:id', (params) => {
49:       renderGame(app, params.id, user).then((cleanup) => {
50:         cleanupFn = cleanup;
51:       });
52:     });
53: 
54:   router.resolve();
55: });

================
File: supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql
================
  1: -- ============================================
  2: -- MultiRP AI — Initial Schema Migration v2
  3: -- All tables first, then policies/indexes/triggers
  4: -- ============================================
  5: 
  6: -- Clean slate
  7: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS turn_queue CASCADE;
  8: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS messages CASCADE;
  9: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS inventory CASCADE;
 10: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS players CASCADE;
 11: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions CASCADE;
 12: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS lore_files CASCADE;
 13: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS worlds CASCADE;
 14: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS update_updated_at CASCADE;
 15: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS roll_d20 CASCADE;
 16: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS roll_d20_advantage CASCADE;
 17: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS roll_d20_disadvantage CASCADE;
 18: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS update_player_hp CASCADE;
 19: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS add_item_to_inventory CASCADE;
 20: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS remove_item_from_inventory CASCADE;
 21: 
 22: -- Enable UUID extension (gen_random_uuid is built-in for PG 13+)
 23: 
 24: -- ============================================
 25: -- TABLES (order matters for FK references)
 26: -- ============================================
 27: 
 28: CREATE TABLE worlds (
 29:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 30:   owner_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 31:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
 32:   settings JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
 33:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 34:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 35: );
 36: 
 37: CREATE TABLE lore_files (
 38:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 39:   world_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 40:   folder TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
 41:   title TEXT NOT NULL,
 42:   content TEXT DEFAULT '',
 43:   tags TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
 44:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 45:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 46: );
 47: 
 48: CREATE TABLE sessions (
 49:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 50:   world_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 51:   difficulty TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (difficulty IN ('easy', 'normal', 'hard')),
 52:   is_pvp_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
 53:   current_plot_stage TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
 54:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 55:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 56: );
 57: 
 58: CREATE TABLE players (
 59:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 60:   session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 61:   user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 62:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
 63:   race TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Человек',
 64:   class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Воин',
 65:   appearance TEXT DEFAULT '',
 66:   personality JSONB DEFAULT '{"ideals": [], "bonds": [], "flaws": []}',
 67:   bio TEXT DEFAULT '',
 68:   power_level INT DEFAULT 10 CHECK (power_level >= 1 AND power_level <= 100),
 69:   stats JSONB DEFAULT '{"STR": 10, "DEX": 10, "CON": 10, "INT": 10, "WIS": 10, "CHA": 10}',
 70:   hp INT DEFAULT 30,
 71:   max_hp INT DEFAULT 30,
 72:   money INT DEFAULT 0,
 73:   is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
 74:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 75:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 76: );
 77: 
 78: CREATE TABLE inventory (
 79:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 80:   player_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 81:   item_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 82:   quantity INT DEFAULT 1 CHECK (quantity >= 0),
 83:   type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'misc' CHECK (type IN ('weapon', 'armor', 'consumable', 'misc')),
 84:   attributes JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
 85:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 86: );
 87: 
 88: CREATE TABLE messages (
 89:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 90:   session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 91:   sender_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (sender_type IN ('player', 'master', 'system')),
 92:   sender_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 93:   sender_name TEXT DEFAULT '',
 94:   content TEXT NOT NULL,
 95:   metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
 96:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 97: );
 98: 
 99: CREATE TABLE turn_queue (
100:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
101:   session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
102:   player_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
103:   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'waiting', 'completed', 'skipped')),
104:   action_text TEXT,
105:   parsed_action JSONB,
106:   roll_result JSONB,
107:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
108:   resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
109: );
110: 
111: -- ============================================
112: -- INDEXES
113: -- ============================================
114: 
115: CREATE INDEX idx_worlds_owner ON worlds(owner_id);
116: CREATE INDEX idx_lore_files_world ON lore_files(world_id);
117: CREATE INDEX idx_lore_files_folder ON lore_files(world_id, folder);
118: CREATE INDEX idx_lore_files_tags ON lore_files USING GIN(tags);
119: CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_world ON sessions(world_id);
120: CREATE INDEX idx_players_session ON players(session_id);
121: CREATE INDEX idx_players_user ON players(user_id);
122: CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_player ON inventory(player_id);
123: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_session ON messages(session_id, created_at DESC);
124: CREATE INDEX idx_turn_queue_session ON turn_queue(session_id, status);
125: CREATE INDEX idx_turn_queue_player ON turn_queue(player_id);
126: 
127: -- ============================================
128: -- RLS POLICIES (all tables now exist)
129: -- ============================================
130: 
131: ALTER TABLE worlds ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
132: CREATE POLICY "Worlds: owner read/write" ON worlds FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = owner_id);
133: CREATE POLICY "Worlds: anyone can read" ON worlds FOR SELECT USING (true);
134: 
135: ALTER TABLE lore_files ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
136: CREATE POLICY "Lore: read for all authenticated" ON lore_files FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
137: CREATE POLICY "Lore: owner write" ON lore_files FOR ALL USING (world_id IN (SELECT id FROM worlds WHERE owner_id = auth.uid()));
138: 
139: ALTER TABLE sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
140: CREATE POLICY "Sessions: read for authenticated" ON sessions FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
141: CREATE POLICY "Sessions: create for authenticated" ON sessions FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
142: CREATE POLICY "Sessions: update for participants" ON sessions FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (id IN (SELECT session_id FROM players WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
143: 
144: ALTER TABLE players ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
145: CREATE POLICY "Players: read in same session" ON players FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM players WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
146: CREATE POLICY "Players: join session" ON players FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id OR user_id IS NULL);
147: CREATE POLICY "Players: update own" ON players FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
148: CREATE POLICY "Players: system update" ON players FOR UPDATE USING (true);
149: 
150: ALTER TABLE inventory ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
151: CREATE POLICY "Inventory: read for owner" ON inventory FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (player_id IN (SELECT id FROM players WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
152: CREATE POLICY "Inventory: manage for owner" ON inventory FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (player_id IN (SELECT id FROM players WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
153: CREATE POLICY "Inventory: system manage" ON inventory FOR ALL USING (true);
154: 
155: ALTER TABLE messages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
156: CREATE POLICY "Messages: read for session players" ON messages FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM players WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
157: CREATE POLICY "Messages: players send" ON messages FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (sender_type = 'player' AND sender_id = auth.uid() AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM players WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
158: CREATE POLICY "Messages: system insert" ON messages FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (sender_type IN ('master', 'system'));
159: 
160: ALTER TABLE turn_queue ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
161: CREATE POLICY "Turn: read for session players" ON turn_queue FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM players WHERE user_id = auth.uid()));
162: CREATE POLICY "Turn: system manage" ON turn_queue FOR ALL USING (true);
163: 
164: -- ============================================
165: -- RPC FUNCTIONS
166: -- ============================================
167: 
168: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at()
169: RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
170: BEGIN NEW.updated_at = NOW(); RETURN NEW; END;
171: $$;
172: 
173: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_worlds_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON worlds FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
174: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_sessions_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
175: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_players_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON players FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
176: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_lore_files_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON lore_files FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
177: 
178: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION roll_d20(stat_value INT, difficulty_mod INT DEFAULT 0)
179: RETURNS TABLE (roll INT, total INT, success BOOLEAN)
180: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
181: DECLARE d20_roll INT; stat_mod INT; total_val INT;
182: BEGIN
183:   d20_roll := floor(random() * 20 + 1)::INT;
184:   stat_mod := floor((stat_value - 10) / 2.0)::INT;
185:   total_val := d20_roll + stat_mod + difficulty_mod;
186:   RETURN QUERY SELECT d20_roll AS roll, total_val AS total, (total_val >= 10) AS success;
187: END;
188: $$;
189: 
190: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION roll_d20_advantage(stat_value INT)
191: RETURNS TABLE (rolls INT[], best_roll INT, total INT, success BOOLEAN)
192: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
193: DECLARE r1 INT; r2 INT; best INT; stat_mod INT; total_val INT;
194: BEGIN
195:   r1 := floor(random() * 20 + 1)::INT;
196:   r2 := floor(random() * 20 + 1)::INT;
197:   best := GREATEST(r1, r2);
198:   stat_mod := floor((stat_value - 10) / 2.0)::INT;
199:   total_val := best + stat_mod;
200:   RETURN QUERY SELECT ARRAY[r1, r2] AS rolls, best AS best_roll, total_val AS total, (total_val >= 10) AS success;
201: END;
202: $$;
203: 
204: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION roll_d20_disadvantage(stat_value INT)
205: RETURNS TABLE (rolls INT[], worst_roll INT, total INT, success BOOLEAN)
206: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
207: DECLARE r1 INT; r2 INT; worst INT; stat_mod INT; total_val INT;
208: BEGIN
209:   r1 := floor(random() * 20 + 1)::INT;
210:   r2 := floor(random() * 20 + 1)::INT;
211:   worst := LEAST(r1, r2);
212:   stat_mod := floor((stat_value - 10) / 2.0)::INT;
213:   total_val := worst + stat_mod;
214:   RETURN QUERY SELECT ARRAY[r1, r2] AS rolls, worst AS worst_roll, total_val AS total, (total_val >= 10) AS success;
215: END;
216: $$;
217: 
218: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_player_hp(p_player_id UUID, p_hp_change INT)
219: RETURNS TABLE (new_hp INT, new_max_hp INT, is_alive BOOLEAN)
220: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
221: DECLARE current_hp_val INT; max_hp_val INT; new_hp_val INT;
222: BEGIN
223:   SELECT hp, max_hp INTO current_hp_val, max_hp_val FROM players WHERE id = p_player_id FOR UPDATE;
224:   new_hp_val := GREATEST(0, LEAST(max_hp_val, current_hp_val + p_hp_change));
225:   UPDATE players SET hp = new_hp_val WHERE id = p_player_id;
226:   RETURN QUERY SELECT new_hp_val AS new_hp, max_hp_val AS new_max_hp, (new_hp_val > 0) AS is_alive;
227: END;
228: $$;
229: 
230: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_item_to_inventory(p_player_id UUID, p_item_name TEXT, p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1, p_type TEXT DEFAULT 'misc', p_attributes JSONB DEFAULT '{}')
231: RETURNS UUID LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
232: DECLARE existing_item_id UUID; new_id UUID;
233: BEGIN
234:   SELECT id INTO existing_item_id FROM inventory WHERE player_id = p_player_id AND item_name = p_item_name AND type = p_type FOR UPDATE;
235:   IF existing_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN
236:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity + p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item_id;
237:     RETURN existing_item_id;
238:   ELSE
239:     new_id := gen_random_uuid();
240:     INSERT INTO inventory (id, player_id, item_name, quantity, type, attributes) VALUES (new_id, p_player_id, p_item_name, p_quantity, p_type, p_attributes);
241:     RETURN new_id;
242:   END IF;
243: END;
244: $$;
245: 
246: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION remove_item_from_inventory(p_player_id UUID, p_item_name TEXT, p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1)
247: RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
248: DECLARE existing_item RECORD;
249: BEGIN
250:   SELECT id, quantity INTO existing_item FROM inventory WHERE player_id = p_player_id AND item_name = p_item_name FOR UPDATE;
251:   IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;
252:   IF existing_item.quantity <= p_quantity THEN
253:     DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = existing_item.id;
254:   ELSE
255:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item.id;
256:   END IF;
257:   RETURN TRUE;
258: END;
259: $$;
260: 
261: -- ============================================
262: -- ENABLE REALTIME
263: -- ============================================
264: 
265: ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE messages;
266: ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE players;
267: ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE turn_queue;

 45: // Хелпер для создания цепочки моков Supabase
 46: function createSupabaseChain(returnValue: any) {
 47:   const chain: any = {
 48:     select: vi.fn(() => chain),
 49:     insert: vi.fn(() => chain),
 50:     update: vi.fn(() => chain),
 51:     delete: vi.fn(() => chain),
 52:     eq: vi.fn(() => chain),
 53:     in: vi.fn(() => chain),
 54:     order: vi.fn(() => chain),
 55:     limit: vi.fn(() => chain),
 56:     single: vi.fn(() => chain),
 57:     maybeSingle: vi.fn(() => chain),
 58:   };
 59:   Object.defineProperty(chain, "then", {
 60:     get() {
 61:       return (resolve: any) => resolve(returnValue);
 62:     },
 63:   });
 64:   return chain;
 65: }

351:     // Проверяем что rpc add_item_to_inventory НЕ вызывался
352:     expect(mockSupabase.rpc).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
353: 
354:     expect(body.success).toBe(true);
355:     expect(body.actions.length).toBe(1);
356:     expect(body.actions[0].obtained_item_name).toBeNull();
357:   });
358: });
359:

File: tests/utils.test.ts

  1: import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
  2: import { parseAIJson, cleanTextForAI, sanitizeKey } from "../supabase/functions/_shared/utils.ts";
  3: 
  4: describe("parseAIJson", () => {
  5:   it("parses plain JSON object", () => {
  6:     expect(parseAIJson('{"STR": 14, "DEX": 12}')).toEqual({ STR: 14, DEX: 12 });
  7:   });
  8: 
  9:   it("parses JSON array", () => {
 10:     expect(parseAIJson('[1, 2, 3]')).toEqual([1, 2, 3]);
 11:   });
 12: 
 13:   it("extracts JSON from markdown code block", () => {
 14:     const text = "Here is the result:\n```json\n{\"a\": 1}\n```";
 15:     expect(parseAIJson(text)).toEqual({ a: 1 });
 16:   });
 17: 
 18:   it("extracts JSON from generic markdown block", () => {
 19:     const text = "```\n{\"x\": true}\n```";
 20:     expect(parseAIJson(text)).toEqual({ x: true });
 21:   });
 22: 
 23:   it("extracts first JSON object from mixed text", () => {
 24:     const text = "Some text {\"key\": \"value\"} more text";
 25:     expect(parseAIJson(text)).toEqual({ key: "value" });
 26:   });
 27: 
 28:   it("returns null for invalid JSON", () => {
 29:     expect(parseAIJson("no json here")).toBeNull();
 30:     expect(parseAIJson("")).toBeNull();
 31:     expect(parseAIJson("```json\n{ invalid ```")).toBeNull();
 32:   });
 33: 
 34:   it("handles nested JSON", () => {
 35:     const text = '{"stats": {"STR": 10, "DEX": 12}}';
 36:     expect(parseAIJson(text)).toEqual({ STR: 10, DEX: 12 });
 37:   });
 38: 
 39:   it("extracts nested stats object from wrapper", () => {
 40:     const text = '{"stats":{"STR":12,"DEX":12,"CON":12,"INT":12,"WIS":12,"CHA":12}}';
 41:     expect(parseAIJson(text)).toEqual({ STR: 12, DEX: 12, CON: 12, INT: 12, WIS: 12, CHA: 12 });
 42:   });
 43: 
 44:   it("extracts stats from text with extra braces", () => {
 45:     const text = 'Here is your character: {"stats":{"STR":12,"DEX":12,"CON":12,"INT":12,"WIS":12,"CHA":12}} Enjoy!';
 46:     expect(parseAIJson(text)).toEqual({ STR: 12, DEX: 12, CON: 12, INT: 12, WIS: 12, CHA: 12 });
 47:   });
 48: 
 49:   it("returns null when no JSON present", () => {
 50:     expect(parseAIJson("No stats here, just text.")).toBeNull();
 51:   });
 52: 
 53:   it("handles JSON with newlines and spaces", () => {
 54:     const text = "{\n  \"a\": 1,\n  \"b\": 2\n}";
 55:     expect(parseAIJson(text)).toEqual({ a: 1, b: 2 });
 56:   });
 57: });
 58: 
 59: describe("cleanTextForAI", () => {
 60:   it("returns empty string for null/undefined", () => {
 61:     expect(cleanTextForAI(null)).toBe("");
 62:     expect(cleanTextForAI(undefined)).toBe("");
 63:     expect(cleanTextForAI("")).toBe("");
 64:   });
 65: 
 66:   it("removes control characters", () => {
 67:     const input = "hello\x00\x1Fworld";
 68:     expect(cleanTextForAI(input)).toBe("helloworld");
 69:   });
 70: 
 71:   it("removes image references and long base64-like strings", () => {
 72:     const input = "Check this image.png and a very long base64 string A".repeat(50);
 73:     const cleaned = cleanTextForAI(input);
 74:     expect(cleaned).not.toContain("image.png");
 75:     // long base64-like substring should be stripped
 76:     expect(cleaned.length).toBeLessThan(input.length);
 77:   });
 78: 
 79:   it("removes data URI image references", () => {
 80:     const input = "Avatar: data:image/png;base64,AAAA";
 81:     const cleaned = cleanTextForAI(input);
 82:     expect(cleaned).not.toContain("image/png");
 83:     expect(cleaned).not.toContain("base64");
 84:     expect(cleaned.trim()).toBe("Avatar:");
 85:   });
 86: 
 87:   it("removes http(s) URLs", () => {
 88:     const input = "Visit https://example.com for more";
 89:     expect(cleanTextForAI(input)).toBe("Visit for more");
 90:   });
 91: 
 92:   it("removes Windows paths", () => {
 93:     const input = "File at C:\\Users\\test\\file.txt";
 94:     expect(cleanTextForAI(input)).toBe("File at");
 95:   });
 96: 
 97:   it("collapses whitespace", () => {
 98:     const input = "hello    world\n\n\t  test";
 99:     expect(cleanTextForAI(input)).toBe("hello world test");
100:   });
101: 
102:   it("truncates long text to 4000 chars", () => {
103:     const input = "word ".repeat(1000);
104:     expect(cleanTextForAI(input).length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(4000);
105:   });
106: 
107:   it("preserves safe ASCII text and strips non-safe characters", () => {
108:     // cleanTextForAI strips non-ASCII characters outside allowed ranges,
109:     // so we only assert it returns a safe ASCII-ish string.
110:     const input = "Hello, world! 123";
111:     const cleaned = cleanTextForAI(input);
112:     expect(cleaned).toBe("Hello, world! 123");
113:   });
114: 
115:   it("preserves Russian/Cyrillic text", () => {
116:     const input = "Привет, мир! Это тест.";
117:     const cleaned = cleanTextForAI(input);
118:     expect(cleaned).toBe("Привет, мир! Это тест.");
119:   });
120: });
121: 
122: describe("sanitizeKey", () => {
123:   it("trims whitespace", () => {
124:     expect(sanitizeKey("  key  ")).toBe("key");
125:   });
126: 
127:   it("removes non-ASCII printable characters", () => {
128:     expect(sanitizeKey("k\u0435\u0443")).toBe("k");
129:   });
130: 
131:   it("handles empty/null input", () => {
132:     expect(sanitizeKey("")).toBe("");
133:     expect(sanitizeKey(null as any)).toBe("");
134:     expect(sanitizeKey(undefined as any)).toBe("");
135:   });
136: 
137:   it("keeps standard ASCII characters", () => {
138:     expect(sanitizeKey("abc-123_ABC")).toBe("abc-123_ABC");
139:   });
140: });

File: tests/stats.test.ts

  1: import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
  2: import { validateAndFixStats } from "../supabase/functions/_shared/utils.ts";
  3: import { calculateHpFromStats, calculateInitiative, calculateArmorClass, calculateSavingThrows, calculateDerivedStats, getRaceAcBonus, validateAndFixStats as validateAndFixStatsFrontend } from "../src/config.js";
  4: 
  5: describe("validateAndFixStats", () => {
  6:   it("returns default stats when input is empty", () => {
  7:     const result = validateAndFixStats(null);
  8:     expect(result.STR).toBe(10);
  9:     expect(result.DEX).toBe(10);
 10:     expect(result.CON).toBe(10);
 11:     expect(result.INT).toBe(10);
 12:     expect(result.WIS).toBe(10);
 13:     expect(result.CHA).toBe(10);
 14:   });
 15: 
 16:   it("preserves values above 18 without clamping", () => {
 17:     const result = validateAndFixStats({ STR: 20, DEX: 22, CON: 25 });
 18:     expect(result.STR).toBe(20);
 19:     expect(result.DEX).toBe(22);
 20:     expect(result.CON).toBe(25);
 21:   });
 22: 
 23:   it("preserves values below 3 without clamping", () => {
 24:     const result = validateAndFixStats({ STR: -5, DEX: 0, CON: 1 });
 25:     expect(result.STR).toBe(-5);
 26:     expect(result.DEX).toBe(0);
 27:     expect(result.CON).toBe(1);
 28:   });
 29: 
 30:   it("does not force sum to 72", () => {
 31:     const result = validateAndFixStats({ STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 });
 32:     const sum = Object.values(result).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
 33:     expect(sum).toBe(60);
 34:   });
 35: 
 36:   it("does not break valid input", () => {
 37:     const input = { STR: 16, DEX: 10, CON: 12, INT: 10, WIS: 14, CHA: 10 };
 38:     const result = validateAndFixStats(input);
 39:     expect(result.STR).toBe(16);
 40:     expect(result.WIS).toBe(14);
 41:   });
 42: 
 43:   it("handles partial input by filling missing stats with 10", () => {
 44:     const result = validateAndFixStats({ STR: 18 });
 45:     expect(result.STR).toBe(18);
 46:     expect(result.DEX).toBe(10);
 47:     expect(result.CON).toBe(10);
 48:     expect(result.INT).toBe(10);
 49:     expect(result.WIS).toBe(10);
 50:     expect(result.CHA).toBe(10);
 51:   });
 52: });
 53: 
 54: describe("calculateHpFromStats", () => {
 55:   it("calculates HP from CON using D&D-like formula (max die + CON mod + 10)", () => {
 56:     // D&D 5e: HP на уровне 1 = max hit die + CON mod + 10
 57:     // По умолчанию d8: max=8, base=10
 58:     // CON 10 (mod=0): 8 + 0 + 10 = 18
 59:     // CON 14 (mod=+2): 8 + 2 + 10 = 20
 60:     // CON 8 (mod=-1): 8 + (-1) + 10 = 17
 61:     expect(calculateHpFromStats({ CON: 10 })).toBe(18);
 62:     expect(calculateHpFromStats({ CON: 14 })).toBe(20);
 63:     expect(calculateHpFromStats({ CON: 8 })).toBe(17);
 64:   });
 65: 
 66:   it("falls back to 10 when stats object is empty or CON is missing", () => {
 67:     // CON 10 (default) → 18
 68:     expect(calculateHpFromStats({})).toBe(18);
 69:     expect(calculateHpFromStats(null)).toBe(18);
 70:     expect(calculateHpFromStats(undefined)).toBe(18);
 71:   });
 72: });
 73: 
 74: describe("calculateInitiative", () => {
 75:   it("returns DEX modifier", () => {
 76:     expect(calculateInitiative({ DEX: 10 })).toBe(0);
 77:     expect(calculateInitiative({ DEX: 14 })).toBe(2);
 78:     expect(calculateInitiative({ DEX: 8 })).toBe(-1);
 79:   });
 80: 
 81:   it("falls back to 0 when DEX is missing", () => {
 82:     expect(calculateInitiative({})).toBe(0);
 83:     expect(calculateInitiative(null)).toBe(0);
 84:   });
 85: });
 86: 
 87: describe("calculateArmorClass", () => {
 88:   it("calculates AC from DEX, race and equipment", () => {
 89:     expect(calculateArmorClass({ DEX: 10 }, 'Человек', [])).toBe(10);
 90:     expect(calculateArmorClass({ DEX: 14 }, 'Эльф', [])).toBe(12);
 91:     expect(calculateArmorClass({ DEX: 8 }, 'Дварф', [])).toBe(10);
 92:     expect(calculateArmorClass({ DEX: 14 }, 'Человек', [{ ac_bonus: 2 }])).toBe(14);
 93:   });
 94: 
 95:   it("falls back to base 10 when stats are missing", () => {
 96:     expect(calculateArmorClass({}, 'Человек', [])).toBe(10);
 97:   });
 98: });
 99: 
100: describe("calculateSavingThrows", () => {
101:   it("calculates saving throws for all stats", () => {
102:     const stats = { STR: 10, DEX: 14, CON: 12, INT: 8, WIS: 16, CHA: 10 };
103:     const result = calculateSavingThrows(stats, 2);
104:     expect(result.STR).toBe(2);
105:     expect(result.DEX).toBe(4);
106:     expect(result.CON).toBe(3);
107:     expect(result.INT).toBe(1);
108:     expect(result.WIS).toBe(5);
109:     expect(result.CHA).toBe(2);
110:   });
111: 
112:   it("falls back to default stats when missing", () => {
113:     const result = calculateSavingThrows({}, 2);
114:     expect(result.STR).toBe(2);
115:     expect(result.DEX).toBe(2);
116:   });
117: });
118: 
119: describe("calculateDerivedStats", () => {
120:   it("returns initiative, armor_class and saving_throws", () => {
121:     const result = calculateDerivedStats({ STR: 10, DEX: 14, CON: 12, INT: 8, WIS: 16, CHA: 10 }, 'Эльф', []);
122:     expect(result.initiative).toBe(2);
123:     expect(result.armor_class).toBe(12);
124:     expect(result.saving_throws.STR).toBe(2);
125:     expect(result.saving_throws.WIS).toBe(5);
126:   });
127: 
128:   it("adds equipment bonus to AC", () => {
129:     const result = calculateDerivedStats({ DEX: 14 }, 'Человек', [{ ac_bonus: 3 }]);
130:     expect(result.armor_class).toBe(15);
131:   });
132: 
133:   it("uses custom race_ac_bonus when provided", () => {
134:     const result = calculateDerivedStats({ DEX: 14 }, 'Каменный голем', [], 3);
135:     expect(result.armor_class).toBe(15);
136:   });
137: });
138: 
139: describe("getRaceAcBonus", () => {
140:   it("returns correct bonus for standard races", () => {
141:     expect(getRaceAcBonus('Дварф')).toBe(1);
142:     expect(getRaceAcBonus('Гном')).toBe(1);
143:     expect(getRaceAcBonus('Полурослик')).toBe(1);
144:     expect(getRaceAcBonus('Эльф')).toBe(0);
145:     expect(getRaceAcBonus('Человек')).toBe(0);
146:   });
147: 
148:   it("returns 0 for unknown races", () => {
149:     expect(getRaceAcBonus('Каменный голем')).toBe(0);
150:     expect(getRaceAcBonus('Дракон')).toBe(0);
151:   });
152: });
153: 
154: describe("validateAndFixStats with forceSum72", () => {
155:   it("forces sum to 72 only when option is set", () => {
156:     const backendResult = validateAndFixStats({ STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 }, { forceSum72: true });
157:     const sum = Object.values(backendResult).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
158:     expect(sum).toBe(72);
159:   });
160: 
161:   it("does not force sum when option is not set", () => {
162:     const backendResult = validateAndFixStats({ STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 });
163:     const sum = Object.values(backendResult).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
164:     expect(sum).toBe(60);
165:   });
166: });

================
File: src/api/supabase.js
================
  1: // src/api/supabase.js — Клиент Supabase
  2: import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
  3: import { SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY } from '../config.js';
  4: 
  5: export const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY);
  6: 
  7: // Безопасный вызов Edge Functions через прямой fetch (обходит баг Supabase-клиента)
  8: export async function invokeFunction(functionName, body) {
  9:   const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
 10:   const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
 11:   if (session?.access_token) {
 12:     headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${session.access_token}`;
 13:   }
 14:   const payload = JSON.stringify(body ?? {});
 15:   const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/${functionName}`, {
 16:     method: 'POST',
 17:     headers,
 18:     body: payload,
 19:     cache: 'no-store',
 20:   });
 21:   const data = await res.json();
 22:   if (!res.ok) {
 23:     const err = new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
 24:     err.status = res.status;
 25:     err.data = data;
 26:     throw err;
 27:   }
 28:   return data;
 29: }
 30: 
 31: // Auth helpers
 32: export async function signUp(email, password) {
 33:   const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password });
 34:   if (error) throw error;
 35:   return data;
 36: }
 37: 
 38: export async function signIn(email, password) {
 39:   const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
 40:   if (error) throw error;
 41:   return data;
 42: }
 43: 
 44: export async function signInWithGoogle() {
 45:   const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
 46:     provider: 'google',
 47:     options: {
 48:       redirectTo: window.location.origin + '/Multi-RP/',
 49:     },
 50:   });
 51:   if (error) throw error;
 52:   return data;
 53: }
 54: 
 55: export async function signOut() {
 56:   const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
 57:   if (error) throw error;
 58: }
 59: 
 60: export async function getCurrentUser() {
 61:   const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
 62:   return user;
 63: }
 64: 
 65: export function onAuthStateChange(callback) {
 66:   return supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
 67:     callback(session?.user || null);
 68:   });
 69: }
 70: 
 71: // Realtime subscription helper
 72: export function subscribeToTable(table, filter, callback) {
 73:   const cleanFilter = filter ? filter.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_') : 'all';
 74:   const channelId = `realtime:${table}:${cleanFilter}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
 75: 
 76:   const channel = supabase
 77:     .channel(channelId)
 78:     .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table, filter }, callback)
 79:     .subscribe();
 80: 
 81:   return () => supabase.removeChannel(channel);
 82: }
 83: 
 84: // Subscribe to session chat messages
 85: export function subscribeToSessionMessages(sessionId, callback) {
 86:   return subscribeToTable(
 87:     'messages',
 88:     `session_id=eq.${sessionId}`,
 89:     (payload) => callback(payload)
 90:   );
 91: }
 92: 
 93: // Subscribe to session player updates (turn tracking)
 94: export function subscribeToSessionPlayers(sessionId, callback) {
 95:   return subscribeToTable(
 96:     'players',
 97:     `session_id=eq.${sessionId}`,
 98:     (payload) => callback(payload)
 99:   );
100: }

  1: // src/pages/session-settings.js — Экран настроек сессии (для Админа)
  2: import { supabase, invokeFunction } from '../api/supabase.js';
  3: import {
  4:   getSession, updateSession, getSessionPlayers, createPlayer,
  5:   getWorlds, getLoreFiles
  6: } from '../api/game.js';
  7: import { STATS, DIFFICULTY_PRESETS, calculateHpFromStats, calculateDerivedStats, getRaceAcBonus } from '../config.js';
  8: import { toast } from '../utils/toast.js';
  9: import { router } from '../router.js';
 10: 
 11: export async function renderSessionSettings(container, sessionId, user) {
 12:   let session = null;
 13:   let players = [];
 14:   let loreFiles = [];
 15: 
 16:   async function load() {
 17:     try {
 18:       session = await getSession(sessionId);
 19:       if (session.world_id) {
 20:         loreFiles = await getLoreFiles(session.world_id);
 21:       }
 22:       players = await getSessionPlayers(sessionId);
 23:     } catch (err) {
 24:       toast.error('Ошибка загрузки: ' + err.message);
 25:       router.navigate('/');
 26:       return;
 27:     }
 28:     render();
 29:   }
 30: 
 31:   function render() {
 32:     if (!session) return;
 33: 
 34:     container.innerHTML = `
 35:       <div class="page">
 36:         <header class="session-header">
 37:           <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="backBtn">← Назад</button>

 39:           <button class="btn btn-primary" id="startGameBtn">🎮 В игру</button>
 40:         </header>
 41: 
 42:         <div class="session-settings-content">
 43:           <!-- Настройки мира -->

 49:                 ${session.worlds?.name || 'Не привязан'}
 50:               </p>
 51:             </div>
 52:           </section>
 53: 
 54:           <!-- Сложность -->
 55:           <section class="card">
 56:             <h2 class="card-title">🎯 Сложность</h2>
 57:             <div class="difficulty-options" style="margin-top: 1rem;">
 58:               ${Object.entries(DIFFICULTY_PRESETS).map(([key, val]) => `
 59:                 <div class="difficulty-option ${session.difficulty === key ? 'selected' : ''}" data-difficulty="${key}">
 60:                   <div class="difficulty-label">${val.label}</div>
 61:                   <div class="difficulty-desc">${val.description}</div>
 62:                 </div>
 63:               `).join('')}
 64:             </div>
 65:           </section>

136:                     <span class="badge badge-gold">💰 ${p.money}</span>
137:                   </div>
138:                 </div>
139:               `).join('') : '<p class="text-muted">Пока нет игроков. Пригласите по ID сессии.</p>'}
140:             </div>
141:           </section>
142: 
143:           <!-- Приглашение -->
144:           <section class="card">
145:             <h2 class="card-title">🔗 Приглашение</h2>
146:             <p class="form-hint" style="margin-top: 0.5rem;">Отправьте эту ссылку друзьям — они присоединятся одной кнопкой</p>
147:             <div class="invite-code-container" style="margin-top: 1rem;">
148:               <code class="invite-code" style="flex: 1; font-size: var(--fs-xs); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">${window.location.origin}/Multi-RP/#/session/${sessionId}</code>
149:               <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" id="copyInviteBtn">📋 Копировать</button>
150:             </div>
151:             <p class="form-hint" style="margin-top: 0.75rem;">ID сессии (для ручного ввода):</p>
152:             <div class="invite-code-container" style="margin-top: 0.5rem;">
153:               <code class="invite-code" style="flex: 1; font-size: var(--fs-xs);">${sessionId}</code>
154:               <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="copyIdBtn">📋</button>
155:             </div>

================
File: supabase/functions/_shared/utils.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/_shared/utils.ts
  2: // Общие чистые утилиты для Edge Functions
  3: 
  4: export function sanitizeKey(raw: string): string {
  5:   return (raw || "").trim().replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g, "");
  6: }
  7: 
  8: export function cleanTextForAI(raw: string | null | undefined, maxLength: number = 4000): string {
  9:   if (!raw) return "";
 10:   let text = String(raw);
 11:   text = text.replace(/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]/g, "");
 12:   text = text.replace(/[^\u0009\u000A\u000D\u0020-\u007E\u00A0-\u00FF\u0400-\u04FF]/g, "");
 13:   text = text.replace(/data:image\/[^;\n\r]+;base64,[^\s]+/gi, "");
 14:   text = text.replace(/\b(?:image|img|photo|picture|avatar|icon|base64)\b[^\n\r]*?\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|bmp|svg)\b/gi, "");
 15:   text = text.replace(/[A-Za-z0-9+\/]{20,}={0,2}/g, "");
 16:   text = text.replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/g, "");
 17:   text = text.replace(/[A-Za-z]:\\[^\s]+/g, "");
 18:   text = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
 19:   if (text.length > maxLength) text = text.slice(0, maxLength);
 20:   return text;
 21: }
 22: 
 23: const VALID_STATS = ["STR", "DEX", "CON", "INT", "WIS", "CHA"] as const;
 24: export type StatKey = typeof VALID_STATS[number];
 25: export type StatsRecord = Record<StatKey, number>;
 26: 
 27: export function parseAIJson(text: string): any {
 28:   // Try direct parse, then unwrap if it's a stats wrapper
 29:   try {
 30:     const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
 31:     if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
 32:       const keys = Object.keys(parsed);
 33:       if (VALID_STATS.some((k) => keys.includes(k))) {
 34:         return parsed;
 35:       }
 36:       for (const val of Object.values(parsed)) {
 37:         if (val && typeof val === 'object' && !Array.isArray(val)) {
 38:           const nestedKeys = Object.keys(val);
 39:           if (VALID_STATS.some((k) => nestedKeys.includes(k))) {
 40:             return val;
 41:           }
 42:         }
 43:       }
 44:       return parsed;
 45:     }
 46:     return parsed;
 47:   } catch {}
 48: 
 49:   const jsonMatch = text.match(/```(?:json)?\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)\n?```/);
 50:   if (jsonMatch) {
 51:     try {
 52:       const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[1]);
 53:       if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
 54:         const keys = Object.keys(parsed);
 55:         if (VALID_STATS.some((k) => keys.includes(k))) {
 56:           return parsed;
 57:         }
 58:         for (const val of Object.values(parsed)) {
 59:           if (val && typeof val === 'object' && !Array.isArray(val)) {
 60:             const nestedKeys = Object.keys(val);
 61:             if (VALID_STATS.some((k) => nestedKeys.includes(k))) {
 62:               return val;
 63:             }
 64:           }
 65:         }
 66:         return parsed;
 67:       }
 68:       return parsed;
 69:     } catch {}
 70:   }
 71: 
 72:   // Scan for all JSON objects by tracking brace depth
 73:   const candidates: string[] = [];
 74:   let start = -1;
 75:   let depth = 0;
 76:   for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
 77:     if (text[i] === '{') {
 78:       if (start === -1) start = i;
 79:       depth++;
 80:     } else if (text[i] === '}') {
 81:       depth--;
 82:       if (depth === 0 && start !== -1) {
 83:         candidates.push(text.slice(start, i + 1));
 84:         start = -1;
 85:       }
 86:     }
 87:   }
 88: 
 89:   // If brace scanning found nothing, fallback to greedy regex
 90:   if (candidates.length === 0) {
 91:     const objMatch = text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
 92:     if (objMatch) candidates.push(objMatch[0]);
 93:   }
 94: 
 95:   // First pass: prioritize objects containing stat keys directly
 96:   for (const c of candidates) {
 97:     try {
 98:       const parsed = JSON.parse(c);
 99:       if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
100:         const keys = Object.keys(parsed);
101:         if (VALID_STATS.some((k) => keys.includes(k))) {
102:           return parsed;
103:         }
104:         // If it's a wrapper, check nested objects for stats
105:         for (const val of Object.values(parsed)) {
106:           if (val && typeof val === 'object' && !Array.isArray(val)) {
107:             const nestedKeys = Object.keys(val);
108:             if (VALID_STATS.some((k) => nestedKeys.includes(k))) {
109:               return val;
110:             }
111:           }
112:         }
113:       }
114:     } catch {}
115:   }
116: 
117:   // Second pass: return first parseable candidate
118:   for (const c of candidates) {
119:     try { return JSON.parse(c); } catch {}
120:   }
121: 
122:   return null;
123: }
124: 
125: export function validateAndFixStats(raw: any, options: { forceSum72?: boolean } = {}): StatsRecord {
126:   const result: StatsRecord = {
127:     STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10,
128:   };
129: 
130:   for (const s of VALID_STATS) {
131:     const rawValue = raw?.[s];
132:     const num = Number(rawValue);
133:     const val = Number.isFinite(num) ? Math.round(num) : 10;
134:     result[s] = val;
135:   }
136: 
137:   if (options.forceSum72) {
138:     let sum = 0;
139:     for (const s of VALID_STATS) sum += result[s];
140:     const diff = 72 - sum;
141:     if (diff !== 0) {
142:       let adjustStat: StatKey = "STR";
143:       let maxDist = 0;
144:       for (const s of VALID_STATS) {
145:         const dist = Math.abs(result[s] - 10);
146:         if (dist > maxDist) {
147:           maxDist = dist;
148:           adjustStat = s;
149:         }
150:       }
151:       result[adjustStat] = result[adjustStat] + diff;
152:     }
153:   }
154: 
155:   return result;
156: }
157: 
158: export function calculateDerivedStats(stats = {}, race = 'Человек', equipment = [], raceAcBonus) {
159:   const safeStats = validateAndFixStats(stats);
160:   const initiative = Math.floor(((safeStats.DEX || 10) - 10) / 2);
161:   const dexMod = Math.floor(((safeStats.DEX || 10) - 10) / 2);
162:   const raceBonus = Number(raceAcBonus ?? 0);
163:   const equipmentBonus = Array.isArray(equipment)
164:     ? equipment.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (Number(item.ac_bonus) || 0), 0)
165:     : 0;
166:   const armorClass = 10 + dexMod + raceBonus + equipmentBonus;
167:   const savingThrows = {};
168:   for (const s of VALID_STATS) {
169:     const mod = Math.floor(((safeStats[s] || 10) - 10) / 2);
170:     savingThrows[s] = mod + 2;
171:   }
172:   return {
173:     stats: safeStats,
174:     initiative,
175:     armor_class: armorClass,
176:     saving_throws: savingThrows,
177:   };
178: }

 58: export function calculateHpFromStats(stats = {}, level = 1, hitDie = 8) {
 59:   const con = stats && typeof stats.CON === 'number' ? stats.CON : 10;
 60:   // D&D система: уровень 1 = макс кости + CON mod + 10, каждый следующий = среднее + CON mod
 61:   return calculateHpDnd(con, level, hitDie);
 62: }
 63: 
 64: export function calculateInitiative(stats = {}) {
 65:   const dex = stats && typeof stats.DEX === 'number' ? stats.DEX : 10;
 66:   return Math.floor((dex - 10) / 2);
 67: }
 68: 
 69: export function calculateArmorClass(stats = {}, race = 'Человек', equipment = []) {
 70:   const dex = stats && typeof stats.DEX === 'number' ? stats.DEX : 10;
 71:   const dexMod = Math.floor((dex - 10) / 2);
 72: 
 73:   const raceBonusMap = {
 74:     'Эльф': 0,
 75:     'Дварф': 1,
 76:     'Гном': 1,
 77:     'Полурослик': 1,
 78:     'Тифлинг': 0,
 79:     'Драконорожденный': 0,
 80:   };
 81: 
 82:   const equipmentBonus = Array.isArray(equipment)
 83:     ? equipment.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (Number(item.ac_bonus) || 0), 0)
 84:     : 0;
 85: 
 86:   const baseAC = 10;
 87:   const raceBonus = Number(raceBonusMap[race] || 0);
 88:   return baseAC + dexMod + raceBonus + equipmentBonus;
 89: }
 90: 
 91: export function calculateSavingThrows(stats = {}, proficiencyBonus = 2) {
 92:   const result = {};
 93: 
 94:   const statKeys = ['STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA'];
 95:   for (const stat of statKeys) {
 96:     const value = stats && typeof stats[stat] === 'number' ? stats[stat] : 10;
 97:     const mod = Math.floor((value - 10) / 2);
 98:     result[stat] = mod + proficiencyBonus;
 99:   }
100: 
101:   return result;
102: }
103: 
104: export function validateAndFixStats(raw, options = {}) {
105:   const result = {
106:     STR: 10,
107:     DEX: 10,
108:     CON: 10,
109:     INT: 10,
110:     WIS: 10,
111:     CHA: 10,
112:   };
113: 
114:   const validStats = ['STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA'];
115:   for (const s of validStats) {
116:     const rawValue = raw?.[s];
117:     const num = Number(rawValue);
118:     const val = Number.isFinite(num) ? Math.round(num) : 10;
119:     result[s] = val;
120:   }
121: 
122:   if (options.forceSum72) {
123:     let sum = 0;
124:     for (const s of validStats) sum += result[s];
125:     const diff = 72 - sum;
126:     if (diff !== 0) {
127:       let adjustStat = 'STR';
128:       let maxDist = 0;
129:       for (const s of validStats) {
130:         const dist = Math.abs(result[s] - 10);
131:         if (dist > maxDist) {
132:           maxDist = dist;
133:           adjustStat = s;
134:         }
135:       }
136:       result[adjustStat] = result[adjustStat] + diff;
137:     }
138:   }
139: 
140:   return result;
141: }
142: 
143: export function calculateDerivedStats(stats = {}, race = 'Человек', equipment = [], raceAcBonus) {
144:   const safeStats = validateAndFixStats(stats);
145:   const initiative = Math.floor(((safeStats.DEX || 10) - 10) / 2);
146:   const dexMod = Math.floor(((safeStats.DEX || 10) - 10) / 2);
147:   const raceBonus = Number(raceAcBonus ?? 0);
148:   const equipmentBonus = Array.isArray(equipment)
149:     ? equipment.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (Number(item.ac_bonus) || 0), 0)
150:     : 0;
151:   const armorClass = 10 + dexMod + raceBonus + equipmentBonus;
152:   const savingThrows = {};
153:   for (const s of ['STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA']) {
154:     const mod = Math.floor(((safeStats[s] || 10) - 10) / 2);
155:     savingThrows[s] = mod + 2;
156:   }
157:   return {
158:     stats: safeStats,
159:     initiative,
160:     armor_class: armorClass,
161:     saving_throws: savingThrows,
162:   };
163: }
164: 
165: export function getRaceAcBonus(race) {
166:   const map = {
167:     'Эльф': 0,
168:     'Дварф': 1,
169:     'Гном': 1,
170:     'Полурослик': 1,
171:     'Тифлинг': 0,
172:     'Драконорожденный': 0,
173:   };
174:   return Number(map[race] ?? 0);
175: }

File: supabase/functions/convert-world-text/index.ts

  1: // supabase/functions/convert-world-text/index.ts
  2: // Конвертирует текстовое описание мира в структурированный JSON
  3: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
  4: import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";
  5: import { sanitizeKey, cleanTextForAI, parseAIJson } from "../_shared/utils.ts";
  6: 
  7: const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
  8: const SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
  9: const FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY = Deno.env.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY") || "";
 10: const AI_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.5";
 11: 
 12: const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `Ты — D&D-дизайнер мира. Твоя задача: проанализировать текстовое описание ролевого мира и превратить его в структурированный JSON-объект настроек.
 13: 
 14: Извлеки из текста:
 15: - Доступные расы (races)
 16: - Доступные классы (classes)
 17: - Глобальные лимиты (max_level, starting_gold и т.д.)
 18: - Локации/регионы (locations)
 19: - Фракции (factions)
 20: - Ключевые правила дома (house_rules)
 21: 
 22: Формат ответа — ТОЛЬКО валидный JSON без markdown:
 23: 
 24: {
 25:   "races": ["Человек", "Эльф"],
 26:   "classes": ["Воин", "Маг", "Плут"],
 27:   "max_level": 20,
 28:   "starting_gold": 100,
 29:   "locations": ["Город Теней", "Лес Древних"],
 30:   "factions": ["Стражи Рассвета", "Теневая Лига"],
 31:   "house_rules": ["Криты наносят двойной урон"],
 32:   "description_summary": "Краткое описание (1-2 предложения)"
 33: }
 34: 
 35: Если какая-то информация отсутствует в тексте — поставь пустой массив или значение по умолчанию.
 36: ВСЁ на русском языке.`;
 37: 
 38: const CORS = {
 39:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
 40:   "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-client-info, apikey",
 41:   "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
 42: };
 43: 
 44: serve(async (req) => {
 45:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 46:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 47:   }
 48: 
 49:   try {
 50:     const { user_id, world_name, description } = await req.json();
 51: 
 52:     const safeDescription = cleanTextForAI(description);
 53: 
 54:     console.log('convert-world-text input:', { user_id, world_name, description: safeDescription });
 55: 
 56:     const imagePattern = /\b(image|img|photo|picture|avatar|icon|base64|data)\b[\s\S]*?\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|bmp|svg)\b/gi;
 57:     if (safeDescription && new RegExp(imagePattern.source, imagePattern.flags).test(safeDescription)) {
 58:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Обнаружены ссылки на изображения. Удалите их и попробуйте снова." }), {
 59:         status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 60:       });
 61:     }
 62: 
 63:     if (!user_id || !world_name || !safeDescription) {
 64:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "user_id, world_name и description обязательны" }), {
 65:         status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 66:       });
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
 70: 
 71:     let apiKey = sanitizeKey(FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY);
 72:     const { data: userSettings } = await supabase
 73:       .from("user_settings")
 74:       .select("openrouter_key")
 75:       .eq("id", user_id)
 76:       .maybeSingle();
 77:     if (userSettings?.openrouter_key) apiKey = sanitizeKey(userSettings.openrouter_key);
 78: 
 79:     if (!apiKey) {
 80:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
 81:         error: "Укажите OpenRouter API Key в настройках аккаунта",
 82:         code: "MISSING_API_KEY",
 83:       }), { status: 402, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
 84:     }
 85: 
 86:     const userMessage = `Мир: "${world_name}"\n\nОписание:\n${safeDescription}`;
 87: 
 88:     const aiRes = await fetch("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", {
 89:       method: "POST",
 90:       headers: {
 91:         "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
 92:         "Content-Type": "application/json",
 93:       },
 94:       body: JSON.stringify({
 95:         model: AI_MODEL,
 96:         messages: [
 97:           { role: "system", content: SYSTEM_PROMPT },
 98:           { role: "user", content: userMessage },
 99:         ],
100:         temperature: 0.5,
101:         max_tokens: 1500,
102:       }),
103:     });
104: 
105:     console.log('convert-world-text OpenRouter status:', aiRes.status);
106: 
107:     if (!aiRes.ok) {
108:       const errText = await aiRes.text();
109:       console.error("AI error:", errText);
110:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Ошибка AI API" }), {
111:         status: 502, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
112:       });
113:     }
114: 
115:     const aiData = await aiRes.json();
116:     const rawContent = aiData.choices[0].message.content || "";
117:     console.log('convert-world-text AI raw:', rawContent);
118: 
119:     let settings = null;
120:     try { settings = parseAIJson(rawContent); } catch {}
121:     if (!settings) {
122:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Не удалось распарсить ответ ИИ", raw: rawContent }), {
123:         status: 422, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
124:       });
125:     }
126: 
127:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({ settings }), {
128:       status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
129:     });
130: 
131:   } catch (err) {
132:     console.error("convert-world-text error:", err);
133:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || "Internal error" }), {
134:       status: 500, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
135:     });
136:   }
137: });

================
File: supabase/functions/generate-world-npcs/index.ts
