 13: function sanitizeAIText(raw) {
 14:   if (!raw) return "";
 15:   let text = String(raw);
 16:   text = text.replace(/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]/g, "");
 17:   text = text.replace(/[^\u0009\u000A\u000D\u0020-\u007E\u00A0-\u00FF\u0400-\u04FF]/g, "");
 18:   text = text.replace(/\b(image|img|photo|picture|avatar|icon|base64|data)\b[\s\S]*?\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|bmp|svg)\b/gi, "");
 19:   text = text.replace(/[A-Za-z0-9+\/]{20,}={0,2}/g, "");
 20:   text = text.replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/g, "");
 21:   text = text.replace(/[A-Za-z]:\\[^\s]+/g, "");
 22:   text = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
 23:   if (text.length > 4000) text = text.slice(0, 4000);
 24:   return text;
 25: }
 26: 
 27: export async function renderGame(container, sessionId, user) {
 28:   let session = null;
 29:   let currentPlayer = null;
 30:   let allPlayers = [];
 31:   let messages = [];
 32:   let activePanel = null; // 'profile' | 'inventory' | 'settings' | null
 33:   let isSubmitting = false;
 34:   let isMyTurn = true; // По умолчанию разрешаем ввод
 35:   let unsubMessages = null;
 36:   let unsubPlayers = null;
 37:   let unsubTurnQueue = null;
 38: 
 39:   // ============================================
 40:   // ТУМАН ВОЙНЫ: фильтр видимости сообщений
 41:   // Персональные сообщения Мастера (с metadata.target_player_id)
 42:   // видны ТОЛЬКО указанному игроку. Глобальный нарратив (без target)
 43:   // и системные сообщения видят все.
 44:   // ============================================
 45:   function isMessageVisibleToCurrentPlayer(msg) {
 46:     if (!msg) return false;
 47: 
 48:     // Системные сообщения — все
 49:     if (msg.sender_type === 'system') return true;
 50: 
 51:     // Свои действия видит только автор
 52:     if (msg.sender_type === 'player') {
 53:       return msg.sender_id === user.id;
 54:     }
 55: 
 56:     // Сообщения Мастера: проверяем target_player_id
 57:     if (msg.sender_type === 'master') {
 58:       const targetPlayerId = msg.metadata?.target_player_id;
 59:       // Глобальный лог (нет таргета, или явный флаг is_global)
 60:       if (!targetPlayerId || msg.metadata?.is_global === true) {
 61:         return true;
 62:       }
 63:       // Персональный нарратив — только адресату
 64:       return currentPlayer && targetPlayerId === currentPlayer.id;
 65:     }
 66: 
 67:     return false;
 68:   }
 69: 
 70:   async function load() {
 71:     try {
 72:       session = await getSession(sessionId);
 73:       allPlayers = await getSessionPlayers(sessionId);
 74:       currentPlayer = allPlayers.find((p) => p.user_id === user.id) || allPlayers[0];
 75:       messages = await getSessionMessages(sessionId);
 76: 
 77:       // Проверяем очередь ходов при загрузке
 78:       await checkTurnQueue();
 79:     } catch (err) {
 80:       toast.error('Ошибка загрузки: ' + err.message);
 81:       router.navigate('/');
 82:       return;
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     if (!currentPlayer) {
 86:       renderCharacterCreation();
 87:       return;
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     render();
 91:     subscribeRealtime();
 92:   }
 93: 
 94:   // ============================================
 95:   // ОЧЕРЕДЬ ХОДОВ: проверка и подписка
 96:   // ============================================
 97:   async function checkTurnQueue() {
 98:     if (!currentPlayer) return;
 99: 
100:     // Если в сессии 1 игрок — всегда его ход
101:     if (allPlayers.length <= 1) {
102:       isMyTurn = true;
103:       return;
104:     }
105: 
106:     try {
107:       const currentTurn = await getCurrentTurn(sessionId);
108:       if (currentTurn) {
109:         isMyTurn = currentTurn.player_id === currentPlayer.id;
110:       } else {
111:         // Нет активного хода — разрешаем ввод (первый ход)
112:         isMyTurn = true;
113:       }
114:     } catch {
115:       isMyTurn = true;
116:     }
117:   }
118: 
119:   function subscribeRealtime() {
120:     unsubMessages = subscribeToSessionMessages(sessionId, (payload) => {
121:       if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT') {
122:         const msg = payload.new;
123:         // Добавляем в массив (для истории), но рисуем только то, что видно
124:         messages.push(msg);
125:         if (isMessageVisibleToCurrentPlayer(msg)) {
126:           appendMessage(msg);
127:         }
128:       }
129:     });
130: 
131:     unsubPlayers = subscribeToSessionPlayers(sessionId, (payload) => {
132:       if (payload.eventType === 'UPDATE') {
133:         const idx = allPlayers.findIndex((p) => p.id === payload.new.id);
134:         if (idx >= 0) allPlayers[idx] = { ...allPlayers[idx], ...payload.new };
135:         if (currentPlayer && currentPlayer.id === payload.new.id) {
136:           currentPlayer = { ...currentPlayer, ...payload.new };
137:           updatePlayerUI();
138:         }
139:       }
140:     });
141: 
142:     // Подписка на очередь ходов
143:     unsubTurnQueue = supabase
144:       .channel(`realtime:turn_queue:${sessionId}`)
145:       .on(
146:         'postgres_changes',
147:         {
148:           event: '*',
149:           schema: 'public',
150:           table: 'turn_queue',
151:           filter: `session_id=eq.${sessionId}`,
152:         },
153:         (payload) => {
154:           handleTurnUpdate(payload);
155:         }
156:       )
157:       .subscribe();
158:   }
159: 
160:   function handleTurnUpdate(payload) {
161:     if (!currentPlayer) return;
162: 
163:     if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT' || payload.eventType === 'UPDATE') {
164:       const turn = payload.new;
165:       if (turn.status === 'active') {
166:         const wasMyTurn = isMyTurn;
167:         isMyTurn = turn.player_id === currentPlayer.id;
168: 
169:         // Снимаем блокировку, когда наступает наш ход
170:         if (!wasMyTurn && isMyTurn) {
171:           toast.info('Ваш ход!');
172:         }
173: 
174:         updateInputState();
175:       }
176:     }
177: 
178:     // Если все ходы завершены — разрешаем ввод
179:     if (payload.eventType === 'DELETE') {
180:       isMyTurn = true;
181:       updateInputState();
182:     }
183:   }
184: 
185:   function updateInputState() {
186:     const input = document.getElementById('actionInput');
187:     const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
188:     if (!input || !sendBtn) return;
189: 
190:     if (!isMyTurn || isSubmitting) {
191:       input.disabled = true;
192:       input.placeholder = 'Ожидание действий напарника...';
193:       sendBtn.disabled = true;
194:     } else {
195:       input.disabled = false;
196:       input.placeholder = 'Опишите действие вашего героя...';
197:       sendBtn.disabled = false;
198:     }
199:   }
200: 
201:   function render() {
202:     const safeMaxHp = Math.max(1, currentPlayer?.max_hp || 1);
203:     const hpPercent = currentPlayer
204:       ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (currentPlayer.hp / safeMaxHp) * 100))
205:       : 100;
206:     const hpClass = hpPercent > 50 ? '' : hpPercent > 25 ? 'low' : 'critical';
207:     
208:     // Format game time
209:     const gameTime = session.game_time || {};
210:     const timeStr = gameTime.day && gameTime.month && gameTime.year 
211:       ? `${gameTime.day}.${gameTime.month}.${gameTime.year} ${gameTime.hour || 0}:${(gameTime.minute || 0).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`
212:       : '';
213:     const locationStr = session.current_location_name || '';
214: 
215:     container.innerHTML = `
216:       <div class="game-page">
217:         <!-- Header -->
218:         <header class="game-header">
219:           <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" id="backBtn" title="Лобби">←</button>
220:           <div class="game-header-center">
221:             <span class="game-header-name">${currentPlayer?.name || 'Герой'}</span>
222:             <div class="hp-bar-container">
223:               <div class="hp-bar ${hpClass}" style="width: ${hpPercent}%"></div>
224:             </div>
225:             <span class="game-header-hp">${currentPlayer?.hp || 0}/${currentPlayer?.max_hp || 0}</span>
226:             ${timeStr ? `<span class="game-header-time">🕐 ${timeStr}</span>` : ''}
227:             ${locationStr ? `<span class="game-header-location">📍 ${locationStr}</span>` : ''}
228:           </div>
229:           <div class="game-header-actions">
230:             <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" id="profileBtn" title="Профиль">👤</button>
231:             <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" id="inventoryBtn" title="Инвентарь">🎒</button>
232:             <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" id="settingsBtn" title="Настройки">⚙️</button>
233:           </div>
234:         </header>
235: 
236:         <!-- Chat Zone -->
237:         <main class="game-chat" id="gameChat">
238:           <div class="chat-messages" id="chatMessages">
239:             ${messages.length
240:               ? messages
241:                   .filter(isMessageVisibleToCurrentPlayer)
242:                   .map(renderMessage)
243:                   .join('')
244:               : `
245:               <div class="chat-empty">
246:                 <div class="empty-icon">📜</div>
247:                 <p>История пока пуста. Начните действие!</p>
248:               </div>
249:             `}
250:           </div>
251:         </main>
252: 
253:         <!-- Input Area -->
254:         <footer class="game-input-area">
255:           <div class="game-input-wrapper">
256:             <textarea
257:               class="game-input"
258:               id="actionInput"
259:               placeholder="${isMyTurn ? 'Опишите действие вашего героя...' : 'Ожидание действий напарника...'}"
260:               rows="1"
261:               ${isSubmitting || !isMyTurn ? 'disabled' : ''}
262:             ></textarea>
263:             <button class="btn btn-primary btn-icon" id="sendBtn" ${isSubmitting || !isMyTurn ? 'disabled' : ''}>
264:               ${isSubmitting ? '⏳' : '▶'}
265:             </button>
266:           </div>
267:         </footer>
268: 
269:         <!-- Side Panels -->
270:         <div class="side-panel-overlay ${activePanel ? 'open' : ''}" id="panelOverlay"></div>
271: 
272:         <!-- Profile Panel -->
273:         <div class="side-panel ${activePanel === 'profile' ? 'open' : ''}" id="profilePanel">
274:           <div class="side-panel-header">
275:             <h2>👤 Профиль</h2>
276:             <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" id="closeProfileBtn">✕</button>
277:           </div>
278:           <div class="side-panel-content" id="profileContent">
279:             ${currentPlayer ? renderProfile(currentPlayer) : ''}
280:           </div>
281:         </div>
282: 
283:         <!-- Inventory Panel -->
284:         <div class="side-panel ${activePanel === 'inventory' ? 'open' : ''}" id="inventoryPanel">
285:           <div class="side-panel-header">
286:             <h2>🎒 Инвентарь</h2>
287:             <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" id="closeInventoryBtn">✕</button>
288:           </div>
289:           <div class="side-panel-content" id="inventoryContent">
290:             ${currentPlayer ? renderInventory(currentPlayer) : ''}
291:           </div>
292:         </div>
293: 
294:         <!-- Settings Panel -->
295:         <div class="side-panel ${activePanel === 'settings' ? 'open' : ''}" id="settingsPanel">
296:           <div class="side-panel-header">
297:             <h2>⚙️ Сессия</h2>
298:             <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-icon" id="closeSettingsBtn">✕</button>
299:           </div>
300:           <div class="side-panel-content">
301:             ${renderSessionSettings(session)}
302:           </div>
303:         </div>
304:       </div>
305:     `;
306: 
307:     bindEvents();
308:     scrollToBottom();
309:   }
310: 
311:   function renderMessage(msg) {
312:     if (msg.sender_type === 'master') {
313:       return `
314:         <div class="message message-master">
315:           <div class="message-avatar">🎭</div>
316:           <div class="message-body">
317:             <div class="message-text">${escapeHtml(msg.content)}</div>
318:           </div>
319:         </div>
320:       `;
321:     }
322: 
323:     if (msg.sender_type === 'system') {
324:       return `
325:         <div class="message message-system">
326:           <div class="message-text">${escapeHtml(msg.content)}</div>
327:         </div>
328:       `;
329:     }
330: 
331:     // Сообщения игроков: показываем ТОЛЬКО свои
332:     if (msg.sender_type === 'player') {
333:       if (msg.sender_id === user.id) {
334:         return `
335:           <div class="message message-self">
336:             <div class="message-body">
337:               <div class="message-text">${escapeHtml(msg.content)}</div>
338:             </div>
339:             <div class="message-avatar">⚔️</div>
340:           </div>
341:         `;
342:       }
343:       return ''; // Чужие сообщения скрыты
344:     }
345: 
346:     return '';
347:   }
348: 
349:   function renderProfile(player) {
350:     if (!player) return '';
351:     const stats = player.stats || {};
352:     const safeMaxHp = Math.max(1, player.max_hp || 1);
353:     const hpRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (player.hp || 0) / safeMaxHp));
354:     const hpClass = hpRatio > 0.5 ? '' : hpRatio > 0.25 ? 'low' : 'critical';
355:     const hpPct = hpRatio * 100;
356:     const statsHtml = STATS.map((stat) => {
357:       const baseValue = stats[stat] || 10;
358:       const injuryPenalty = (player.injuries || [])
359:         .filter(i => !i.cured_at && i.stat_penalties?.[stat])
360:         .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (Number(i.stat_penalties[stat]) || 0), 0);
361:       const displayValue = baseValue + injuryPenalty;
362:       return `
363:         <div class="stat-card">
364:           <div class="stat-card-label">${stat}</div>
365:           <div class="stat-card-value">${displayValue}</div>
366:           <div class="stat-card-modifier">${Math.floor((displayValue - 10) / 2) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.floor((displayValue - 10) / 2)}</div>
367:         </div>
368:       `;
369:     }).join('');
370: 
371:     const derived = calculateDerivedStats(stats, player.race || 'Человек', player.inventory || [], player.race_ac_bonus);
372:     const initiative = derived.initiative;
373:     const armorClass = derived.armor_class;
374:     const savingThrows = derived.saving_throws;
375:     const savingThrowsHtml = STATS.map((stat) => {
376:       const baseMod = Math.floor(((stats[stat] || 10) - 10) / 2);
377:       const injuryPenalty = (player.injuries || [])
378:         .filter(i => !i.cured_at && i.stat_penalties?.[stat])
379:         .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (Number(i.stat_penalties[stat]) || 0), 0);
380:       const totalMod = baseMod + 2 + injuryPenalty;
381:       return `
382:         <div class="stat-card">
383:           <div class="stat-card-label">${stat}</div>
384:           <div class="stat-card-value">${totalMod >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${totalMod}</div>
385:         </div>
386:       `;
387:     }).join('');
388: 
389:     const activeInjuries = (player.injuries || []).filter(i => !i.cured_at);
390:     const injuriesHtml = activeInjuries.length ? `
391:       <div class="profile-section">
392:         <h4 class="profile-section-title">⚠️ Травмы</h4>
393:         ${activeInjuries.map(injury => `
394:           <div class="profile-injuries" style="margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
395:             <div style="font-weight: 600;">${escapeHtml(injury.injury_type)}</div>
396:             <div style="font-size: var(--fs-sm); margin-top: 0.25rem;">${escapeHtml(injury.description || '')}</div>
397:             ${injury.stat_penalties && Object.keys(injury.stat_penalties).length > 0 ? `
398:               <div style="font-size: var(--fs-xs); margin-top: 0.25rem; color: var(--text-muted);">
399:                 Штрафы: ${Object.entries(injury.stat_penalties).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${Number(v) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Number(v)}`).join(', ')}
400:               </div>
401:             ` : ''}
402:             ${injury.duration_hours ? `<div style="font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-muted);">Длительность: ${injury.duration_hours}ч</div>` : ''}
403:             ${injury.is_permanent ? '<div style="font-size: var(--fs-xs); font-weight: 600;">Постоянная</div>' : ''}
404:           </div>
405:         `).join('')}
406:       </div>
407:     ` : '';
408: 
409:     return `
410:       <div class="profile-card">
411:         <div class="profile-avatar">⚔️</div>
412:         <h3 class="profile-name">${escapeHtml(player.name)}</h3>
413:         <p class="profile-meta">${escapeHtml(player.race || '')} / ${escapeHtml(player.class || '')}</p>
414: 
415:         <div class="profile-section" style="width: 100%;">
416:           <div class="hp-bar-container" style="height: 16px;">
417:             <div class="hp-bar ${hpClass}"
418:                  style="width: ${hpPct}%"></div>
419:           </div>
420:           <p style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: var(--fs-base); font-weight: 600;">
421:             ❤️ ${player.hp} / ${player.max_hp}
422:           </p>
423:           <p style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.25rem; font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--accent-gold);">
424:             💰 ${player.money || 0} золота
425:           </p>
426:         </div>
427: 
428:         <div class="profile-section" style="width: 100%;">
429:           <h4 class="profile-section-title">Характеристики</h4>
430:           <div class="stats-grid-3">
431:             ${statsHtml}
432:           </div>
433:         </div>
434: 
435:         <div class="profile-section" style="width: 100%;">
436:           <div class="stats-grid-3">
437:             <div class="stat-card">
438:               <div class="stat-card-label">Инициатива</div>
439:               <div class="stat-card-value">${initiative >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${initiative}</div>
440:             </div>
441:             <div class="stat-card">
442:               <div class="stat-card-label">AC</div>
443:               <div class="stat-card-value">${armorClass}</div>
444:             </div>
445:           </div>
446:         </div>
447: 
448:         <div class="profile-section" style="width: 100%;">
449:           <h4 class="profile-section-title">Спасброски</h4>
450:           <div class="stats-grid-3">
451:             ${savingThrowsHtml}
452:           </div>
453:         </div>
454: 
455:         ${injuriesHtml}
456: 
457:         ${player.appearance ? `
458:           <div class="profile-section" style="width: 100%;">
459:             <h4 class="profile-section-title">Внешность</h4>
460:             <p class="profile-bio">${escapeHtml(player.appearance)}</p>
461:           </div>
462:         ` : ''}
463: 
464:         ${player.bio ? `
465:           <div class="profile-section" style="width: 100%;">
466:             <h4 class="profile-section-title">Биография</h4>
467:             <p class="profile-bio">${escapeHtml(player.bio)}</p>
468:           </div>
469:         ` : ''}
470:       </div>
471:     `;
472:   }
473: 
474:   function renderInventory(player) {
475:     const inventory = player.inventory || [];
476:     const totalWeight = inventory.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.quantity || 1), 0);
477: 
478:     return `
479:       <div class="inventory-content">
480:         <div class="inventory-summary">
481:           <span>💰 ${player.money || 0} золота</span>
482:           <span>📦 ${totalWeight} предметов</span>
483:         </div>
484: 
485:         <div class="inventory-list">
486:           ${inventory.length ? inventory.map((item) => `
487:             <div class="inventory-item">
488:               <div class="inventory-item-info">
489:                 <div class="inventory-item-name">${escapeHtml(item.item_name)}</div>
490:                 <div class="inventory-item-meta">
491:                   <span class="badge badge-${item.type === 'weapon' ? 'primary' : item.type === 'armor' ? 'info' : 'gold'}">${item.type}</span>
492:                   ${item.quantity > 1 ? `<span>x${item.quantity}</span>` : ''}
493:                 </div>
494:               </div>
495:               ${item.attributes ? `
496:                 <div class="inventory-item-stats text-muted" style="font-size: var(--fs-xs);">
497:                   ${Object.entries(item.attributes).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${v}`).join(', ')}
498:                 </div>
499:               ` : ''}
500:             </div>
501:           `).join('') : `
502:             <div class="empty-state">
503:               <p class="text-muted">Инвентарь пуст</p>
504:             </div>
505:           `}
506:         </div>
507:       </div>
508:     `;
509:   }
510: 
511:   function renderSessionSettings(session) {
512:     return `
513:       <div class="session-info">
514:         <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
515:           <label class="form-label">Мир</label>
516:           <p>${session.worlds?.name || 'Не задан'}</p>
517:         </div>
518:         <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
519:           <label class="form-label">Сложность</label>
520:           <p>${session.difficulty === 'easy' ? 'Легко' : session.difficulty === 'hard' ? 'Хардкор' : 'Нормально'}</p>
521:         </div>
522:         <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
523:           <label class="form-label">PvP</label>
524:           <p>${session.is_pvp_enabled ? '⚔️ Включено' : '🛡️ Выключено'}</p>
525:         </div>
526:         <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
527:           <label class="form-label">Режим</label>
528:           <p>${session.current_plot_stage ? `📖 Сюжет (${session.current_plot_stage})` : '🎭 Песочница'}</p>
529:         </div>
530:         <div class="form-group">
531:           <label class="form-label">Участники (${allPlayers.length})</label>
532:           <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; margin-top: 0.5rem;">
533:             ${allPlayers.map((p) => `
534:               <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;">
535:                 <span style="width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-success);"></span>
536:                 <span style="font-size: var(--fs-sm);">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</span>
537:                 <span class="text-muted" style="font-size: var(--fs-xs);">${p.race}/${p.class}</span>
538:               </div>
539:             `).join('')}
540:           </div>
541:         </div>
542:       </div>
543:     `;
544:   }
545: 
546:   function bindEvents() {
547:     // Back
548:     document.getElementById('backBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => router.navigate('/'));
549: 
550:     // Panel toggles
551:     document.getElementById('profileBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => togglePanel('profile'));
552:     document.getElementById('inventoryBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => togglePanel('inventory'));
553:     document.getElementById('settingsBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => togglePanel('settings'));
554: 
555:     // Close panels
556:     document.getElementById('closeProfileBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => togglePanel(null));
557:     document.getElementById('closeInventoryBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => togglePanel(null));
558:     document.getElementById('closeSettingsBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => togglePanel(null));
559:     document.getElementById('panelOverlay')?.addEventListener('click', () => togglePanel(null));
560: 
561:     // Auto-resize textarea
562:     const input = document.getElementById('actionInput');
563:     input?.addEventListener('input', () => {
564:       input.style.height = 'auto';
565:       input.style.height = Math.min(input.scrollHeight, 120) + 'px';
566:     });
567: 
568:     // Submit action
569:     document.getElementById('sendBtn')?.addEventListener('click', handleSend);
570:     input?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
571:       if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
572:         e.preventDefault();
573:         handleSend();
574:       }
575:     });
576: 
577:     // Export player
578:     document.getElementById('exportPlayerBtn')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
579:       if (!currentPlayer) return;
580:       try {
581:         const data = await exportPlayer(currentPlayer.id);
582:         downloadJSON(data, `${currentPlayer.name}_character.json`);
583:         toast.success('Персонаж экспортирован!');
584:       } catch (err) {
585:         toast.error('Ошибка экспорта: ' + err.message);
586:       }
587:     });
588:   }
589: 
590:   function togglePanel(panel) {
591:     activePanel = activePanel === panel ? null : panel;
592:     render();
593:   }
594: 
595:   async function handleSend() {
596:     if (isSubmitting || !currentPlayer || !isMyTurn) return;
597: 
598:     const input = document.getElementById('actionInput');
599:     const text = input?.value?.trim();
600:     if (!text) return;
601: 
602:     isSubmitting = true;
603:     input.value = '';
604:     input.style.height = 'auto';
605:     updateInputState();
606: 
607:     try {
608:       const result = await submitAction(sessionId, currentPlayer.id, sanitizeAIText(text));
609: 
610:       if (result.status === 'clarification_needed' && result.clarification_msg) {
611:         toast.warning(result.clarification_msg);
612:         return;
613:       }
614: 
615:       if (result.error) {
616:         toast.error(result.error);
617:         return;
618:       }
619: 
620:       if (result.rest_result?.is_rest) {
621:         const restInfo = result.rest_result;
622:         let restMessage = `Отдых: ${restInfo.rest_quality || 'normal'} (${restInfo.rest_duration_hours || 0}ч)`;
623:         if (restInfo.hp_recovery) {
624:           restMessage += `. Восстановлено HP: ${restInfo.hp_recovery}`;
625:         }
626:         if (restInfo.injuries?.length) {
627:           restMessage += `. Получены травмы: ${restInfo.injuries.map(i => i.type).join(', ')}`;
628:         }
629:         toast.info(restMessage);
630: 
631:         if (restInfo.new_hp !== undefined) {
632:           currentPlayer = { ...currentPlayer, hp: restInfo.new_hp };
633:         }
634:         if (restInfo.injuries?.length) {
635:           currentPlayer = {
636:             ...currentPlayer,
637:             injuries: [...(currentPlayer.injuries || []), ...restInfo.injuries],
638:           };
639:         }
640:         render();
641:       }
642: 
643:       if (result.hp_change) {
644:         currentPlayer = { ...currentPlayer, hp: (currentPlayer.hp || 0) + result.hp_change };
645:         render();
646:       }
647:     } catch (err) {
648:       if (err.message === 'MISSING_API_KEY') {
649:         toast.error('Не задан OpenRouter API Key. Откройте «⚙️ Аккаунт» в лобби и введите ключ.');
650:       } else {
651:         toast.error('Ошибка обработки: ' + err.message);
652:       }
653:     } finally {
654:       isSubmitting = false;
655:       updateInputState();
656:     }
657:   }
658: 
659:   function appendMessage(msg) {
660:     // ТУМАН ВОЙНЫ: единая функция проверки видимости
661:     if (!isMessageVisibleToCurrentPlayer(msg)) return;
662: 
663:     const chatMessages = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
664:     if (!chatMessages) return;
665: 
666:     // Remove empty state if present
667:     const empty = chatMessages.querySelector('.chat-empty');
668:     if (empty) empty.remove();
669: 
670:     const html = renderMessage(msg);
671:     if (!html) return;
672: 
673:     const div = document.createElement('div');
674:     div.innerHTML = html;
675:     chatMessages.appendChild(div.firstElementChild);
676:     scrollToBottom();
677:   }
678: 
679:   function updatePlayerUI() {
680:     if (!currentPlayer) return;
681:     const hpBar = document.querySelector('.hp-bar');
682:     const hpText = document.querySelector('.game-header-hp');
683:     if (hpBar && currentPlayer) {
684:       const safeMaxHp = Math.max(1, currentPlayer.max_hp || 1);
685:       const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ((currentPlayer.hp || 0) / safeMaxHp) * 100));
686:       hpBar.style.width = pct + '%';
687:       hpBar.className = 'hp-bar ' + (pct > 50 ? '' : pct > 25 ? 'low' : 'critical');
688:     }
689:     if (hpText && currentPlayer) {
690:       hpText.textContent = `${currentPlayer.hp}/${currentPlayer.max_hp}`;
691:     }
692:   }
693: 
694:   function scrollToBottom() {
695:     const chat = document.getElementById('gameChat');
696:     if (chat) {
697:       requestAnimationFrame(() => {
698:         chat.scrollTop = chat.scrollHeight;
699:       });
700:     }
701:   }
702: 
703:   function escapeHtml(text) {
704:     if (!text) return '';
705:     const div = document.createElement('div');
706:     div.textContent = text;
707:     return div.innerHTML;
708:   }
709: 
710:     // Character creation / selection screen
711:   function renderCharacterCreation() {
712:     // Try to load existing cards
713:     getCharacterCards(user.id).then((cards) => {
714:       const cardsEl = document.getElementById('existingCardsList');
715:       if (cardsEl && cards.length) {
716:         cardsEl.innerHTML = cards.map((c) => {
717:           const stats = c.stats || {};
718:           const total = Object.values(stats).reduce((s, v) => s + (v || 0), 0);
719:           return `
720:             <div class="card char-select-card" data-card-id="${c.id}">
721:               <div class="card-header">
722:                 <h3 style="font-weight: 700;">⚔️ ${c.name}</h3>
723:                 <span class="badge badge-info">${c.race} / ${c.class}</span>
724:               </div>
725:               <p class="form-hint">❤️ ${c.hp}/${c.max_hp} &nbsp;•&nbsp; 💰 ${c.money} &nbsp;•&nbsp; 📊 ${total}</p>
726:               <p class="char-select-bio">${c.bio || 'Без биографии'}</p>
727:               <div class="char-select-actions">
728:                 <button class="btn btn-primary char-select-btn" data-card-id="${c.id}">Выбрать этого героя</button>
729:               </div>
730:             </div>
731:           `;
732:         }).join('');
733: 
734:         // Select existing card handler - inside callback where cards is in scope
735:         cardsEl.querySelectorAll('.char-select-btn').forEach((btn) => {
736:           btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
737:             const cardId = btn.dataset.cardId;
738:             try {
739:               const card = cards.find((c) => c.id === cardId);
740:               if (!card) return;
741: 
742:               console.log('[character-card] select card:', { cardId, name: card.name, stats: card.stats });
743: 
744:               currentPlayer = await createPlayer({
745:                 session_id: sessionId,
746:                 user_id: user.id,
747:                 name: card.name,
748:                 race: card.race,
749:                 class: card.class,
750:                 appearance: card.appearance,
751:                 bio: card.bio,
752:                 personality: card.personality || {},
753:                 power_level: card.power_level,
754:                 stats: card.stats || {},
755:                 hp: calculateHpFromStats(card.stats),
756:                 max_hp: calculateHpFromStats(card.stats),
757:                 money: card.money,
758:                 ...calculateDerivedStats(card.stats, card.race || 'Человек', [], getRaceAcBonus(card.race)),
759:               });
760: 
761:               console.log('[character-card] player created:', currentPlayer.id);
762:               allPlayers.push(currentPlayer);
763:               toast.success(`Герой «${card.name}» выбран!`);
764:               render();
765:               subscribeRealtime();
766:             } catch (err) {
767:               console.error('[character-card] select error:', err);
768:               toast.error('Ошибка: ' + err.message);
769:             }
770:           });
771:         });
772:       } else if (cardsEl) {
773:         cardsEl.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted" style="text-align: center;">У вас пока нет карточек. Создайте нового героя ниже.</p>';
774:       }
775:     });
776: 
777:     container.innerHTML = `

823:                     <div class="stat-card-label">${stat}</div>
824:                     <input class="stat-card-input" type="number" id="stat_${stat}" value="10" min="1" max="30" />
825:                   </div>
826:                 `).join('')}
827:               </div>
828:               <div id="statsLoading" style="display: none; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem;">
829:                 <span class="form-hint">⏳ Генерация...</span>
830:               </div>
831:               <div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.75rem;">
832:                 <span class="stats-sum" id="statsSum">Сумма: <strong>60</strong> / 72</span>
833:               </div>
834:             </div>
835:             <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" style="width: 100%;">Начать приключение</button>
836:           </form>
837:         </div>
838:       </div>
839:     `;

841:     // Create new character
842:     document.getElementById('createCharacterForm')?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
843:       e.preventDefault();
844: 
845:       const stats = {};
846:       STATS.forEach((stat) => {
847:         stats[stat] = parseInt(document.getElementById(`stat_${stat}`).value) || 10;
848:       });
849: 
850:       const requestPayload = {
851:         session_id: sessionId,
852:         user_id: user.id,
853:         name: document.getElementById('charName').value,
854:         race: document.getElementById('charRace').value,
855:         class: document.getElementById('charClass').value,
856:         appearance: document.getElementById('charAppearance').value,
857:         bio: document.getElementById('charBio').value,
858:         personality: { ideals: [], bonds: [], flaws: [] },
859:         power_level: 10,
860:         stats,
861:         hp: calculateHpFromStats(stats),
862:         max_hp: calculateHpFromStats(stats),
863:         money: 50,
864:         initiative: calculateInitiative(stats),
865:         armor_class: calculateArmorClass(stats, document.getElementById('charRace').value || 'Человек', []),
866:         saving_throws: calculateSavingThrows(stats, 2),
867:       };
868:       console.log('[create-character] request:', requestPayload);
869: 
870:       try {
871:         currentPlayer = await createPlayer(requestPayload);
872: 
873:         console.log('[create-character] player created:', currentPlayer.id);
874:         allPlayers.push(currentPlayer);
875:         toast.success('Персонаж создан!');
876:         render();
877:         subscribeRealtime();
878:       } catch (err) {
879:         console.error('[create-character] error:', err);
880:         toast.error('Ошибка создания: ' + err.message);
881:       }
882:     });
883: 
884:     // Auto-update stats sum display
885:     function updateStatsSum() {
886:       let sum = 0;
887:       STATS.forEach((stat) => {
888:         sum += parseInt(document.getElementById(`stat_${stat}`)?.value) || 0;
889:       });
890:       const sumEl = document.getElementById('statsSum');
891:       if (sumEl) {
892:         sumEl.textContent = `Сумма: ${sum} / 72`;
893:         sumEl.style.color = sum === 72 ? 'var(--accent-success)' : sum > 72 ? 'var(--accent-danger)' : 'var(--text-muted)';
894:       }
895:     }
896: 
897:     STATS.forEach((stat) => {
898:       document.getElementById(`stat_${stat}`)?.addEventListener('input', updateStatsSum);
899:     });
900:     updateStatsSum();
901: 
902:     // Generate stats via AI
903:     document.getElementById('generateStatsBtn')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
904:       const bio = document.getElementById('charBio')?.value?.trim();
905:       if (!bio) {
906:         toast.warning('Сначала заполните поле «Биография» — нейросеть проанализирует её для генерации статов.');
907:         return;
908:       }
909: 
910:       const btn = document.getElementById('generateStatsBtn');
911:       const loading = document.getElementById('statsLoading');
912:       btn.disabled = true;
913:       btn.textContent = '⏳ Генерация...';
914:       loading.style.display = 'block';
915: 
916:       try {
917:         const requestPayload = {
918:             user_id: user.id,
919:             name: sanitizeAIText(document.getElementById('charName')?.value || ''),
920:             race: sanitizeAIText(document.getElementById('charRace')?.value || ''),
921:             class: sanitizeAIText(document.getElementById('charClass')?.value || ''),
922:             appearance: sanitizeAIText(document.getElementById('charAppearance')?.value || ''),
923:             bio: sanitizeAIText(bio),
924:           };
925:         console.log('[generate-character] request:', requestPayload);
926: 
927:         const response = await invokeFunction('generate-character', requestPayload);
928:         console.log('[generate-character] response:', response);
929: 
930:         if (response?.stats) {
931:           console.log('[generate-character] applying stats:', response.stats);
932:           STATS.forEach((stat) => {
933:             const input = document.getElementById(`stat_${stat}`);
934:             if (input && response.stats[stat] !== undefined) {
935:               input.value = response.stats[stat];
936:             }
937:           });
938:           updateStatsSum();
939:           toast.success('Статы сгенерированы!');
940:         } else {
941:           console.warn('[generate-character] response without stats:', response);
942:         }
943:       } catch (err) {
944:         console.error('[generate-character] error:', err);
945:         if (err?.data?.code === 'MISSING_API_KEY') {
946:           toast.error('Не задан OpenRouter API Key. Откройте «⚙️ Аккаунт» в лобби и введите ключ.');
947:         } else {
948:           const detail = err?.data?.details || err?.data?.error || err.message || 'Неизвестная ошибка';
949:           toast.error('Ошибка генерации: ' + detail);
950:         }
951:       } finally {
952:         console.log('[generate-character] finally: reset UI');
953:         btn.disabled = false;
954:         btn.textContent = '✨ Сгенерировать нейросетью';
955:         loading.style.display = 'none';
956:       }
957:     });
958:   }
959: 
960:   // Cleanup on unmount
961:   function cleanup() {
962:     if (unsubMessages) unsubMessages();
963:     if (unsubPlayers) unsubPlayers();
964:     if (unsubTurnQueue) {
965:       supabase.removeChannel(unsubTurnQueue);
966:     }
967:   }
968: 
969:   await load();
970: 
971:   // Return cleanup function
972:   return cleanup;
973: }

================
File: supabase/functions/process-turn/index.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/index.ts
  2: // 5-шаговый конвейер process-turn: Router → Engine → Persistence → SystemTruth → Narrator
  3: //
  4: // Шаги:
  5: //   1. AI Router  (step1_router.ts)        — парсинг намерений игрока → JSON actions
  6: //   2. Game Engine (engine/step2_engine.ts) — броски кубиков, проверки, мутации
  7: //   3. Persistence (step3_persistence.ts)   — атомарное применение мутаций через RPC
  8: //   4. System Truth (step4_system_truth.ts) — Туман Войны, разделение видимости, RAG
  9: //   5. Narrator  (step5_narrator.ts)        — LLM-нарратор (или fallback)
 10: 
 11: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
 12: import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";
 13: import { sanitizeKey, cleanTextForAI, parseAIJson } from "../_shared/utils.ts";
 14: import { parsePlayerIntent } from "./steps/step1_router.ts";
 15: import { executeEngine } from "./engine/step2_engine.ts";
 16: import { applyTurnMutations } from "./steps/step3_persistence.ts";
 17: import { compileSystemTruth } from "./steps/step4_system_truth.ts";
 18: import { generateNarrative, buildFallbackNarrative } from "./steps/step5_narrator.ts";
 19: import { buildSatellitePrompt, buildGpsPrompt } from "./steps/_shared_prompts.ts";
 20: 
 21: const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
 22: const SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
 23: const FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY = Deno.env.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY") || "";
 24: const AI_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.5";
 25: 
 26: const CORS = {
 27:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
 28:   "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-client-info, apikey",
 29:   "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
 30: };
 31: 
 32: // ============================================
 33: // AI API call
 34: // ============================================
 35: async function callAI(systemPrompt: string, userMessage: string, apiKey: string, retries = 3, model?: string): Promise<string> {
 36:   const useModel = model || AI_MODEL;
 37:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt < retries; attempt++) {
 38:     try {
 39:       const response = await fetch("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", {
 40:         method: "POST",
 41:         headers: {
 42:           "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
 43:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
 44:         },
 45:         body: JSON.stringify({
 46:           model: useModel,
 47:           messages: [
 48:             { role: "system", content: systemPrompt },
 49:             { role: "user", content: userMessage },
 50:           ],
 51:           temperature: 0.7,
 52:           max_tokens: 2000,
 53:         }),
 54:       });
 55:       if (!response.ok) {
 56:         const errText = await response.text();
 57:         if (attempt === retries - 1) throw new Error(`AI API error: ${response.status}`);
 58:         continue;
 59:       }
 60:       const data = await response.json();
 61:       return data.choices[0].message.content;
 62:     } catch (err) {
 63:       if (attempt === retries - 1) throw err;
 64:       await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000 * (attempt + 1)));
 65:     }
 66:   }
 67:   throw new Error("AI call failed after all retries");
 68: }
 69: 
 70: // ============================================
 71: // Утилиты времени (для fallback в GPS, если Шаг 1.6 не вызывается)
 72: // ============================================
 73: function advanceTime(base: { year: number; month: number; day: number; hour: number; minute: number }, addMinutes: number) {
 74:   let totalMin = (base.hour * 60 + base.minute + addMinutes);
 75:   let day = base.day, month = base.month, year = base.year;
 76:   const minutesInDay = 24 * 60;
 77:   while (totalMin >= minutesInDay) {
 78:     totalMin -= minutesInDay;
 79:     day++;
 80:     if (day > 30) { day = 1; month++; if (month > 12) { month = 1; year++; } }
 81:   }
 82:   return { year, month, day, hour: Math.floor(totalMin / 60), minute: totalMin % 60 };
 83: }
 84: 
 85: // ============================================
 86: // Main Handler — 5-шаговый конвейер
 87: // ============================================
 88: serve(async (req) => {
 89:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 90:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 91:   }
 92: 
 93:   const requestId = crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
 94:   console.log(`\n[${requestId}] ════════ PROCESS-TURN (5-step pipeline) START ════════`);
 95: 
 96:   try {
 97:     const { session_id, player_id, action_text } = await req.json();
 98:     const safeActionText = cleanTextForAI(action_text);
 99: 
100:     if (!session_id || !player_id || !safeActionText) {
101:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing required fields" }), {
102:         status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
103:       });
104:     }
105: 
106:     const imagePattern = /\b(image|img|photo|picture|avatar|icon|base64|data)\b[\s\S]*?\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|bmp|svg)\b/gi;
107:     if (imagePattern.test(safeActionText)) {
108:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Обнаружены ссылки на изображения. Удалите их и попробуйте снова." }), {
109:         status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
110:       });
111:     }
112: 
113:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
114: 
115:     // ============================================
116:     // LOAD CONTEXT
117:     // ============================================
118:     const { data: player, error: playerErr } = await supabase
119:       .from("players")
120:       .select("*, inventory(*)")
121:       .eq("id", player_id)
122:       .single();
123:     if (playerErr || !player) {
124:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Player not found" }), { status: 404, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
125:     }
126: 
127:     const { data: session } = await supabase
128:       .from("sessions")
129:       .select("*, worlds(settings)")
130:       .eq("id", session_id)
131:       .single();
132:     if (!session) {
133:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Session not found" }), { status: 404, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
134:     }
135: 
136:     // Resolve API key + models
137:     let openrouterApiKey = sanitizeKey(FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY);
138:     let satelliteModel = AI_MODEL, gpsModel = AI_MODEL, dmModel = AI_MODEL;
139:     if (player.user_id) {
140:       const { data: us } = await supabase.from("user_settings")
141:         .select("openrouter_key, satellite_model, gps_model, dm_model")
142:         .eq("id", player.user_id).maybeSingle();
143:       if (us?.openrouter_key) openrouterApiKey = sanitizeKey(us.openrouter_key);
144:       if (us?.satellite_model) satelliteModel = us.satellite_model;
145:       if (us?.gps_model) gpsModel = us.gps_model;
146:       if (us?.dm_model) dmModel = us.dm_model;
147:     }
148:     if (!openrouterApiKey) {
149:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Укажите ваш OpenRouter API Key в настройках.", code: "MISSING_API_KEY" }), {
150:         status: 402, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
151:       });
152:     }
153: 
154:     // Load location, available locations, lore
155:     let currentLocationName: string | null = null, currentStateName: string | null = null;
156:     if (session.current_location_id) {
157:       const { data: locData } = await supabase.from("locations").select("name, states(name)").eq("id", session.current_location_id).maybeSingle();
158:       if (locData) { currentLocationName = locData.name; currentStateName = locData.states?.name || null; }
159:     }
160:     let availableLocations: { id: string; name: string; type: string; state_name: string }[] = [];
161:     if (session.world_id) {
162:       const { data: locsData } = await supabase.from("locations").select("id, name, type, states(name)").eq("world_id", session.world_id).order("name");
163:       availableLocations = (locsData || []).map((l: any) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name, type: l.type, state_name: l.states?.name || '' }));
164:     }
165:     let loreContext = "";
166:     if (session.world_id) {
167:       const { data: loreFiles } = await supabase.from("lore_files").select("title, content").eq("world_id", session.world_id).limit(5);
168:       if (loreFiles?.length) {
169:         loreContext = loreFiles.map((f) => `### ${f.title}\n${cleanTextForAI(f.content).slice(0, 500)}`).join("\n\n");
170:       }
171:     }
172:     const { data: recentMsgs } = await supabase.from("messages").select("content, sender_type").eq("session_id", session_id).order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(10);
173:     const recentMessages = (recentMsgs || []).reverse().map((m) => `[${m.sender_type === "master" ? "Мастер" : "Игрок"}]: ${cleanTextForAI(m.content).slice(0, 200)}`);
174: 
175:     // ============================================
176:     // ШАГ 1: AI Router (parsePlayerIntent)
177:     // ============================================
178:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 1] AI Router...`);
179:     const routerResult = await parsePlayerIntent({
180:       player_name: player.name,
181:       player_race: player.race,
182:       player_class: player.class,
183:       player_id: player.id,
184:       action_text: safeActionText,
185:       player_inventory: (player.inventory || []).map((i: any) => i.item_name),
186:       world_lore: loreContext,
187:       recent_messages: recentMessages,
188:       current_location: currentLocationName,
189:       current_state: currentStateName,
190:       current_time: {
191:         year: session.game_year || 1, month: session.game_month || 1, day: session.game_day || 1,
192:         hour: session.game_hour || 8, minute: session.game_minute || 0,
193:       },
194:       available_locations: availableLocations,
195:       openrouter_api_key: openrouterApiKey,
196:       satellite_model: satelliteModel,
197:     });
198: 
199:     if (routerResult.status === "clarification_needed") {
200:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
201:         success: false,
202:         status: "clarification_needed",
203:         clarification_msg: routerResult.clarification_msg,
204:         actions: [],
205:       }), { status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
206:     }
207: 
208:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 1] OK: ${routerResult.actions.length} actions`);
209: 
210:     // Apply GPS time/location (still here, as it's pre-engine)
211:     let time_passed_minutes = 0;
212:     let location_changed = false, new_location_id: string | null = null, travel_description = "";
213:     try {
214:       const gpsSystemPrompt = buildGpsPrompt({
215:         playerName: cleanTextForAI(player.name),
216:         actionText: safeActionText,
217:         intentType: "router",
218:         intentDescription: safeActionText,
219:         currentYear: session.game_year || 1, currentMonth: session.game_month || 1,
220:         currentDay: session.game_day || 1, currentHour: session.game_hour || 8,
221:         currentMinute: session.game_minute || 0,
222:         currentLocation: currentLocationName, currentState: currentStateName,
223:         wantsLocationChange: false, locationChangeDescription: "",
224:         availableLocations,
225:       });
226:       const gpsResp = await callAI(gpsSystemPrompt, "Определи время.", openrouterApiKey, 2, gpsModel);
227:       const gpsParsed = parseAIJson(gpsResp);
228:       if (gpsParsed) {
229:         time_passed_minutes = Math.max(0, Math.min(1440, Number(gpsParsed.time_minutes) || 0));
230:         location_changed = gpsParsed.location_changed === true;
231:         new_location_id = gpsParsed.new_location_id || null;
232:         travel_description = gpsParsed.travel_description || "";
233:       }
234:     } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
235: 
236:     // ============================================
237:     // ШАГ 2: Game Engine
238:     // ============================================
239:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 2] Game Engine...`);
240:     // Load all players in session (for engine context)
241:     const { data: allPlayers } = await supabase.from("players").select("*, inventory(*)").eq("session_id", session_id);
242:     // Load all NPCs in current location
243:     let allNpcs: any[] = [];
244:     if (session.current_location_id) {
245:       const { data: npcData } = await supabase.from("npcs")
246:         .select("id, name, race, role, hp, max_hp, armor_class, level, is_alive, is_hostile, status_tags, stats")
247:         .eq("location_id", session.current_location_id);
248:       allNpcs = npcData || [];
249:     }
250: 
251:     const engineResult = executeEngine({
252:       router_output: routerResult,
253:       session: {
254:         id: session_id,
255:         difficulty: session.difficulty || "normal",
256:         is_pvp_enabled: session.is_pvp_enabled || false,
257:         game_year: session.game_year || 1, game_month: session.game_month || 1,
258:         game_day: session.game_day || 1, game_hour: session.game_hour || 8,
259:         game_minute: session.game_minute || 0,
260:         current_location_id: session.current_location_id,
261:       },
262:       acting_player: {
263:         id: player.id, name: player.name,
264:         stats: player.stats || { STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 },
265:         hp: player.hp, max_hp: player.max_hp,
266:         armor_class: player.armor_class || 10,
267:         initiative: player.initiative || 0,
268:         level: player.level || 1,
269:         inventory: player.inventory || [],
270:         injuries: player.injuries || [],
271:       },
272:       targets: {
273:         players: new Map((allPlayers || []).map((p: any) => [p.id, p])),
274:         npcs: new Map(allNpcs.map((n: any) => [n.id, n])),
275:         location_items: new Map(),
276:       },
277:     });
278:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 2] OK: ${engineResult.mutations.length} mutations`);
279: 
280:     // ============================================
281:     // ШАГ 3: DB Persistence
282:     // ============================================
283:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 3] Persistence...`);
284:     const persistenceResult = await applyTurnMutations({
285:       session_id,
286:       engine_output: engineResult,
287:     });
288:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 3] ${persistenceResult.status}, ${persistenceResult.applied_mutations_count} applied`);
289: 
290:     // Apply time advance to session
291:     if (time_passed_minutes > 0) {
292:       const nt = advanceTime({
293:         year: session.game_year || 1, month: session.game_month || 1, day: session.game_day || 1,
294:         hour: session.game_hour || 8, minute: session.game_minute || 0,
295:       }, time_passed_minutes);
296:       await supabase.from("sessions").update({
297:         game_year: nt.year, game_month: nt.month, game_day: nt.day,
298:         game_hour: nt.hour, game_minute: nt.minute,
299:       }).eq("id", session_id);
300:     }
301:     if (location_changed && new_location_id) {
302:       await supabase.from("sessions").update({ current_location_id: new_location_id }).eq("id", session_id);
303:     }
304: 
305:     // ============================================
306:     // ШАГ 4: System Truth Compiler
307:     // ============================================
308:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 4] System Truth...`);
309:     const systemTruth = await compileSystemTruth({
310:       session_id,
311:       acting_player_id: player.id,
312:       engine_output: engineResult,
313:       persistence_output: persistenceResult,
314:       session: {
315:         game_year: session.game_year || 1, game_month: session.game_month || 1,
316:         game_day: session.game_day || 1, game_hour: session.game_hour || 8,
317:         game_minute: session.game_minute || 0,
318:         current_location_id: session.current_location_id,
319:       },
320:       location: { name: currentLocationName || "Неизвестно", weather: null },
321:       players: (allPlayers || []).map((p: any) => ({
322:         id: p.id, name: p.name, hp: p.hp, max_hp: p.max_hp, inventory: p.inventory || [],
323:       })),
324:       npcs: allNpcs.map((n: any) => ({ id: n.id, name: n.name, race: n.race, role: n.role, status_tags: n.status_tags })),
325:       atmosphere: { sounds: [], visuals: [] },
326:       time_passed_minutes,
327:       encounter_alert: null,
328:     });
329:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 4] turn_status=${systemTruth.turn_status}, ${Object.keys(systemTruth.player_truths).length} player_truths`);
330: 
331:     // ============================================
332:     // ШАГ 5: Narrator
333:     // ============================================
334:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 5] Narrator...`);
335:     let narratorOutput: { players: Record<string, string>; global_narrative: string };
336:     try {
337:       narratorOutput = await generateNarrative({
338:         system_truth: systemTruth,
339:         action_text: safeActionText,
340:         player_name: player.name,
341:         player_race: player.race,
342:         player_class: player.class,
343:         lore_context: loreContext,
344:         openrouter_api_key: openrouterApiKey,
345:         dm_model: dmModel,
346:       });
347:     } catch (narratorErr) {
348:       console.warn(`[${requestId}] [STEP 5] LLM failed, using fallback:`, narratorErr);
349:       narratorOutput = buildFallbackNarrative(systemTruth);
350:     }
351:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 5] ${Object.keys(narratorOutput.players).length} player narratives`);
352: 
353:     // ============================================
354:     // SAVE: messages + turn_queue
355:     // ============================================
356:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [SAVE] Persisting messages...`);
357:     // 1) Player action
358:     await supabase.from("messages").insert({
359:       session_id, sender_type: "player", sender_id: player.user_id, sender_name: player.name, content: safeActionText,
360:     });
361:     // 2) Master narratives — по одному сообщению на игрока
362:     for (const [targetPlayerId, narrative] of Object.entries(narratorOutput.players)) {
363:       await supabase.from("messages").insert({
364:         session_id, sender_type: "master", sender_name: "Мастер", content: narrative,
365:         metadata: {
366:           target_player_id: targetPlayerId,
367:           turn_status: systemTruth.turn_status,
368:           hp_status: systemTruth.player_truths[targetPlayerId]?.hp_status,
369:           inventory_delta: systemTruth.player_truths[targetPlayerId]?.inventory_delta,
370:         },
371:       });
372:     }
373:     // 3) Global log
374:     if (narratorOutput.global_narrative) {
375:       await supabase.from("messages").insert({
376:         session_id, sender_type: "master", sender_name: "Лог",
377:         content: narratorOutput.global_narrative,
378:         metadata: { type: "global_log", is_global: true },
379:       });
380:     }
381: 
382:     // turn_queue: текущий ход completed → следующий active
383:     try {
384:       await supabase.from("turn_queue").update({
385:         status: "completed", resolved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
386:         parsed_action: routerResult, roll_result: engineResult,
387:       }).eq("session_id", session_id).eq("player_id", player.id).in("status", ["active", "pending"]);
388: 
389:       const { data: nextTurn } = await supabase.from("turn_queue")
390:         .select("id, player_id")
391:         .eq("session_id", session_id).eq("status", "pending")
392:         .order("turn_number", { ascending: true }).limit(1).maybeSingle();
393:       if (nextTurn) {
394:         await supabase.from("turn_queue").update({ status: "active" }).eq("id", nextTurn.id);
395:       }
396:     } catch (queueErr) { console.warn(`[${requestId}] [SAVE] turn_queue update failed:`, queueErr); }
397: 
398:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
399:       success: true,
400:       pipeline: {
401:         step1: { status: "ok", actions_count: routerResult.actions.length },
402:         step2: { status: "ok", mutations_count: engineResult.mutations.length },
403:         step3: { status: persistenceResult.status, applied: persistenceResult.applied_mutations_count },
404:         step4: { status: "ok", turn_status: systemTruth.turn_status },
405:         step5: { status: "ok", players_narrated: Object.keys(narratorOutput.players).length },
406:       },
407:       turn_status: systemTruth.turn_status,
408:       narratives: narratorOutput,
409:       game_time: systemTruth.environment.time,
410:       time_minutes: time_passed_minutes,
411:       location_changed,
412:     }), { status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
413: 
414:   } catch (err) {
415:     console.error(`[${requestId}] ❌ ERROR:`, err);
416:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || "Internal server error" }), {
417:       status: 500, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
418:     });
419:   }
420: });

105: // ===================== SESSIONS =====================
106: 
107: export async function getSessions() {
108:   const { data: sessions, error: sessErr } = await supabase
109:     .from('sessions')
110:     .select('*')
111:     .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
112:   if (sessErr) throw sessErr;
113:   if (!sessions || sessions.length === 0) return [];
114: 
115:   const worldIds = [...new Set(sessions.map((s) => s.world_id).filter(Boolean))];
116:   const sessionIds = sessions.map((s) => s.id);
117: 
118:   // Параллельно забираем миры и всех участников всех сессий за 2 запроса
119:   const [{ data: worlds }, { data: allPlayers }] = await Promise.all([
120:     supabase.from('worlds').select('id, name').in('id', worldIds.length ? worldIds : ['00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000']),
121:     supabase.from('players').select('id, session_id, name, user_id, hp, max_hp, is_active').in('session_id', sessionIds),
122:   ]);
123: 
124:   const worldMap = {};
125:   (worlds || []).forEach((w) => { worldMap[w.id] = w; });
126: 
127:   const playersBySession = {};
128:   (allPlayers || []).forEach((p) => {
129:     if (!playersBySession[p.session_id]) playersBySession[p.session_id] = [];
130:     playersBySession[p.session_id].push(p);
131:   });
132: 
133:   return sessions.map((s) => ({
134:     ...s,
135:     worlds: worldMap[s.world_id] || null,
136:     players: playersBySession[s.id] || [],
137:   }));
138: }
139: 
140: export async function getSession(id) {
141:   const { data, error } = await supabase
142:     .from('sessions')
143:     .select('*, worlds(settings), current_locations:locations(name), current_states:states(name)')
144:     .eq('id', id)
145:     .single();
146:   if (error) throw error;
147:   // Flatten location and state names
148:   if (data) {
149:     data.current_location_name = data.current_locations?.name || null;
150:     data.current_state_name = data.current_states?.name || null;
151:     data.current_locations = undefined;
152:     data.current_states = undefined;
153:   }
154:   return data;
155: }

290:     .from('turn_queue')
291:     .select('*')
292:     .eq('session_id', sessionId)
293:     .eq('status', 'active')

296:   if (error && error.code !== 'PGRST116') throw error;

300: export async function submitAction(sessionId, playerId, actionText) {
301:   try {
302:     return await invokeFunction('process-turn', {
303:       session_id: sessionId,
304:       player_id: playerId,
305:       action_text: actionText,
306:     });
307:   } catch (err) {
308:     if (err?.data?.code === 'MISSING_API_KEY' || err?.status === 402) {
309:       throw new Error('MISSING_API_KEY');
310:     }
311:     throw new Error(err.message || 'Неизвестная ошибка');
312:   }
313: }

377:     p_user_id: userId,
378:     p_openrouter_key: openrouterKey || null,
379:     p_card_model: models.card_model || null,
380:     p_dm_model: models.dm_model || null,
381:     p_gps_model: models.gps_model || null,
382:     p_satellite_model: models.satellite_model || null,
383:   });
384:   if (error) throw error;
385:   return data;
386: }

390: export async function exportWorld(worldId) {
391:   const world = await getWorld(worldId);
392:   const loreFiles = await getLoreFiles(worldId);
393:   const folders = await getLoreFilesByFolder(worldId);
394:   
395:   // Get states with locations
396:   const { data: states } = await supabase
397:     .from('states')
398:     .select('*, locations(*)')
399:     .eq('world_id', worldId)
400:     .order('name');
401:   
402:   // Get NPCs with location info
403:   const { data: npcs } = await supabase
404:     .from('npcs')
405:     .select('*')
406:     .eq('world_id', worldId)
407:     .order('role')
408:     .order('name');
409: 
410:   const exportData = {
411:     version: '3.1',
412:     exported_at: new Date().toISOString(),
413:     schema: 'multirp_world_full',
414:     world: {
415:       name: world.name,
416:       settings: world.settings,
417:       description: world.description || '',
418:     },
419:     lore_files: loreFiles.map((f) => ({
420:       folder: f.folder,
421:       title: f.title,
422:       content: f.content,
423:       tags: f.tags,
424:     })),
425:     folders,
426:     geography: {
427:       states: states?.map(s => ({
428:         id: s.id,
429:         name: s.name,
430:         description: s.description,
431:         ruler_id: s.ruler_id,
432:         locations: s.locations?.map(l => ({
433:           id: l.id,
434:           name: l.name,
435:           type: l.type,
436:           description: l.description,
437:         })) || [],
438:       })) || [],
439:     },
440:     bestiary: {
441:       npcs: npcs?.map(n => ({
442:         id: n.id,
443:         name: n.name,
444:         race: n.race,
445:         class: n.class || '',
446:         category: n.category,
447:         role: n.role,
448:         appearance: n.appearance,
449:         background: n.background,
450:         stats: n.stats,
451:         // Расчётные поля (hp, max_hp, armor_class, initiative, saving_throws) исключаены — рассчитываются автоматически
452:         level: n.level,
453:         tier: n.tier,
454:         hit_dice: n.hit_dice || 8,
455:         // Для неуникальных существ — диапазон уровней при спавне
456:         level_min: n.level_min || n.level || 1,
457:         level_max: n.level_max || n.level || 1,
458:         status_tags: n.status_tags,
459:         habits: n.habits,
460:         catchphrases: n.catchphrases,
461:         location_id: n.location_id,
462:         state_id: n.state_id,
463:         special_attacks: n.special_attacks,
464:         base_attacks: n.base_attacks,
465:         is_pack: n.is_pack_instance,
466:         pack_size: n.pack_size,
467:         is_unique: n.is_unique || false,
468:       })) || [],
469:     },
470:   };
471: 
472:   return exportData;
473: }
474: 
475: export function downloadJSON(data, filename) {
476:   const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
477:   const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
478:   const a = document.createElement('a');
479:   a.href = url;
480:   a.download = filename;
481:   a.click();
482:   URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
483: }

485: // Get schema info for display
486: export function getWorldSchema() {
487:   return {
488:     version: '3.1',
489:     description: 'Полный экспорт мира MultiRP',
490:     structure: {
491:       version: 'string - версии формата',
492:       exported_at: 'ISO timestamp',
493:       schema: 'идентификатор схемы',
494:       world: {
495:         name: 'string - название мира',
496:         settings: 'object - настройки мира (races, classes, max_level и т.д.)',

610: export async function importWorld(jsonData, ownerId) {
611:   const worldData = JSON.parse(jsonData);
612:   
613:   // Validate schema
614:   if (!worldData.world || !worldData.version) {
615:     throw new Error('Некорректный формат файла мира');
616:   }
617: 
618:   const world = await createWorld({
619:     owner_id: ownerId,
620:     name: worldData.world.name,
621:     settings: worldData.world.settings,
622:     description: worldData.world.description || '',
623:   });
624: 
625:   // Import lore files
626:   let loreCount = 0;
627:   if (worldData.lore_files?.length) {
628:     const files = worldData.lore_files.map((f) => ({
629:       world_id: world.id,
630:       folder: f.folder,
631:       title: f.title,
632:       content: f.content,
633:       tags: f.tags || [],
634:     }));
635:     const { error } = await supabase.from('lore_files').insert(files);
636:     if (error) throw error;
637:     loreCount = files.length;
638:   }
639: 
640:   // Import geography (states + locations)
641:   const locationIdMap = {}; // old ID -> new ID
642:   const locationNameMap = {}; // name -> new ID (for JSON without IDs)
643:   const stateIdMap = {}; // old ID -> new ID
644:   const stateNameMap = {}; // name -> new ID (for JSON without IDs)
645:   let stateCount = 0;
646:   let locationCount = 0;
647:   
648:   if (worldData.geography?.states?.length) {
649:     for (const state of worldData.geography.states) {
650:       const { data: newState, error: stateError } = await supabase
651:         .from('states')
652:         .insert({
653:           world_id: world.id,
654:           name: state.name,
655:           description: state.description || '',
656:         })
657:         .select()
658:         .single();
659:       
660:       if (stateError) throw stateError;
661:       stateIdMap[state.id] = newState.id;
662:       stateNameMap[state.name.toLowerCase().trim()] = newState.id;
663:       stateCount++;
664:       
665:       // Import locations for this state
666:       if (state.locations?.length) {
667:         const locations = state.locations.map(l => ({
668:           state_id: newState.id,
669:           name: l.name,
670:           type: l.type || 'city',
671:           description: l.description || '',
672:         }));
673:         
674:         const { data: newLocations, error: locError } = await supabase
675:           .from('locations')
676:           .insert(locations)
677:           .select();
678:         
679:         if (locError) throw locError;
680:         locationCount += newLocations.length;
681:         
682:         // Map old location IDs to new ones
683:         state.locations.forEach((oldLoc, idx) => {
684:           if (newLocations[idx]) {
685:             locationIdMap[oldLoc.id] = newLocations[idx].id;
686:             locationNameMap[oldLoc.name.toLowerCase().trim()] = newLocations[idx].id;
687:           }
688:         });
689:       }
690:     }
691:   }
692: 
693:   // Import NPCs
694:   let npcCount = 0;
695:   if (worldData.bestiary?.npcs?.length) {
696:     // Build name-based lookups for locations and states from DB
697:     const locationNameToId = {};
698:     const stateNameToId = {};
699:     
700:     // Fetch all states for this world to build name lookup
701:     const { data: allStates } = await supabase
702:       .from('states')
703:       .select('id, name')
704:       .eq('world_id', world.id);
705:     
706:     if (allStates) {
707:       allStates.forEach(s => {
708:         stateNameToId[s.name.toLowerCase().trim()] = s.id;
709:       });
710:     }
711:     
712:     // Fetch all locations for this world (via states)
713:     if (allStates?.length) {
714:       const stateIds = allStates.map(s => s.id);
715:       const { data: allLocations } = await supabase
716:         .from('locations')
717:         .select('id, name')
718:         .in('state_id', stateIds);
719:       
720:       if (allLocations) {
721:         allLocations.forEach(l => {
722:           locationNameToId[l.name.toLowerCase().trim()] = l.id;
723:         });
724:       }
725:     }
726:     
727:     const npcs = worldData.bestiary.npcs.map(n => {
728:       // Resolve location_id: can be UUID (from export) or name (manual JSON)
729:       let locationId = null;
730:       if (n.location_id) {
731:         // Try UUID mapping first (from export)
732:         locationId = locationIdMap[n.location_id] || null;
733:         // Try name mapping from imported locations
734:         if (!locationId && typeof n.location_id === 'string') {
735:           locationId = locationNameMap[n.location_id.toLowerCase().trim()] || null;
736:         }
737:         // Fallback: search all locations in DB by name
738:         if (!locationId && typeof n.location_id === 'string') {
739:           locationId = locationNameToId[n.location_id.toLowerCase().trim()] || null;
740:         }
741:       }
742:       
743:       // Resolve state_id: can be UUID (from export) or name (manual JSON)
744:       let stateId = null;
745:       if (n.state_id) {
746:         // Try UUID mapping first (from export)
747:         stateId = stateIdMap[n.state_id] || null;
748:         // Try name mapping from imported states
749:         if (!stateId && typeof n.state_id === 'string') {
750:           stateId = stateNameMap[n.state_id.toLowerCase().trim()] || null;
751:         }
752:         // Fallback: search all states in DB by name
753:         if (!stateId && typeof n.state_id === 'string') {
754:           stateId = stateNameToId[n.state_id.toLowerCase().trim()] || null;
755:         }
756:       }
757:       
758:       // Расчётные поля
759:       const safeStats = {
760:         STR: Number(n.stats?.STR) || 10,
761:         DEX: Number(n.stats?.DEX) || 10,
762:         CON: Number(n.stats?.CON) || 10,
763:         INT: Number(n.stats?.INT) || 10,
764:         WIS: Number(n.stats?.WIS) || 10,
765:         CHA: Number(n.stats?.CHA) || 10,
766:       };
767:       const nLevel = Number(n.level) || 1;
768:       const nHitDie = [6, 8, 10, 12].includes(Number(n.hit_dice)) ? Number(n.hit_dice) : 8;
769:       const nRace = n.race || 'Человек';
770:       
771:       // HP: уровень 1 = макс кости + CON mod + 10, каждый следующий = среднее + CON mod
772:       const calculatedHp = calculateHpDnd(safeStats.CON, nLevel, nHitDie);
773:       
774:       // AC: 10 + DEX mod + расовый бонус
775:       const dexMod = Math.floor((safeStats.DEX - 10) / 2);
776:       const raceBonus = getRaceAcBonus(nRace);
777:       const calculatedAC = 10 + dexMod + raceBonus;
778:       
779:       // Initiative: DEX mod
780:       const calculatedInit = dexMod;
781:       
782:       // Saving throws: stat mod + proficiency bonus
783:       const proficiencyBonus = Math.ceil(nLevel / 4) + 1;
784:       const calculatedSaves = {};
785:       for (const stat of ['STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA']) {
786:         const statMod = Math.floor((safeStats[stat] - 10) / 2);
787:         calculatedSaves[stat] = statMod + proficiencyBonus;
788:       }
789:       
790:       return {
791:         world_id: world.id,
792:         name: n.name,
793:         race: nRace,
794:         category: n.category || 'npc',
795:         class: n.class || '',
796:         role: ['main', 'secondary', 'tertiary'].includes(n.role) ? n.role : 'secondary',
797:         appearance: n.appearance || '',
798:         background: n.background || '',
799:         stats: safeStats,
800:         // Расчётные поля
801:         hp: calculatedHp,
802:         max_hp: calculatedHp,
803:         armor_class: calculatedAC,
804:         initiative: calculatedInit,
805:         saving_throws: calculatedSaves,
806:         level: nLevel,
807:         tier: n.tier || 1,
808:         hit_dice: nHitDie,
809:         level_min: Number(n.level_min) || nLevel,
810:         level_max: Number(n.level_max) || nLevel,
811:         status_tags: n.status_tags || [],
812:         habits: n.habits || [],
813:         catchphrases: n.catchphrases || [],
814:         location_id: locationId,
815:         state_id: stateId,
816:         // Combat fields
817:         special_attacks: Array.isArray(n.special_attacks) ? n.special_attacks : [],
818:         base_attacks: Array.isArray(n.base_attacks) ? n.base_attacks : [],
819:         is_pack_instance: n.is_pack === true,
820:         pack_size: n.is_pack ? (n.pack_size || 2) : 1,
821:         is_unique: n.is_unique === true,
822:       };
823:     });
824:     
825:     const { error: npcError } = await supabase.from('npcs').insert(npcs);
826:     if (npcError) throw npcError;
827:     npcCount = npcs.length;
828:   }
829: 
830:   return {
831:     world,
832:     stats: {
833:       loreCount,
834:       stateCount,
835:       locationCount,
836:       npcCount,
837:       hasGeography: stateCount > 0,
838:       hasBestiary: npcCount > 0,
839:     },
840:   };
841: }
842: 
843: // ===================== NPC BESTIARY =====================
844: 
845: export async function getNpcsByWorld(worldId) {
846:   const { data, error } = await supabase
847:     .from('npcs')
848:     .select('*, locations(name)')
849:     .eq('world_id', worldId)
850:     .order('role', { ascending: true })
851:     .order('name', { ascending: true });
852:   if (error) throw error;
853:   // Flatten location name for easier access
854:   return data?.map(npc => ({
855:     ...npc,
856:     location_name: npc.locations?.name || null,
857:     locations: undefined,
858:   })) || [];
859: }
860: 
861: export async function getNpc(id) {
862:   const { data, error } = await supabase
863:     .from('npcs')
864:     .select('*')
865:     .eq('id', id)
866:     .single();
867:   if (error) throw error;
868:   return data;
869: }
870: 
871: export async function createNpc(npc) {
872:   const payload = { ...npc };
873:   if (payload.location_name !== undefined) {
874:     const locationName = payload.location_name;
875:     delete payload.location_name;
876:     if (locationName) {
877:       const { data: location } = await supabase
878:         .from('locations')
879:         .select('id')
880:         .ilike('name', locationName)
881:         .maybeSingle();
882:       payload.location_id = location?.id || null;
883:     } else {
884:       payload.location_id = null;
885:     }
886:   }
887: 
888:   const { data, error } = await supabase
889:     .from('npcs')
890:     .insert(payload)
891:     .select()
892:     .single();
893:   if (error) throw error;
894:   return data;
895: }
896: 
897: export async function updateNpc(id, updates) {
898:   // Resolve location_name to location_id if provided
899:   if (updates.location_name !== undefined) {
900:     const locationName = updates.location_name;
901:     delete updates.location_name;
902:     if (locationName) {
903:       const { data: location } = await supabase
904:         .from('locations')
905:         .select('id')
906:         .ilike('name', locationName)
907:         .maybeSingle();
908:       updates.location_id = location?.id || null;
909:     } else {
910:       updates.location_id = null;
911:     }
912:   }
913:   
914:   const { data, error } = await supabase
915:     .from('npcs')
916:     .update(updates)
917:     .eq('id', id)
918:     .select()
919:     .single();
920:   if (error) throw error;
921:   return data;
922: }
923: 
924: export async function deleteNpc(id) {
925:   const { error } = await supabase.from('npcs').delete().eq('id', id);
926:   if (error) throw error;
927: }

929: export async function exportPlayer(playerId) {
930:   const player = await getPlayer(playerId);
931:   const inventory = await getPlayerInventory(playerId);
932: 
933:   const exportData = {
934:     version: '2.0',
935:     exported_at: new Date().toISOString(),
936:     player: {
937:       name: player.name,
938:       race: player.race,
939:       class: player.class,
940:       appearance: player.appearance,
941:       personality: player.personality,
942:       bio: player.bio,
943:       power_level: player.power_level,
944:       stats: player.stats,
945:       hp: player.hp,
946:       max_hp: player.max_hp,
947:       money: player.money,
948:     },
949:     inventory: inventory.map((item) => ({
950:       item_name: item.item_name,
951:       quantity: item.quantity,
952:       type: item.type,
953:       attributes: item.attributes,
954:     })),
955:   };
956: 
957:   return exportData;
958: }

File: supabase/functions/generate-character/index.ts

  1: // supabase/functions/generate-character/index.ts
  2: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
  3: import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";
  4: import {
  5:   sanitizeKey,
  6:   cleanTextForAI,
  7:   parseAIJson,
  8:   validateAndFixStats,
  9:   calculateDerivedStats,
 10: } from "../_shared/utils.ts";

 12: const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
 13: const SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
 14: const FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY = Deno.env.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY") || "";
 15: const AI_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.5";
